jobs.title: Business Immigration Attorney
jobs.excerpt: CIP PC is a nationally recognized immigration law firm known for delivering strategic, business-focused solutions.
jobs.description:
CIP PC is a nationally recognized immigration law firm known for delivering strategic, business-focused solutions. With a highly skilled remote-first team based across the United States, we are experiencing strong growth driven by continued success with our corporate clients. To support this momentum, we are excited to add an Attorney with expertise in business immigration to our team. This is a permanent, full-time opportunity to work alongside industry-leading professionals in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. 

The purpose of theBusiness Immigration Attorney at CIP, P.C., is to assist the assigned team in the review and filing of immigration casework. In this role, The Business Immigration Attorney will closely liaise with client contacts, provide strategic legal counsel, and help manage immigration programs. In-depth experience with high volume employment-based NIV and IV immigration cases, including PERM, I-140, AOS, H-1B, L-1, TN, and E visa matters is required within this role. It also requires legal research and preparation of complex written projects for immigration cases as well as reviewing work of Paralegals, to ensure accuracy and quality.

What you’ll do:

  • Prepare and file cases for acceptance and approval including at least H-1B, I-140, I-485, and client-relevant NIV/IV
  • Perform client management and consult for Small Business potential clients, while also guiding clients through processes
  • Provide support to Managing Attorney on Enterprise clients as well as provide support and leadership to assigned team(s)
  • May liaise with other attorneys or departments in the firm on projects
  • Assist with maintenance of casework quality and consistency on the assigned team(s)
  • Evaluate cases and assist in providing case strategies and/or solutions to issues
  • Provide coverage for attorneys on vacation and leave of absence
  • Work closely with and mentor paralegals; May provide supervision of other employees, as required
  • Perform reporting/auditing duties
  • Supplement and maintain knowledge of law and policy changes
  • Perform legal research and prepare legal memoranda and/or legal briefs
  • Analyze facts, patterns, and complex legal issues to provide sound legal advice
  • Prepare immigration-based filings for complex case management
  • Gain rapport and foster strong relationships in a professional, proactive, considerate, and accountable way with clients, colleagues.
  • Other duties as assigned

What you bring:

  • Juris Doctor (JD) degree
  • Admittance to the State Bar
  • 1-3 years of related experience
  • 1+ years of experience/proficiency level with PERM
  • Experience with H-1B, L-1, TN and E visas
  • Track record of consistently meeting SLEs (Service Level Expectations)
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and legal research tools
  • Fluency of the English language in both written and verbal forms; Bilingual a plus, but not required
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with a focus on delivering exceptional client service
  • You exhibit excellent written and verbal English communication skills, including spelling and grammar
  • Sharp eye for attention to detail to ensure consistent accuracy of work
  • You possess an exceptional ability to analyze data and cases
  • Ability to work harmoniously and effectively with others as part of a team
  • Excellent organizational skills and are able to meet strict deadlines
  • You are tech savvy and possess strong computer literacy with the ability to adapt to state-of-the-art Envoy Global case processing software
  • Contribute to positive team morale, even within a remote work environment
  • Ability to multi-task and fulfill daily responsibilities in a fast-paced work environment
  • Ability to troubleshoot and strategize for solution options and recommendations

Why CIP: CIP P.C. is a highly reputable business immigration law firm that focuses on offering its clients exceptional legal service and support, while ensuring a work-life balance for its employees. 

Please note, we may have multiple openings for this role, each of which may require experience with one or more case types. As part of the application process, you will complete a brief screening assessment to indicate your years of experience and relevant case type expertise.

Annual Salary Range: $70,000-$105,000

jobs.title: Customer Experience Analyst
jobs.excerpt: Save lives, from the workplace to anyplace.  The National Safety Council is America’s leading nonprofit safety advocate.
jobs.description:
Save lives, from the workplace to anyplace.

The National Safety Council is America’s leading nonprofit safety advocate. We focus on eliminating the leading causes of preventable injuries and deaths. Through leadership, research, education, and advocacy, NSC focuses on areas where most unintentional injuries and deaths occur.

We are currently looking for a Customer Experience Analystto join us in our mission to save lives and prevent injuries.

Position Highlights:

The Customer Experience Analyst is responsible for analyzing customer interactions, operational performance, and feedback across an omnichannel contact center to drive insights that improve both customer experience and operational efficiency. This role supports the delivery of world-class service by identifying trends, uncovering root causes, and recommending data-driven improvements across voice and digital channels.

Working closely with Customer Service leadership and enablement team colleagues, this role serves as a key partner in optimizing contact center performance, leveraging tools such as Five9, and ensuring insights translate into measurable business outcomes. This position is a critical feeder role to leadership, building the analytical foundation required to support strategic decision-making and continuous improvement.

What You’ll Own:
Omnichannel Data Collection & Analysis
  • Analyze customer interaction data across voice, email, and digital channels to include websites (self-service portals, FAQs), mobile appts, chatbots, live chat, SMS and social mediato identify trends, contact drivers, and performance patterns.
  • Evaluate both experience metrics (CSAT, NPS, CES) and operational KPIs (AHT, FCR, Service Level, Quality) to understand performance drivers.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce customer effort, improve resolution times, and enhance overall experience consistency.
Reporting, Dashboards & Visualization
  • Develop and maintain real-time and historical dashboards that provide visibility into customer experience and operational performance.
  • Deliver recurring and ad hoc reporting for leadership, highlighting risks, trends, and actionable insights.
  • Ensure reporting accuracy and consistency across systems, including Five9 and CRM platforms.
Contact Center Analytics & Five9 Optimization
  • Leverage Five9 reporting and analytics tools to assess:
    • Call routing effectiveness
    • IVR performance and containment
    • Channel utilization and efficiency
  • Partner with leadership to identify and recommend improvements to routing logic, workflows, and self-service capabilities.
  • Support system enhancements and ensure data integrity across contact center platforms.
Voice of Customer (VoC) & Sentiment Analysis
  • Support and manage Voice of Customer programs, integrating feedback from surveys, complaints, and interaction-level data.
  • Synthesize quantitative and qualitative insights to provide a comprehensive view of the customer experience.
  • Monitor sentiment trends across customer segments and channels.
Customer Journey Mapping & Experience Optimization
  • Map and analyze end-to-end customer journeys across contact center touchpoints.
  • Identify friction points, breakdowns, and inconsistencies impacting customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.
  • Partner with stakeholders to improve critical moments in the customer journey.
Root Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement
  • Conduct root cause analysis on negative feedback, repeat contacts, and performance gaps.
  • Identify systemic issues driving customer dissatisfaction and operational inefficiencies.
  • Partner with internal business units and shared service teams to validate findings and develop targeted improvement plans.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives and monitor progress through implementation.
Actionable Insights & Impact Measurement
  • Translate data into clear, prioritized recommendations aligned with customer and business goals.
  • Communicate insights and influence stakeholders across the organization to drive alignment and adoption of proposed solutions.
  • Quantify the impact of proposed changes and track post-implementation performance improvements.
  • Support leadership in making data-driven decisions that balance customer experience with operational efficiency.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Partner with Customer Operations, Workforce Management, Product, IT, and Training teams to align improvement initiatives.
  • Support implementation of process, technology, and experience enhancements.
  • Communicate insights effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
We’re Looking for Someone with:
  • 2–4 years of experience in contact center analytics, customer experience, or operations analysis.
  • Experience in an omnichannel customer service environment.
  • Familiarity with contact center KPIs and workforce dynamics.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex datasets.
  • Knowledge of customer journey mapping and VoC frameworks.
  • Proficiency in reporting tools (Excel, BI tools, dashboards).
  • Strong communication and data storytelling skills.
  • Experience with Five9 reporting, analytics, or administration.
  • Experience with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau) and CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce).
  • Basic experience with SQL or data querying tools.
  • This is a remote position.
  • Salary range: $85,000 to $90,000
Reasons You’ll Love it here:
NSC cares about the safety, health, and overall well-being of our employees. We offer competitive benefits, resources, and tools to promote a work-life balance that supports employees during all phases of life. We offer the following:
  • At least 20 PTO days accrued 1st year and 11 paid holidays
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans
  • Flex spending accounts for medical and dependent care
  • 403(b) & Roth 403(b) with employer match up to 6%
  • Reimbursable training
  • Dress for your day

Our hiring process is designed to give you the opportunity to shine at each step. It starts with an assessment where you really showcase your drive for the role. From there, candidates selected for the first interview will discuss their skills and how they fit with our team. If you're a match, the second interview takes a deeper dive into your background and how you can contribute to our goals. After that, we'll make our final decision and let you know the outcome. This is our usual process, and we're excited to get to know you along the way!

NSC is a Recovery-Friendly Workplace.
We support individuals in or seeking recovery from substance use disorder by fostering a culture of respect, inclusion, and support. We provide access to confidential resources, reasonable accommodations, and a work environment that values your journey and contributions.

NSC is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Success Engineer
jobs.excerpt: As a Senior Technical Success Engineer at Backstory, you will own the hardest issues our largest customers raise.
jobs.description:
As a Senior Technical Success Engineer at Backstory, you will own the hardest issues our largest customers raise. You work them from intake to root cause: reading logs, querying live data stores, and establishing a solution. You will have the internal tooling and data access to investigate properly before ever asking a customer to check something you could have checked yourself. You will have the standing to hold a boundary when Sales, Engineering, or the customer pushes for a shortcut.

This is a role for someone who has outgrown the queue and wants the cases that require judgement rather than throughput. Your findings do not stop at case closure: they become documentation, education, product signal, and better escalations for the whole team. This role trends toward full competency at 12–18 months so the first six months here are disorienting by design. Our platform is deep, the data is enormous, and the challenges can be complex and multifactorial. The people who come through become the ones the rest of the company routes its hardest questions to.

What you will do:

  • Own complex escalations for strategic accounts end-to-end, without oversight.
  • Triage cases at intake as defect, configuration, expectation, or data availability.
  • Resolve post-go-live configuration problems that present as product faults; route what belongs to other CSG teams.
  • Investigate with internal tooling before contacting the customer, including on surfaces we do not control.
  • Diagnose live issues by querying the underlying data stores.
  • Present investigation timelines to customers and to internal audiences.
  • Carry a full caseload to team standards - 4.5-day time to resolution, 95% SLA without closing cases early to hit them.
  • Escalate to Engineering with stakes, timing, and affected-user count attached.
  • Hold ticket-quality and escalation standards when asked to bypass them.
  • Review AI-generated answers with the Technical KB Manager and improve the source artifacts behind them.
  • Submit specific documentation requests to the KB queue; return technical review on drafts within five business days.
  • Review teammates' investigations as you grow into the role.

What you will bring:

  • Enterprise technical support experience, including at least one support role held for 18 months or more.
  • Escalation ownership at a SaaS company whose product moves data between two systems the customer controls.
  • A habit of investigating before replying, with specific logs, queries, and consoles you can name.
  • The ability to diagnose a production issue with a live query. SQL, SOQL, or equivalent; the reasoning matters more than the dialect.
  • Experience holding a written standard under pressure, without conceding a defect or blaming the customer.
  • A recurring question you spotted, specified, and saw through to published documentation. Authorship optional.
  • Communication that separates the technical answer from the relationship problem and addresses both.
  • Nice to have: AI tooling in your own workflow, and a clear account of where it failed and when you stepped back in.

About Backstory.ai:

    Backstory helps companies understand the state of their revenue business by answering questions that span customer interactions, sales activity, pipeline health, and deal execution. The platform operates over trillions of sales activities, millions of deals, and more than 160 million business contacts, giving customers a unified view of the signals that drive revenue. Companies such as Nvidia, OpenAI, AMD, Red Hat, and Databricks rely on Backstory to surface risks, identify opportunities, and understand what's happening across their business.

    Backstory is building AI systems that reason over massive amounts of enterprise data to help business leaders understand what's happening in their business and what to do next. We work at the intersection of large language models, retrieval, evaluation, distributed data systems, and product design, turning billions of signals from across the enterprise into insights people can trust. The underlying challenges span reasoning, search, ranking, data quality, knowledge representation, and operating AI systems against continuously evolving real-world information.

    We value ownership highly — the ability to take an idea through all the stages from conception to shipping a product. This reflects throughout our company, but is especially true in engineering. As an engineer at Backstory, you'll be a part of a highly independent and autonomous team. Since we're building out a robust data layer that needs to be presented elegantly to the end-user, you'll be working with a large array of different technologies and fields. Expect lots of interesting challenges.

Headquartered in San Francisco, CA, Backstory is backed by Y Combinator and Silicon Valley’s top investors, including ICONIQ Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Akkadian Ventures, and Mubadala Capital. Backstory is listed in the top 20 percent of Inc 5000 companies, is a regular leader in our key categories on G2, and is on the Forbes list of America’s Best Startup Employers. For more information, please visit .

jobs.description:
Toloka AI supports frontier model post-training by building domain-specific reinforcement learning environments, tasks, and evaluation frameworks designed by real practitioners.

Mindrift, powered by Toloka — a leading enterprise AI and machine learning data partner since 2014 — connects top domain experts with cutting-edge AI initiatives. Backed by Toloka’s deep expertise in scalable data generation, crowd technology, and applied ML systems, Mindrift enables experts to shape how next-generation generative models learn, reason, and perform.

We are launching a Management Consulting domain focused on translating real-world consulting engagements into structured learning environments for advanced AI systems. To do this credibly, we are assembling a team of strategy consultants from top-tier firms who can convert authentic project experience into end-to-end examples — from problem structuring and work planning to analysis, synthesis, and client-ready recommendations.

You will join a growing team of consultants from leading strategy firms shaping how AI learns high-level business reasoning.

Important: This role is exclusively for consultants with direct experience at a top-tier strategy consulting firm. If you do not have hands-on project experience at one of the firms listed below, please do not apply. This requirement ensures the domain is built by practitioners trained to the highest standards of structured problem-solving and client delivery.

Eligible firms: McKinsey & Company, Boston Consulting Group (BCG), Bain & Company, Oliver Wyman, Roland Berger, Monitor Deloitte (Deloitte S&C), EY-Parthenon, Kearney, and Strategy& (PwC).

Who We’re Looking For

Consultants with 3+ years of experience at one of the firms listed above, with hands-on project experience in:

  • Structuring ambiguous client problems into workable analytical plans
  • Building financial models, market analyses, or synthesized findings from messy inputs
  • Producing client-ready deliverables under time pressure
  • Forming and defending recommendations under uncertainty

No deep technical background is required — we will onboard you on the lightweight tools involved.

What You’ll Do

  • Build realistic consulting project environments — create detailed project scenarios grounded in real engagement dynamics: industry context, financials, constraints, conflicting inputs, and incomplete information.
  • Design structured consulting tasks for AI agents — break projects into discrete tasks that mirror real consulting work: market sizing, commercial due diligence, cost optimization, growth strategy, operational diagnosis, benchmarking, and more.
  • Define evaluation criteria and quality standards — develop grading frameworks, evaluation rubrics, and golden-answer solutions for each task, used to train and calibrate an LLM-based grading system that evaluates AI outputs at scale.

This is a remote, project-based, individual-contributor role focused on analytical design and evaluation.

Skills & Requirements

  • 3+ years at McKinsey, BCG, Bain, Oliver Wyman, Roland Berger, Monitor Deloitte, EY-Parthenon, Kearney, or Strategy&
  • Strong structured problem-solving and hypothesis-driven thinking
  • Ability to translate vague problems into clear analytical steps and deliverables
  • High attention to logical consistency and output quality
  • Independent, self-directed working style
  • Clear written English (B2+)

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $60 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 25-30 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

jobs.excerpt: About Inchcape Shipping ServicesAt Inchcape, our vision is to have a connected world, in which our customers trade successfully and make better decisions in every port, everywhere.
jobs.description:
About Inchcape Shipping Services

At Inchcape, our vision is to have a connected world, in which our customers trade successfully and make better decisions in every port, everywhere. We use technology and our global network to help our partners connect to a smoother, smarter ocean.

Inchcape combines its worldwide infrastructure with local expertise through our global network of over 250 proprietary offices, across 70 countries and a team of more than 3,000 committed professionals. Our diverse global customer base includes owners and charterers in the oil, cruise, container, and bulk commodity sectors as well as naval, government and intergovernmental organizations.

We have an ambitious growth model and a career here is certainly going to be a rewarding one that will allow you to bring your skills & experience. We embrace change and are open to new thinking and pushing for positive change in our industry.

Note: This role is on a contract basis & the duration of contract will be 3-4 months .It can be extendable as per the business need.

Main Purpose of Job

The Senior Data Engineer designs, builds and maintains the data ingestion and transformation pipelines that populate Inchcape’s central data platforms. This role ingests raw data from diverse systems, curates the bronze and silver layers of the medallion architecture, ensures data quality and performance, and delivers reliable, reusable datasets for modelling, analysis, reporting and BI.

Key Accountabilities

  • Develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest data from ERP, CRM, operational, financial, and third‑party sources into the Microsoft Fabric Platform - Lakehouse (OneLake) using Delta Lake/Parquet.
  • Implement data quality standards and controls, incremental loading, CDC and error handling to ensure reliability and correctness.

Location: 100% Remote - anywhere in the Continental U.S.

About Us

Friends From The City is a design, research, and engineering company focused on public impact. Our mission is to make digital interactions with government simple, intuitive, and accessible. That means removing barriers like confusing user flows, inaccessible content, and language limitations that prevent people from getting what they need.

We build digital products using accessible design, rigorous research, and reliable code.


About the Role

The Solutions Architect / Technical Lead will provide hands-on technical leadership for the design, development, and modernization of complex public-interest digital services. This role is responsible for translating product, user, program, and regulatory needs into secure, scalable, and maintainable technical solutions spanning user-facing applications, APIs, data services, configurable workflows, integrations, and cloud infrastructure.

Working closely with product, design, engineering, security, and program teams, this person will establish architectural direction while remaining close enough to implementation to guide critical technical decisions, resolve complex challenges, and ensure solutions can evolve from prototype and alpha delivery into reliable production systems. Experience with health IT or similarly complex, regulated, data-intensive environments is important for success in this role.

Requirements

What you'll achieve:In this role, you will lead the technical architecture and delivery of modern public-interest digital services, with a focus on secure, accessible, configurable health and government systems. You will translate product and program requirements into scalable architecture, guide engineering implementation, and ensure prototypes and alpha solutions can mature into reliable production platforms.

You will:

  • Own solution architecture across front-end applications, APIs, data services, configuration platforms, and cloud infrastructure
  • Lead the evolution of configurable, rules-driven workflows rather than hardcoded application logic
  • Design and maintain versioned APIs, data models, configuration schemas, and integration boundaries
  • Guide development of branching, validation, workflow, content, and configuration-management capabilities
  • Ensure systems preserve historical/versioned behavior and support safe configuration change and release governance
  • Establish technical patterns for security, privacy, accessibility, observability, testing, and performance
  • Define integration approaches for existing government systems, identity services, content platforms, reference data, and external APIs
  • Review architecture and code, mentor engineers, and make pragmatic technical decisions that balance alpha delivery with long-term maintainability
  • Partner closely with product, design, research, security, data, and program teams
  • Support deployment, troubleshooting, technical documentation, and transition from prototype through production

Skills You’ll Need to Bring:We are looking for a senior technical leader who can move comfortably between architecture and hands-on implementation. The ideal candidate brings a mix of the following:

  • 7+ years of experience designing and developing production software systems, including technical leadership responsibilities
  • Strong experience designing RESTful APIs, service boundaries, and domain/data models
  • Strong experience with modern application architecture using technologies such as .NET/C#, Java, Node.js, Python, or comparable platforms
  • Experience with modern front-end architectures using React, TypeScript, or comparable frameworks
  • Experience designing relational data models and working with technologies such as PostgreSQL, SQL Server, SQLite, or similar databases
  • Demonstrated experience with configuration-driven systems, workflow engines, rules engines, dynamic forms, or other metadata-driven platforms
  • Experience designing versioning, immutable configuration, auditability, change governance, or similar approaches for systems where historical behavior must be preserved
  • Strong understanding of application security, privacy, authentication/authorization, API security, and secure software development practices
  • Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, observability, performance engineering, and production reliability
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear architecture decisions and communicate tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience leading engineers through incremental delivery while protecting long-term architectural integrity

Health IT / Domain Experience:
Health IT experience or equivalent experience with complex, regulated data systems is required.

  • Relevant experience may include:
    • Public health, health care, clinical, safety-surveillance, regulatory, or health-data systems
    • Electronic health records, clinical workflows, case reporting, surveillance systems, or health information exchange
    • Familiarity with standards such as FHIR, HL7, USCDI, terminology/reference-data services, or comparable structured-data standards
    • Experience working with highly sensitive, regulated, or mission-critical data where privacy, traceability, versioning, and data quality are essential
    • Equivalent experience in another regulated environment may be considered when the candidate can demonstrate comparable complexity, governance, and interoperability requirements

Nice To Haves:These are not required, but we would love to know if you have:

  • Experience delivering digital services for federal, state, local, or tribal government
  • Familiarity with USWDS, Section 508, WCAG, and accessible digital-service development
  • Experience with Azure, AWS, or comparable cloud platforms
  • Experience with infrastructure as code, containers, automated deployment, and DevSecOps
  • Experience integrating CMS platforms, identity providers, reference-data systems, or enterprise APIs
  • Familiarity with FHIR APIs, HL7 messaging, health terminology systems, or public-health interoperability
  • Experience with configurable form engines, content governance, rules authoring, or workflow-management platforms
  • Experience supporting government ATO, security assessment, privacy, or compliance activities
  • Experience leading modernization of legacy systems while maintaining continuity for existing users and data

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, health informatics, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience
  • Significant relevant experience designing and leading complex software systems
  • Health IT, public health technology, regulated-data, or equivalent domain experience required.

Benefits

This is a 1099 independent contractor position and is not eligible for employee benefits, including health insurance, paid time off, or employer-sponsored retirement benefits.

  1. Phone Interview
  2. Technical Interview
  3. Final Interview

jobs.description:
Director of Finance

Group Finance — Multi-Entity, Multi-Currency — Remote, Philippines

Reports to

Chief Financial Officer

Direct reports

Accounting Manager (Philippines), Senior Accountant (Philippines)

Works alongside

Canada-based Controller, staff accountant and AP clerk — who report separately to the Canada Controller

Entities in scope

Nine — three operating companies and six corporate/holding entities (Canada, United States, Barbados)

Location

Remote — Philippines (home-based)

Working hours

8:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time (approx. 9:00 p.m. – 6:00 a.m. PHT), Monday to Friday

Language

Fluent English — written and spoken (mandatory)

Engagement

Full-time, permanent, via Philippine Employer of Record or BPO partner

Status

Draft v4 — prepared 19 August 2026 — for CFO review before posting


Position Summary

The Director of Finance owns the group reporting layer across all nine entities — consolidation, intercompany, foreign-currency translation, technical accounting, forecasting and audit — so that the CFO can concentrate on capital, tax structure, transactions and executive matters. Day-to-day transaction processing is owned by a separate Canada-based team; your accountability is the accuracy, timeliness and defensibility of what is reported on top of it.

This is a build role, not a maintenance role. The Group’s reporting currently carries known open items — unreconciled intercompany balances across jurisdictions, a derived equity plug, no formal foreign-exchange policy, and inconsistent sign conventions between entity ledgers. You will be expected to close these out, put the supporting policies and controls in place, and hold them there.

You will manage a team of two — an Accounting Manager and a Senior Accountant — and are accountable for their output, their development and the quality of what reaches the CFO. With a team this size relative to nine entities, you will remain hands-on: expect to prepare as well as review. You report directly to the Chief Financial Officer.

Read this next paragraph carefully before applying. The Canada-based Controller owns the traditional accounting cycle and reports to the CFO, not to you. You nonetheless own the group close calendar, the reporting standards, the technical accounting positions and every deliverable that depends on that team’s output. This role therefore requires you to run a process across a team you do not manage, twelve time zones from your own, using clear service standards, documented handoffs and early escalation rather than hierarchy. Candidates who have only operated with direct line authority over everyone who feeds their numbers will find this role difficult.


The Group and the Scope of the Role

The Group comprises nine legal entities operating across Canada, the United States and Barbados. The successful candidate supports all nine:

  • Three operating companies — Family Focus (community health and support services), HavenPoint Health (clinic and independent medical examination operations) and Prolexity (professional services).

  • Six corporate, holding and investment entities — comprising Canadian, U.S. and Barbados holding companies, a management services company and an investment/rental holding entity.

The Group reports in Canadian dollars with material U.S. dollar and Barbados dollar activity, extensive intercompany and shareholder-loan balances, a shared-services cost pool allocated across entities, and a recurring group reporting package of eight standard schedules plus standalone entity packages that must agree to the consolidated result. This is a genuinely multi-entity, multi-currency, multi-jurisdiction environment. It is not a single-ledger bookkeeping job.

How the finance function is structured

Group finance operates as two teams reporting to the Chief Financial Officer:

  • A Canada-based team — Controller, staff accountant and accounts payable clerk — which owns the traditional accounting cycle: accounts payable and receivable, disbursements, payroll administration, general-ledger posting, and Canadian statutory compliance, through to an entity-level trial balance. The Controller reports directly to the CFO.

  • A Philippines-based team — Director of Finance, Accounting Manager and Senior Accountant — which owns everything built on top of those ledgers: group close and consolidation, intercompany reconciliation, foreign-currency translation, the shared-services allocation, group and entity reporting, budgeting and forecasting and technical accounting.

The two teams are interdependent. The Philippines team relies on the Canadian team for timely, accurate source data; the Canadian team relies on the Philippines team for the consolidation, reporting, analysis and technical accounting built on top of it. Working effectively across that boundary — across a twelve-hour time difference, and without a shared reporting line below the CFO — is a core requirement of every role on this team, not an incidental one.

The Philippines team holds full general-ledger access across all nine entities and the authority to post adjusting, reclassifying and consolidation entries. Ownership of the transaction cycle sits in Canada; responsibility for the accuracy of the reported result sits in the Philippines.

Key Responsibilities

Financial reporting and consolidation

  • Own the monthly close calendar across all nine entities and deliver a hard close within an agreed number of business days.

  • Own the consolidation, including intercompany eliminations, foreign-currency translation and the shared-services allocation, and be able to defend every material balance.

  • Own the recurring group reporting suite: the group month-end package; budget versus actual and cash-burn reporting; the 13-week cash forecast; trending statements by entity; payroll analysis; and the owner-draw and professional-fees analyses.

  • Ensure each standalone entity package agrees to the consolidated result without manual bridging, and that missing entities or missing source data are flagged explicitly on every reporting cycle rather than quietly estimated.

Intercompany, shareholder and balance-sheet integrity

  • Own the reconciliation of all intercompany due to/from accounts across the Canadian, U.S. and Barbados entities, including the resolution of legacy differences and sign-convention errors.

  • Maintain and substantiate shareholder loan accounts, owner draws and related-party balances, with a clear audit trail for each movement.

  • Drive equity to a substantiated position rather than a derived plug, and maintain a documented balance-sheet substantiation file for every entity.

Planning, forecasting and analysis

  • Own the annual budget process and the rolling forecast across all entities, including driver-based operating forecasts and the entity-level KPI models.

  • Own the 13-week cash forecast and the Group liquidity view, and escalate funding requirements to the CFO with lead time, not at the point of failure.

  • Deliver variance analysis with a stated cause and a recommended action, not a table of differences.

  • Track performance against the Group’s EBITDA-margin improvement targets by entity and report progress monthly.

Leadership

  • Manage, review and develop the Accounting Manager and the Senior Accountant; set objectives, run one-to-ones and manage performance directly.

  • Partner with the Canadian Controller as an equal on delivery. Where source data is late, incomplete or inconsistent, raise it early, in writing, with the specific impact on the close — and escalate to the CFO promptly rather than absorbing the delay and reporting late.

  • Review before the CFO reviews. Work that reaches the CFO should be finished work.

  • Deputise for the CFO on operational finance matters and in dealings with operating-company management.

Required Qualifications

  • Philippine CPA, or an equivalent professional designation (CPA, ACCA) in good standing.

  • Minimum ten years of progressive accounting and finance experience, including at least four years managing a team.

  • Demonstrated ownership of a multi-entity consolidation with intercompany eliminations and foreign-currency translation. This is the single most important screen for this role.

  • Direct experience reporting to or working alongside a CFO or Financial Controller in a North American reporting environment.

  • Demonstrated experience delivering to deadline in a split or distributed finance function, dependent on colleagues in another location or another reporting line. Be prepared to describe a specific example at interview.

  • Working knowledge of U.S. GAAP or Canadian ASPE/IFRS, and the confidence to research and take a position on a technical treatment.

  • Advanced Excel — complex model construction, large data sets, links across workbooks, and the discipline to build models that another person can audit.

  • Experience preparing audit workpapers and dealing directly with external auditors.

  • Fluent written and spoken English (C1 or above).

  • Demonstrated history of working a permanent U.S. Eastern Time schedule.

Preferred

  • Exposure to Canadian tax and payroll compliance (GST/HST, T2, source deductions) and/or U.S. and offshore structures.

  • Experience in healthcare, clinical, community-services or professional-services businesses.

  • QuickBooks Online at an administrator level across multiple company files; experience migrating or consolidating ledgers.

  • Prior experience in a company under financial pressure — tight cash, cost reduction, turnaround — rather than only in stable, well-resourced finance functions.

  • Experience building or leading an offshore finance team supporting a North American parent.

Performance Measures

First 90 days

  • Full close calendar and responsibility matrix documented and operating across all nine entities.

  • Written assessment delivered to the CFO of every open reconciling item, ranked by dollar value and audit risk, with a remediation plan and dates.

  • Month-end package delivered on the agreed date without CFO rework.

  • Intercompany balances agreed across all entity pairs, or every remaining difference formally quantified, explained and scheduled for resolution.

First 180 days

  • Foreign-exchange, intercompany and shared-services allocation policies drafted, approved and applied.

  • Written service standards between the Philippines and Canadian teams agreed with the Controller, in operation, and reported against monthly.

  • Close cycle reduced to the agreed target and sustained for three consecutive months.

  • Team performing at a standard where CFO review is confirmatory rather than corrective.

Working Conditions and Non-Negotiable Requirements

Language

  • Fluent written and spoken English is a hard requirement (CEFR C1 or equivalent). You will draft reporting commentary, correspond directly with external auditors, tax advisers and lawyers, and present analysis to the CFO and the CEO. Written English will be assessed during the interview process through a live written exercise.

Working hours

  • Core working hours are 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time, Monday to Friday — approximately 9:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. Philippine Standard Time.

  • This is a permanent night-shift role, not an occasional accommodation. Please only apply if you have worked this schedule before and can sustain it indefinitely.

  • Additional flexibility is required during month-end close, audit fieldwork and statutory deadlines.

  • Public holidays follow the Group’s North American calendar; Philippine holidays are taken as flexible days by arrangement.

Infrastructure

  • Reliable primary internet connection of at least 25 Mbps with a documented backup connection (secondary ISP or mobile data).

  • A backup power arrangement sufficient to complete a working shift, given the overnight schedule.

  • A quiet, private workspace suitable for calls involving confidential financial and personnel information.

Security and confidentiality

  • Group financial data is held in Group-controlled cloud systems. No local storage of Group financial records, payroll data or shareholder information on personal devices.

  • Two-factor authentication on all Group systems, full-disk encryption and current endpoint protection are mandatory.

  • Signed confidentiality and intellectual-property assignment terms are a condition of engagement. This role has visibility into executive compensation, shareholder loan activity and owner draws; discretion is not optional.

Engagement and Compensation

  • Full-time, permanent, home-based in the Philippines. Engagement will be through an established Philippine Employer of Record or BPO partner; the provider will be confirmed before an offer is issued.

  • Compensation is quoted and paid in U.S. dollars.

  • Statutory entitlements apply, including 13th-month pay and the night-shift differential for hours worked between 9:00 p.m. and 6:00 a.m.

  • Annual performance review with a discretionary performance component tied to the measures set out above.


The Group is an equal opportunity employer. Candidates are assessed on demonstrated capability against the requirements above.

How to Apply

Submit a CV in English together with a short covering note (maximum one page) addressing three points: (1) the most complex multi-entity or multi-currency close you have personally been responsible for; (2) a control or process weakness you identified and fixed, and what it was worth; and (3) confirmation that you have previously worked a permanent U.S. Eastern Time night shift and can sustain it.

Shortlisted candidates will complete a timed practical exercise in Excel and a live written-English task. Final-stage candidates will be asked to review a set of draft entity financials and present findings verbally to the CFO.

jobs.description:
About the Team

The Solutions & Growth team is helping build the next chapter of DCS. We partner with new and existing clients to solve complex distribution and fulfillment challenges through thoughtful engineering, automation, software, and long-term relationships.DCS is investing significantly in its Distribution & Fulfillment business, and the people joining this team will have a meaningful opportunity to shape how we grow, how we go to market, and how we serve customers as the business scales.

About the Role

As a Senior Account Executive, you’ll build strategic customer relationships that create meaningful, long-term growth for both our clients and DCS.There’s significant opportunity to grow within the Distribution & Fulfillment market. We’re looking for someone who understands material handling and automation, knows how to develop relationships and uncover opportunities, and can help customers navigate complex decisions from early conversations through implementation and beyond.

Our approach is consultative and highly collaborative. You’ll partner closely with Solutions, Operations, and Pre-Contract teams to understand customer needs, shape the right solution, and pursue opportunities where we believe DCS can deliver real value and win.You’ll stay connected throughout the customer journey, serving as a trusted partner while bringing the right people across DCS together to deliver on what we promise.

In This Role, You Will

  • Build and grow a portfolio of strategic Distribution & Fulfillment accounts across industries such as retail, apparel, footwear, consumer goods, industrial, and other emerging markets.
  • Identify and develop new opportunities through your network, targeted prospecting, industry knowledge, and partnership with DCS business development and marketing teams.
  • Create account and territory strategies that turn relationships and market intelligence into a healthy, sustainable pipeline.
  • Lead complex sales opportunities from initial engagement through solution development, commercial negotiations, contract execution, and long-term account growth.
  • Partner closely with Solutions, Operations, Consulting, and Pre-Contract teams to ensure DCS is pursuing the right opportunities and delivering solutions that work for both the customer and the business.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior and executive-level customer stakeholders and serve as an ongoing executive sponsor for key accounts.
  • Own commercial conversations including MSAs, LOIs, SOWs, support agreements, pricing strategy, forecasting, and deal progression.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline and forecasting information and provide clear visibility into account strategy, opportunities, risks, and next steps.
  • Help shape how DCS goes to market by contributing to sales processes, account strategy, collateral, partnerships, and broader growth initiatives.
  • Represent DCS in the market through customer relationships, industry events, professional networks, and other opportunities to strengthen our brand and credibility.

We’re Excited About You Because You

  • Bring 5-10+ years of successful sales experience in material handling, warehouse automation, systems integration, operations consulting, or a related industry.
  • Demonstrate a track record of identifying, developing, and closing large, complex enterprise opportunities.
  • Know how to sell an integrated solution, not simply a product, and connect the value of engineering, consulting, software, automation, and implementation services.
  • Navigate long, complex capital sales cycles while building relationships well before a formal RFP begins.
  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline that translates into meaningful annual bookings and revenue.
  • Leverage an established industry network while continuing to develop new relationships and opportunities.
  • Build credibility with customer executives while partnering effectively with engineering, Solutions, Operations, and delivery teams.
  • Bring a self-starter mindset; building a plan, creating momentum, and taking ownership of results.
  • Balance commercial drive with a collaborative, humble approach that fits a team-based sales environment.
  • Look beyond the individual sale, contributing to how we grow the business, strengthen our sales approach, and build the future of DCS.

Why DCS

DCS is at an exciting point in its Distribution & Fulfillment growth journey. The foundation is in place; strong engineering and delivery capabilities, an expanding software suite, established customer relationships, and significant leadership investment in the business.

For the right Senior Account Executive, that creates meaningful whitespace. You’ll have the ability to help shape your territory and account strategy, work across a broad set of technologies and solutions, and have an outsized impact on a business that is positioned for significant growth.

If you’re looking for an opportunity where you can hunt, build, influence, and grow, not simply inherit a number, we’d like to talk.

Conveyor may be in our name, but it’s only part of what we do. DCS was founded in 1982 and has grown to serve major clients in multiple industries by providing material handling, full-scale warehouse operations and conveyor design solutions that are custom crafted for their need. We don’t sell ready-made systems - we build relationships that empower us to craft custom solutions together. It’s the teamwork approach, sharing ideas and building upon them, that produces the best results.   

And DCS is committed to creating an extraordinary employment experience for our team. We work like crazy to hire and develop great people, build relationships, and ensure that the programs and services we offer our team are among the best in the business- from a killer snack wall and casual work environment to flexible PTO and opportunities to give back within the community.

More reasons to join our team:   

  • We pride ourselves in our family-like culture and casual, but focused, work environment   
  • We offer competitive salaries and health benefits   
  • Our 401K program includes a 100% match up to 5%

  • We offer our employees flexibility and autonomy   
  • We do community outreach projects throughout the year   
  • We know how to throw company events   
  • We work hard, but we also know how to have fun - darts, anyone?

jobs.description:
Remote, United States

Role Overview 🚀

At Uncapped, we help ambitious founders realise their dreams. Our Ecommerce Partnerships Manager owns a portfolio of high value referral and broker relationships across the e-commerce and agency ecosystem. This isn't a maintenance role: you source and close new partners, negotiate terms and co-selling arrangements, and find the growth opportunities inside your portfolio rather than waiting for them to be assigned to you.

Partnerships are a key growth driver for Uncapped. This is a high impact, high autonomy role at one of the fastest growing fintechs in revenue based funding.

About Uncapped 👫

Founded in 2019, Uncapped is a fintech company focused on providing working capital to SMEs in North America and Europe.

We leverage multiple data sources to make credit decisions faster, safer and more conveniently. We are working with the largest platforms in the world, including Amazon and Walmart, and strive to be the best alternative-lender globally.

What Success Looks Like

    • A portfolio of active, high value referral and broker partners consistently generating qualified, partner sourced origination
    • Partnerships that don't just run but grow, because you've spotted an angle nobody assigned you
    • Clear, scalable operating workflows across sourcing, enablement, reporting and reviews
    • You take a partnership goal and find the path yourself, pulling in Sales and Ops as needed rather than waiting to be told how

What you will do ✍️

Sourcing & Closing

  • Identify, engage and recruit new referral and broker partners across the e-commerce ecosystem — agencies, advisors and referral networks — aligned to Uncapped's growth strategy
  • Run partner discovery, qualification and prioritisation across inbound and outbound channels
  • Negotiate partner agreements, commercial terms, incentives and co-selling arrangements, and hold your own in the room with senior partner counterparts
  • Onboard and operationalise each partnership through enablement, structured processes and clear launch plans

Portfolio Ownership & Growth

  • Own your portfolio of referral and broker relationships end to end, from first conversation to ongoing performance management
  • Drive regular business reviews focused on targets, impact and revenue contribution
  • Proactively mine existing partnerships for growth that wasn't in the original deal — new segments, new referral sources — rather than waiting for it to be assigned
  • Manage smooth lead routing and feedback loops with the Sales team to ensure post-handoff follow through

Analytics & Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Define and track partner KPIs, including pipeline, conversion rates and lead quality
  • Own data hygiene and pipeline forecasting within the CRM
  • Conduct ROI analysis on partner initiatives to optimise performance and incentive structures
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing and Ops to build repeatable, friction-free partner workflows, and bring them along when a partnership needs a coordinated push

Requirements

Who you are 👀

  • 4+ years of experience in partnerships, business development or channel management, with a track record of owning outcomes, not just relationships
  • At least part of that experience is in fintech, lending or payments — direct exposure to e-commerce or online consumer brands (as an operator, agency partner, or platform) strongly preferred
  • Proven ability to source, close and operate broker and referral partnerships end to end — you don't hand off the hard parts
  • Commercially sharp: you understand how a deal makes money for both sides and can negotiate terms that hold up
  • Self directed: given a partnership goal, you find the path yourself and know when to pull in Sales or Ops
  • Comfortable with data and analytics, and you use it to prioritise, forecast and make the case for where to invest your time
  • Direct, intentional communicator, comfortable managing remote workflows out in the open
  • Working knowledge of a CRM such as HubSpot, Pipedrive or Salesforce
  • Strong grasp of Microsoft applications (Excel, PowerPoint & Word) and/or G Suite
  • Excellent organisation and multi-tasking skills, with acute attention to detail

Benefits

What we offer 🎁

At Uncapped, our people make us successful. We are a start-up with big goals, and we work hard, so we want to give everyone the benefits they really want. We are continually adding to this list as new people join -- here are some of the things you can expect:

  • Unlimited holiday: we believe that well-rested and happy people make the best employees
  • Competitive compensation plan
  • Personal growth fund: Raise your game from great to spectacular
  • Monthly recognition and awards: Celebrate wins big and small
  • The opportunity to make a big impact every day on the lives of European and US entrepreneurs.
  • Optional workspaces in Warsaw, London and Atlanta

We can only consider applications from candidates eligible to work in the USA without requiring visa sponsorship.

jobs.excerpt: Role DescriptionZoetis Reference Laboratories seeks a full-time Veterinary Molecular Diagnostics Lead to own the development, validation, implementation, and lifecycle management of multiplex real-time PCR (qPCR/RT PCR) panels for detecting infectious agents in animal specimens.
jobs.description:
Role Description

Zoetis Reference Laboratories seeks a full-time Veterinary Molecular Diagnostics Lead to own the development, validation, implementation, and lifecycle management of multiplex real-time PCR (qPCR/RT PCR) panels for detecting infectious agents in animal specimens. The role blends veterinary diagnostic expertise with advanced molecular methods to deliver accurate, clinically meaningful results. Focus areas include continuous assay improvement, workflow efficiency, and quality/compliance. The position will report to the Head of Microbiology and Infectious Disease Testing and will partner closely with veterinary specialists, lab operations, quality, bench teams, and commercial stakeholders in a high throughput, quality driven, and collaborative environment.

We value positive, adaptable leaders who support the veterinary community and thrive in a dynamic, cross functional setting. Zoetis is a values-driven organization.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design, optimize, validate/verify, and implement multiplex PCR panels (including primer/probe design, assay optimization, and acceptance criteria).
    • Execute and document validations/verifications and appropriately document and report study results.
    • Lead/support SOP, policy, and data reporting development in conjunction with the ZRL Quality Management System and other stakeholder groups.
    • Annually review primer/probe targets (in silico and/or empirical) and assess new reagents/controls; lead updates and supply changes as needed.
    • Implement QC program and QC monitoring. Responsible for QC trending and reporting of data; escalate issues promptly.
    • Lead or support, as applicable, investigations of nonconformances, root cause, CAPA, and effectiveness checks.
    • Troubleshoot assay and performance issues using data-driven approaches.
    • Oversee technician review of PCR data to ensure accurate reporting.
    • Consult with internal teams and veterinary customers on complex results and case workup. Internal teams may include ZRL Medical and Operational teams, as well as Commercial teams.
    • Provide scientific leadership, mentorship, and support training initiatives for bench colleagues.
    • Collaborate with operations on efficiency and budget stewardship.
    • Contribute to equipment readiness and reagent inventory planning as applicable.
    • Support safe work practices and biosafety compliance (BSL-2).
    • Stay current on veterinary diagnostics, emerging pathogens, and new methods and technology.
    • Support validation/training for new equipment or processes (e.g., liquid handling implementation).
    • When required, support technology or assay transfer from R&D to ZRL operations.
    • As required, support of other lab sections (e.g. Serology or Bacteriology sections).

QUALIFICATIONS

  • MS required; PhD preferred in Molecular Biology, Microbiology, Biochemistry, Veterinary/Animal Health sciences, or related field (or equivalent combination of education and experience).
    • 10+ years in veterinary molecular diagnostics or closely related diagnostic/IVD environment. Veterinary microbiology and/or molecular laboratory experience is essential.
    • 10+ years of hands-on experience developing and validating real-time PCR (qPCR/RT PCR) and multiplex assays.
    • 10+ years of experience with Sanger sequencing, BLAST analysis and primer design required.
    • 10+ years of experience with proficiency testing as a competency tool.
    • 10+ years of experience with utilization of a quality system for molecular diagnostics. Experience preferred with AAVLD or ISO 17025 accreditation. Candidate must provide evidence of quality system adherence.
    • Experience with next generation sequencing (NGS) is a plus.
    • Bioinformatics experience (sequence analysis, primer/probe design, strain surveillance) is a plus.
    • 5+ years of hands-on experience verifying or validating diagnostic serological assays is a plus.
    • Experience with NALHN-sanctioned disease testing is a plus.

KNOWLEDGE AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Expertise in DNA/RNA extraction (manual/automated), PCR (conventional and real time) setup, environmental contamination control, liquid handling and automation techniques and equipment and troubleshooting.
    • Demonstrated success in high-throughput testing environments and with automation platforms.
    • Working knowledge of laboratory information system (LIS), documentation practices, and regulated/quality environments.
    • Proficient with primer design and genomics tools (e.g., CLC Workbench or equivalent).
    • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills; ability to lead cross-functionally.
    • Proficient in Excel or related software for control charting purposes and data analysis

PHYSICAL POSITION REQUIREMENTS

  • This position is remote, but periodic travel is required
    • Able to work hours on a computer and tolerate computer screens, including video conferencing
    • Able to physically tolerate laboratory bench work related to assay validation and training.
    • Ability to effectively conduct phone calls and communicate in person.
    • Occasional required movements may include bending, kneeling, and crouching.
    • May be required to lift, move, carry up to 25 lbs.

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is 114,000 - 175,000. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the base pay target range for new hire salaries for the position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Shift

Based on project needs, your schedule, or these duties, may change as necessary. It is important to emphasize that your new role as a QA Specialist requires you to be completely engaged with agents during monitoring and coaching sessions. As a QA Specialist you will also be responsible to send up any calls that require immediate corrective action to the QA Supervisor as well as the appropriate Manager and Shift Supervisor. Taking ownership of performance metrics:

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT NYMBUSNymbus ( is not just a leader in fintech; we are a community of innovators passionate about reimagining banking.
jobs.description:
ABOUT NYMBUS

Nymbus ( is not just a leader in fintech; we are a community of innovators passionate about reimagining banking. Our modern core platform and cloud based technology serve as the backbone for financial institutions eager to modernize and excel.

Nymbus is building the next generation of fintech platforms, and Domain SVPs are among the most consequential leadership roles in delivering that vision. This role owns the Core Banking domain: the foundational system layer that processes every financial transaction, maintains every account balance, and enforces every posting rule across the platform.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

We are a remote-first company, with occasional travel required for team collaboration or client engagement.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The SVP, Product Management, Core Banking role is the senior product leader responsible for the strategic direction, squad output, and commercial outcomes of the Core Banking domain at Nymbus.

You lead multiple squads that build and evolve the core banking engine — deposits, lending, account structures, posting models, settlement, interest accrual, and the fundamental ledger infrastructure that every other domain depends on. You manage Builders directly, collaborate daily with Architects and Shippers assigned to your domain, and are accountable for everything your domain ships.

This is not a traditional product management role. You operate with four capabilities simultaneously: strategic product leadership, people leadership of Builders, domain subject matter expertise, and AI-first execution. You are expected to be a hands-on SME in core banking systems — someone who has designed, built, or deeply operated core banking platforms and can guide your teams through the complexity of core banking, from operations, finance, teller, to products, entitlements, GL and reconciliations.

You should be equally comfortable discussing market strategy with an executive team, walking through an application funnel with a client, diagnosing friction in an onboarding workflow, and working with product and engineering teams to determine what needs to change.

THE OPERATING MODELYou operate within Nymbus' AI-native solution operating model:

  • SVP, Product Management, Core Banking (This Role): Owns the domain's strategic direction, manages Builders, drives commercial outcomes, and ensures squad output meets quality and velocity standards. You are the most senior product voice in your domain.
  • Builders (Your Direct Reports): Own product intent, specification, and implementation within each squad. You hire, develop, and performance-manage Builders. You set their priorities, remove their blockers, and ensure they operate at the AI-first standard Nymbus requires.
  • Architects (Collaboration Partners): Report through the Architecture organization but collaborate with you daily. They own system design, technical integrity, and cross-squad consistency within your domain. You coordinate with them on data models, posting engines, and platform integrity.
  • Shippers (Collaboration Partners): Report through the Product Operations organization but collaborate with you daily. They own delivery quality, release management, and operational readiness. You coordinate with them on acceptance criteria, deployment cadence, and production stability.

YOUR DOMAIN: CORE BANKING

The Core Banking domain encompasses the foundational transaction processing, account management, and ledger infrastructure that every other domain at Nymbus depends on. Current and planned squads include:

  • Deposits: Core deposit product engine — account structures, sub-ledgers, posting models (memo posting, hard posting, reversals, adjustments), interest accrual, fee calculation, tiering, minimum balances, and product configuration.
  • Lending: Loan servicing lifecycle — consumer, commercial, real estate, construction, and lines of credit. Payment application logic, accrual and capitalization, payoff calculations, late fees, escrow, suspense handling, and servicing exception workflows (reversals, corrections, extensions, deferments, modifications, charge-offs).
  • Settlement & Processing: End-of-day batch processing, settlement windows, cutover logic, posting order dependencies, and downstream system propagation. The engine that ensures balances reconcile and financial reporting is accurate.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES:

Strategic Product Leadership

  • Owns and executes on the product roadmap for the Core Banking domain
  • Define the vision for how Nymbus builds a modern, configurable, multi-tenant core banking engine
  • Prioritize squad work against business outcomes, client needs, and platform strategy
  • Represent the domain in executive planning, client conversations, and board-level updates
  • Drive commercial outcomes — your domain's reliability and capability directly impacts every client relationship

People Leadership (Builder Management)

  • Hire, develop, and performance-manage all Builders in the Core Banking domain
  • Set clear expectations for AI-first execution, specification quality, and delivery velocity
  • Coach Builders on domain expertise — particularly the nuances of ledger integrity, posting models, and regulatory constraints
  • Build a team culture of precision, ownership, and continuous improvement
  • Ensure Builders operate at the Nymbus hiring bar and AI fluency standard

Domain Subject Matter Expertise

  • Serve as the authoritative SME for core banking within Nymbus
  • Design and reason about account hierarchies, sub-ledgers, and posting models including memo posting, hard posting, reversals, and adjustments
  • Understand batch processing, end-of-day settlement, and cutover windows including how posting order and timing affect balances and downstream systems
  • Define product configuration logic for deposit products (fees, interest accrual, minimum balances, tiering, exceptions)
  • Model core-to-digital integration patterns including event propagation, synchronization delays, and reconciliation strategies
  • Address data integrity, auditability, and operational controls required for regulatory and financial reporting
  • Guide teams through loan servicing complexity — payment application logic, accrual calculations, payoff quotes, per-diem interest, and exception workflows
  • Understand regulatory frameworks deeply: Reg D, Reg CC, Reg DD, Reg Z, TILA, RESPA, and their operational implications on core system behavior
  • Navigate the tension between multi-tenant configurability and system correctness — every institution has different product configurations, but the ledger must always balance

AI Execution

  • Model AI-first working practices for the domain — use Kiro, Claude, and spec-driven development personally
  • Set the standard for how Builders in your domain leverage AI tools
  • Ensure specifications for core banking logic are precise, testable, and take full advantage of AI-augmented workflows
  • Drive continuous improvement in squad velocity through AI-native methodology
  • Evaluate and adopt new AI tools and practices that accelerate domain output
  • Recognize that core banking demands exceptional specification precision — AI tools must enhance, not shortcut, correctness

Cross-Domain Coordination

  • Coordinate with other Domain Owners on integration surfaces — Digital Banking, Payments, and Origination all depend on Core
  • Own the contract between Core and its consumers — define how other domains interact with the ledger, accounts, and posting engine
  • Partner with the Architecture Spine on platform-wide patterns that affect Core Banking
  • Collaborate with COEs (UX, QA, Security) on standards compliance
  • Align with Cloud and Infrastructure on performance, scalability, and batch processing requirements

QUALIFICATIONS:Non-Negotiables:

  • Technical product management leadership experience
  • Banking processes and product experience required.
  • Experience at product or Fintech organizations

AI-First Mindset

  • Active, hands-on experience with AI-assisted product design and development workflows
  • Demonstrated use of AI tools for specification, iteration, and problem-solving
  • Willingness to model AI-first practices for the entire domain
  • Comfort operating in a spec-first, AI-native development methodology
  • Understanding that AI-first does not mean lower precision — core banking demands both speed and correctness

Core Banking Expertise (Required)

  • 8+ years in product, engineering, or technical leadership roles in core banking or financial services infrastructure
  • Deep hands-on experience with core banking platforms — you have built, operated, or led teams building core systems (deposits, lending, or both)
  • Expert-level understanding of ledger structures, posting models, and double-entry accounting as implemented in bank systems
  • Experience with loan servicing systems — lifecycle management, payment application, accrual, and exception handling
  • Understanding of batch processing, settlement, and end-of-day reconciliation at operational depth
  • Experience with multi-tenant core banking platforms serving multiple financial institutions
  • Knowledge of regulatory frameworks affecting core operations (Reg D, Reg CC, Reg DD, Reg Z, TILA, RESPA, BSA/AML)
  • Experience navigating the tradeoffs between configurability, correctness, and performance in core systems

Leadership & Management

  • Experience managing and developing product builders, engineers, or technical product managers
  • Track record of building high-performing teams that ship working software in high-stakes, correctness-critical domains
  • Ability to operate at strategic and tactical levels simultaneously — roadmap one day, posting model specification review the next
  • Experience making priority tradeoffs across competing demands with incomplete information
  • Comfort with direct accountability for commercial outcomes tied to platform reliability and capability

Technical Fluency

  • Strong understanding of database design, transaction processing, and distributed systems
  • Deep familiarity with ledger architecture, ACID compliance, and data consistency patterns
  • Ability to engage deeply in technical design discussions with Architects on posting engines, batch processing, and integration contracts
  • Experience with modern development workflows, CI/CD, and deployment practices for mission-critical systems
  • Understanding of performance engineering for high-volume transaction processing

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS AT NYMBUS

The Core Banking domain is the foundation everything else sits on. Every digital interaction, every payment, every loan — they all resolve to a posting in the core.

The SVP, Product Management, Core Banking owns the most consequential infrastructure in fintech: the system of record for money. You are building a modern, AI-enabled, multi-tenant core that community financial institutions can trust with every dollar their customers deposit, borrow, and move. This role demands both the strategic vision to modernize core banking and the operational depth to ensure every penny reconciles.

BENEFITS:Annual Cash Bonus and Equity Options commensurate with the role level and experience

100% Remote

401(k) plan

Insurance - Health, Dental and Vision
Paid Time Off

OUR HIRING COMMITMENTS As an AI-first company, we embrace leveraging the power of AI tools throughout our hiring process. Nymbus remains committed to the importance of finding the right match for our teams and candidates alike. While we are excited about the AI tools at our disposal today, including the use of AI Video Interview tools, we remain committed to the human touch and oversight throughout the process.

Nymbus is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Nymbus is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and interview process, including accommodations related to our use of AI tools. If you require an accommodation, please notify your recruiter.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the country in which the role is based- this role is currently based in the US. Not all locations are available for consideration. Locations will be considered on a case by case basis.

In compliance with applicable pay transparency laws, this posting includes the anticipated base salary range, a general description of available benefits, and the application deadline where required. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, and location.

Job Overview
VRChat is known as one of the most vibrant social hangout immersive destinations — a place where people gather around shared interests, build communities, host events, and create entirely new worlds and experiences together. With over 250,000 user-created worlds and growing, the platform powers concerts, meetups, performances, niche communities, and creator-run businesses across VR, desktop, and mobile. People connect across time zones and cultures, and entire communities organize their social lives inside VRChat. It’s a live, global creator ecosystem with meaningful scale and long-term momentum.
We have built a team of experienced engineers and product leaders from companies such as Netflix, Meta, Microsoft, Roblox, Google, Amazon, Unity, Spotify, Discord, Twitch, and others. Backed by $100M from Makers Fund, Anthos Capital, and HTC, we’re investing in durable platform infrastructure — including the economic systems that support creators and end-users worldwide.
About the Economy Team
The Economy team designs and operates the systems that power creator monetization and platform-wide transactions. Our work ensures creators can reliably earn income while the platform remains stable, sustainable, and built for long-term growth.
Our team operates with high velocity and high impact—without sacrificing work-life integration. We value technical excellence, mutual respect, and solving hard problems together.
What We're Looking For
We’re looking for a Senior / Staff Backend Engineer (API) – Economy to join our Economy team. You will play a foundational role in architecting and evolving the systems that power how creators earn and how users transact across VRChat globally.
This role focuses on building high-integrity backend infrastructure that supports subscriptions, digital ownership, creator monetization, payment processing, and economic analytics at global scale. You’ll work primarily with Node.js and TypeScript, designing systems where correctness, auditability, reliability, and compliance are non-negotiable.
If you’re excited about building financial-grade systems for a thriving global creator ecosystem, this role could be the perfect fit.
