As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:

CrowdStrike is looking for a Salesforce Business Systems Analyst to join our Go-to-Market Applications team, where the systems we build directly power how CrowdStrike sells, partners, and grows. Our team designs, builds, and ships the capabilities that let Sales and Channel pitch new products, enter new markets, deepen partner relationships, and adopt new selling motions — from self-service eCommerce to complex, multi-year enterprise deals.

In this role, you'll be the liaison between our business partners and our engineering teams. You'll develop a deep understanding of our quote, order, and revenue processes, then translate that understanding into scalable solutions across Salesforce CPQ, Revenue Cloud, and the broader Lead-to-Cash ecosystem. You'll act as a strategic consultant, constructively challenging requests, proposing better alternatives, and using AI to move from idea to production faster than traditional delivery models allow.

This role is part of a globally distributed team. You'll partner daily with engineers, QA, and analysts across US and offshore locations, and with stakeholders in multiple regions — so comfort operating asynchronously, documenting clearly, and flexing occasionally for early or late calls is essential to how we work.

Your mission is simple: make it easier to do business at CrowdStrike.

Requested in lieu of a cover letter:

Tell us about one project where your analysis changed the outcome. Start with a short intro paragraph describing the business problem and why it was hard, then give us no more than 10 bullet points of specific actions you took that led to the result. If AI played a role in how you got there, we want to hear about it.

What You'll Do:

  • Partner with stakeholders across Sales, Channel, Professional Services, Finance, and Revenue Operations to lead requirements-gathering sessions, prioritize competing requests, and set pragmatic expectations.

  • Own functional deliverables end to end: process definition, requirements, fit/gap analysis, functional design, test planning and execution, training, and post-launch support.

  • Drive the pre-research phase independently — analyze data, validate assumptions, and identify trends without relying on developers to do your discovery for you.

  • Assess systemic impact of every change across the Quote-to-Cash ecosystem, including downstream effects on provisioning, entitlements, billing, and reporting.

  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate the delivery lifecycle — drafting requirements and user stories, generating functional designs and test cases, building proof of concepts and accelerators, and analyzing data to inform recommendations.

  • Apply AI-powered capabilities within the Salesforce platform (e.g., Agentforce, Einstein) to design experiences that reduce manual effort for sellers and partners.

  • Independently facilitate sprint planning, standups, retrospectives, backlog grooming, and cross-functional design sessions following Agile best practices.

  • Create and maintain process documentation, functional and architectural design artifacts, and Salesforce configuration best practices.

  • Help shape the custom-versus-configuration conversation, advocating for scalable, upgrade-safe solutions over one-off workarounds.

  • Stay ahead of Salesforce release cycles and industry practices, proactively bringing new capabilities to the business before they ask for them.

  • Build a fanatical focus on the seller and partner experience into everything you deliver.

What You'll Need:

  • 5+ years implementing, configuring, and supporting SaaS business systems at a software company, including at least 2 years hands-on with Salesforce CPQ or Revenue Cloud or any other CPQ application.

  • Working knowledge of the Lead-to-Cash / Quote-to-Cash lifecycle — products and price books, quoting and approvals, amendments and renewals, orders, and the handoff to billing.

  • Demonstrated use of AI tools to improve your own throughput and decision-making, with specific examples of where it changed your output or timeline.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize ambiguous input into clear requirements and evaluate trade-offs across options.

  • Comfort working directly with data — building reports and dashboards, running queries or extracts, and using data to support a recommendation.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to and influencing senior leadership.

  • Solid understanding of the Salesforce platform, its ecosystem, and its declarative capabilities (Flow, validation rules, security model, sharing).

  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

  • Detail-oriented, organized, self-motivated, and a genuine team player who thrives in a fast-moving environment.

  • Bachelor's degree (technical degree preferred) or equivalent practical experience.

Bonus Points:

  • Salesforce Revenue Cloud Advanced (RCA) project delivery experience.

  • Salesforce certifications: Administrator, Advanced Administrator, CPQ Specialist, Revenue Cloud, or Business Analyst.

  • Experience with partner/channel commerce, distributor and reseller models, or marketplace and eCommerce selling motions.

  • Familiarity with adjacent Quote-to-Cash tooling (billing systems, CLM, tax, ERP integrations).

  • Ability to read Apex, SOQL, or LWC well enough to collaborate credibly with developers and troubleshoot independently.

  • Consulting background, including Big 4.

  • Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs

  • Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge

Welcome to Centr - The Home of Strength

Centr is a globally recognized wellness platform founded by Chris Hemsworth in 2019. Through fitness, food and mindfulness, we provide the tools for people to live their strongest life. As the official equipment partner of HYROX, we're proud to bring that strength beyond the app — powering athletes at the world's fastest-growing fitness race.

Headquartered in Los Angeles, California, we are a passionate team of content creators, strategists, engineers, designers, marketers, and brand builders who bring the Centr lifestyle to life every day. At Centr, our core values include respect, transparency, accountability, and collaboration. We are proud of who we are and what we do. We don't just accept individuality; we encourage it and acknowledge the value diversity and inclusivity brings to our team.

About the Role

Centr is seeking an experienced and commercially driven Global Academic Market Manager to lead the growth of the Centr fitness brand across the global education market. This role will be responsible for developing sales within K–12 schools, colleges, universities, campus recreation departments, athletic programs, academic fitness centers, and related educational institutions.

The Global Academic Market Manager will work through a combination of direct sales, dealer partnerships and distributors for Centr’s presence within academic facilities worldwide. The successful candidate will develop a clear global channel strategy, build relationships with key education decision-makers, support complex project opportunities, and provide dealer partners with the tools and expertise needed to successfully position Centr products and solutions.

What You'll Do

Global Academic Market Strategy

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive global sales strategy for the K–12 and higher education markets.
  • Establish market priorities, revenue targets, account segmentation, and growth plans by region.
  • Identify high-potential institutions, school systems, universities, athletic departments, campus recreation programs, and educational networks.
  • Build a repeatable sales model that can be executed directly and through Centr’s global dealer and distributor network.
  • Position Centr as a preferred fitness equipment and training solutions provider within the academic market.

Direct Sales and Key Account Development

  • Build and manage relationships with key decision-makers, including:
    • Athletic directors
    • Strength and conditioning coaches
    • Campus recreation leaders
    • Physical education departments
    • Facilities and procurement teams
    • School administrators
    • University wellness leaders
    • Architects, designers, and fitness consultants
  • Lead direct sales efforts for strategic academic accounts and large-scale projects.
  • Develop multi-year relationships with school districts, university systems, athletic conferences, and institutional purchasing organizations.
  • Conduct presentations, needs assessments, product demonstrations, and facility planning discussions.
  • Manage opportunities from initial qualification through proposal, negotiation, purchase order, installation, and post-sale follow-up.

Dealer and Distributor Partnership

  • Work closely with Centr’s dealer and distributor partners to identify, pursue, and close academic market opportunities.
  • Train dealer sales teams on the academic market, Centr’s value proposition, product portfolio, and institutional selling strategies.
  • Support dealers with account planning, presentations, product selection, facility layouts, bids, proposals, and project specifications.
  • Establish clear rules of engagement for direct, dealer-supported, and distributor-led academic opportunities.
  • Evaluate dealer capabilities by market and identify geographic areas requiring additional coverage or support.
  • Conduct regular pipeline reviews with regional sales teams, dealers, and distributors.

Business Development and Market Expansion

  • Develop new business across K–12 schools, private schools, colleges, universities, community colleges, vocational institutions, and campus recreation facilities.
  • Identify opportunities within:
    • Physical education programs
    • Student recreation centers
    • Collegiate athletics
    • Strength and conditioning facilities
    • Sports performance centers
    • Faculty and staff wellness facilities
    • Student housing and residential fitness
    • Medical wellness and kinesiology programs
    • Research and human performance laboratories
  • Build relationships with academic associations, athletic organizations, purchasing cooperatives, and industry groups.
  • Identify bid opportunities, capital projects, new construction, renovations, and replacement cycles.
  • Develop strategies for gaining inclusion in institutional specifications, approved vendor programs, and purchasing contracts.

Product and Solution Positioning

  • Position Centr’s strength, cardio, functional fitness, performance training, and Centr x HYROX product offerings according to the needs of each institution.
  • Partner with customers to develop equipment packages based on facility size, user population, programming goals, budget, and training requirements.
  • Promote integrated solutions that may include equipment, education, programming, digital content, and training support.
  • Provide product and market feedback to internal teams to support future product development for academic customers.
  • Ensure Centr’s products are presented consistently and professionally across direct and dealer-led sales opportunities.

Training and Education

  • Develop and deliver sales training for dealer partners, distributors, internal sales teams, and academic customers.
  • Assist in creating market-specific sales tools, presentations, case studies, proposal templates, and educational materials.
  • Educate partners and customers on product features, benefits, applications, and competitive differentiation.
  • Support product launches and the introduction of new Centr solutions into the academic market.
  • Conduct webinars, regional training sessions, customer demonstrations, and in-person educational events.

Project and Pipeline Management

  • Build and maintain a global academic sales pipeline with clear visibility into project value, timing, probability, and next steps within Salesforce.
  • Maintain accurate account, opportunity, and activity information within Salesforce.
  • Develop forecasts and provide regular updates on revenue, pipeline health, dealer engagement, and major project opportunities.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to support pricing, product availability, freight, installation, service, and project execution.
  • Ensure major projects are properly registered, qualified, and managed throughout the sales process.
  • Track project outcomes and identify lessons that can improve future sales effectiveness.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Global Sales, Product, Marketing, Operations, Finance, Customer Service, Logistics, and Service teams.
  • Work with Marketing to develop academic market campaigns, content, case studies, digital assets, and lead-generation initiatives.
  • Coordinate with Product teams to communicate institutional requirements, product gaps, and emerging market needs.
  • Partner with Operations and Logistics to support complex global projects, delivery requirements, and installation timelines.
  • Work with regional leaders to align academic market priorities with broader commercial sales strategies.

Market Intelligence and Reporting

  • Monitor academic fitness trends, institutional spending, procurement practices, facility design trends, and competitor activity.
  • Track major construction projects, campus expansions, athletic facility investments, and government education funding programs.
  • Provide regular reports to senior leadership outlining:
    • Sales performance
    • Pipeline development
    • Key account activity
    • Dealer performance
    • Market trends
    • Competitive insights
    • Risks and opportunities
  • Recommend actions to improve Centr’s competitiveness and market penetration.

Brand Representation

  • Represent Centr at education, fitness, athletic, recreation, and facilities industry events.
  • Attend trade shows, conferences, association meetings, dealer events, and customer presentations.
  • Serve as Centr’s subject-matter expert and primary commercial representative for the global academic market.
  • Maintain a professional brand presence and ensure Centr’s standards are consistently represented.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, sales, sports management, exercise science, education, or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in commercial fitness equipment, institutional sales, education sales, dealer management, or a related industry.
  • Demonstrated experience selling into K–12 schools, colleges, universities, athletic departments, or campus recreation facilities.
  • Proven ability to manage direct sales and dealer-supported sales channels.
  • Experience with complex, project-based, and capital equipment sales.
  • Strong understanding of institutional procurement, bid processes, budgeting cycles, and purchasing requirements.
  • Demonstrated success developing strategic accounts and building long-term customer relationships.
  • Experience working across multiple countries or regions is strongly preferred.
  • Knowledge of fitness equipment, strength and conditioning, campus recreation, athletics, or physical education is highly desirable.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce platforms, Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, presentation software, and sales reporting tools.
  • Fluency in English required; additional languages are beneficial.
  • Valid passport and ability to travel internationally.

Travel Requirements

This role requires frequent domestic and international travel to visit customers, dealers, distributors, educational institutions, trade shows, and industry events. Travel may represent approximately 40%–60% of the position, depending on market needs.

jobs.excerpt: Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

About the Role

You’ll design coding tasks that challenge frontier AI coding agents. Each task is a self-contained Docker environment with a broken piece of software; an AI agent attempts the fix; automated tests verify the outcome. Your deliverable is the full task package: broken code, tests, instructions, and a reference solution proving the task is solvable.

Responsibilities:

  • Invent a realistic developer scenario — a real bug, a broken ETL, a missing feature — not a toy problem.
  • Build a reproducible Docker environment with pinned dependencies.
  • Write a pytest that verifies outcomes, not specific commands — deterministic, non-flaky, and does not leak the fix.
  • Write an instruction.md that reads like a Jira ticket a developer would receive.
  • Write a reference solve.sh proving the task is solvable.
  • Calibrate difficulty so current state-of-the-art agents solve the task 20–60% of the time.
  • Iterate based on feedback from expert QA reviewers.
  • Later: review other authors’ tasks as a QA reviewer.

Not in scope

  • Data labeling, prompt engineering.
  • Production code to ship — you design problems and verification for AI agents.
  • Leetcode puzzles — scenarios must look like real developer work.
  • Not every candidate task ships — quality over quantity.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of production software development in one backend stack — Python, Go, Node.js, Java, or Rust. Depth in one stack beats breadth.
  • Python + pytest fluency — required regardless of primary stack. The task harness is pytest-based even when the broken app is in another language. Fixtures, parametrize, monkeypatch, timeouts, conftest.py.
  • Docker authoring — reproducible Dockerfiles, pinned dependencies, multi-stage builds when needed, non-root user.
  • Linux & Bash — comfort debugging inside containers (strace, lsof, journalctl); shell beyond set -euo pipefail.
  • AI coding agent experience — Claude Code, Cursor, Roo Code, or similar, on non-trivial work. You can cite a specific time the AI was confidently wrong and how you caught it.
  • English — B2+ written.

Not a fit

  • Data Science, ML, or Computer Vision engineers without backend-engineering output.
  • Manual QA testers without automation or test authoring.
  • Frontend-only, low-code / no-code, IT Support, or Business Analysts.
  • Engineers who have never written pytest from scratch.
  • Junior, intern, or assistant as the most recent role.

Preferred qualifications

  • Domain depth in Security, System Administration (nginx / systemd / cron), Scientific Computing (NumPy / PyTorch / SciPy), DevOps, or Git internals.
  • Modern Python tooling (uv, poetry, pyproject.toml).
  • Coverage tooling (pytest-cov, coverage.py, gcov, llvm-cov, kcov).
  • Fuzzing or property-based testing (Hypothesis).
  • Prior contribution to agent-evaluation benchmarks or related frameworks.

Process

Apply → Pass qualification (90-minute sample-task screen + short behavioral interview) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid.

Time commitment

  • Onboarding: ~10 hours per first task.
  • Steady state: ~5 hours per task, 2–4 parallel tasks per author.
  • Realistic weekly load: 8–20 hours. Higher volume available for top performers.
  • You choose when and how to contribute; tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet acceptance criteria.

Compensation:

  • Paid contributions, rates up to $35/hour*.
  • Task-based compensation equivalent to hourly rate, depending on performance and volume.
  • Some projects include incentive payments.

*Rates vary based on expertise, skills assessment, location, project needs, and other factors. Higher rates may be provided to highly specialized experts. Lower rates may apply during onboarding or non-core project phases. Payment details are shared per project.

Apply

Submit your CV via the Mindrift platform. Indicate your English level, note this role (Software Engineering Evaluation Specialist — Terminal Bench), and include a GitHub profile link if available.

jobs.title: Travel Expert | Reviewer
jobs.excerpt: We’re recruiting Travel professionals and experienced trip planners to review and improve realistic travel scenarios used to train AI travel assistants.
jobs.description:
We’re recruiting Travel professionals and experienced trip planners to review and improve realistic travel scenarios used to train AI travel assistants.

Your job isn’t to “write itineraries.” It’s to think like a real trip planner and spot what makes a travel situation real, feasible, and decision-changing — then upgrade weak scenarios so they actually test the model.

‼️ AI is not allowed. If we spot AI use, we’ll block the application.
⚠️ This application form must be completed entirely in English.
🚨 READ ALL THE DESCRIPTION BELOW TO UNDERSTAND THE APPLICATION FORM.

WHO CAN APPLY

  • Travel professionals and experienced trip planners

  • 3+ years of relevant travel planning experience (professional or high-volume personal)

  • English level: Advanced / Fluent (required)

WHAT YOU’LL DO IN THE APPLICATION (QUICK SCREENING TEST)
You will review two pre-generated travel tasks. For each task, you’ll answer simple 1–5 ratings and give a short justification.

Then, for the 2nd task, you’ll rewrite it to make it stronger.

WHAT “STRONG” MEANS (SIMPLE DEFINITION)
A strong task includes one decisive feasibility constraint that can flip the plan if ignored (missed train, missed check-in, closed attraction, wrong station, etc.).

We call this a Knife:

  • A Knife is a constraint that changes what itinerary is actually viable.

  • Quick test: if you remove it, the “best plan” would meaningfully change.

Examples of Knives in Travel

  • Last train / last entry / check-in cutoff times

  • Closures and holidays that change what’s possible

  • Ambiguous locations (airport/station names that can be confused)

  • Sequential dependencies (if A slips, B becomes impossible)

  • Mobility constraints that change routing feasibility

WHAT YOU WILL RATE (1–5) IN THE FORM

You’ll give 3 ratings per task:

  1. Overall Quality (1–5)

    How clear and testable the task is (can you judge PASS/FAIL)?

  2. Knife / Hidden Context Strength (1–5)

    Is there a decisive feasibility constraint — or is the “hidden context” just extra color that doesn’t change the plan?

  3. Checklist Quality (1–5)

    Does the checklist truly test feasibility + the Knife with clear criteria?
    (Strong checklists include verification steps and forbid inventing logistics, written as PASS/FAIL — not “be helpful.”)

You’ll also write a short justification (2–4 bullets) explaining your ratings.

WHAT YOU WILL REWRITE (FOR THE 2ND TASK ONLY)
You will rewrite these parts to make the task stronger:

  • Scenario (3rd person) — more realistic + naturally sets up the feasibility risk

  • Prompt (user message) — natural, human, does not reveal the Knife

  • Hidden Context (1–3 bullets) — must include exactly 1 decisive Knife

  • Checklist (4–6 items) — each item must be PASS/FAIL, covering:

    • feasibility/verification (minimum unknowns to check)

    • the Knife (the decision-flipping constraint)

    • no invented logistics (no made-up schedules/hours/availability)

    • branching plan (Plan A / Plan B) when feasibility depends on one missing answer

    • safety only when there is real risk

Checklist item example:

PASS if it flags what must be verified (tickets/hours/cutoffs) before committing; FAIL if it confidently invents times or availability.

Important: Don’t “leak” the Knife in the prompt (no “IMPORTANT”, no all-caps, no “the key detail is…”).

IF SELECTED (PROJECT WORK)
You’ll review batches of pre-generated travel scenarios:

  • Rating realism and feasibility risk

  • Identifying weak or missing constraints (Knives)

  • Improving tasks so they better represent real travel moments where wrong advice causes missed connections, wasted money, or ruined plans

COMPENSATION

Payment will be US$ 30 per approved task, converted and paid in your local currency.

Each task takes approximately 40 minutes, which corresponds to an effective rate of about US$ 45 per hour.

jobs.excerpt: Become a part of our caring community Humana is seeking a Lead Cloud Architect – NoSQL Databases to provide strategic leadership, architecture direction, and engineering oversight for enterprise NoSQL database platforms across Humana’s cloud environments.
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

Humana is seeking a Lead Cloud Architect – NoSQL Databases to provide strategic leadership, architecture direction, and engineering oversight for enterprise NoSQL database platforms across Humana’s cloud environments. This role will focus on the design, implementation, modernization, and governance of NoSQL database solutions, including MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB, Neo4j, and vector database technologies.

The successful candidate will help define and advance Humana's enterprise NoSQL strategy, support platform rationalization initiatives, and ensure database solutions are secure, scalable, resilient, automated, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards. This role requires hands-on technical depth, strong cloud architecture experience, and the ability to collaborate across security, engineering, quality, application, and business teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, document, and maintain enterprise-wide NoSQL database standards, reference architectures, design patterns, and best practices.
  • Lead architecture and engineering efforts for NoSQL platforms including MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB, Neo4j, and vector databases.
  • Support NoSQL platform rationalization and modernization initiatives, including migration planning and execution from Cosmos DB to MongoDB where appropriate.
  • Architect secure, highly available, scalable, and performant NoSQL database solutions across cloud environments, including Azure and/or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Define database architecture patterns for document databases, graph databases, key-value workloads, and vector search use cases.
  • Guide application teams on NoSQL data modeling, partitioning, indexing, query patterns, performance optimization, and operational readiness.
  • Oversee automation of NoSQL provisioning, configuration, monitoring, backup, recovery, and lifecycle management using DevOps and infrastructure-as-code practices.
  • Develop and review automation scripts, tooling, and integrations using Python and related technologies.
  • Collaborate with security, cloud engineering, quality engineering, compliance, and application teams to ensure NoSQL deployments meet enterprise security, regulatory, and operational standards.
  • Support Cloud onboarding, development, deployment, and troubleshooting activities for application teams using NoSQL database platforms.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and architecture guidance to engineers and cross-functional teams.
  • Evaluate emerging NoSQL, graph, vector database, cloud-native, and AI-enabled data technologies to inform enterprise roadmap decisions.
  • Participate in architecture review, platform governance, technology standardization, and modernization planning activities.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 or more years of experience in Cloud architecture, Cloud engineering, Database engineering, DevOps, or related technology roles.
  • Strong experience designing, implementing, or supporting NoSQL database platforms such as MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB, Neo4j, vector databases, or similar technologies.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure and/or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Strong development or scripting experience using Python.
  • Demonstrated experience with DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines, source control, branching strategies, release management, pull request workflows, automated testing, and operational automation.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, or similar DevOps platforms.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code and configuration management tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or similar technologies.
  • Demonstrated experience leading or supporting large-scale database migrations, platform modernization efforts, or technology standardization initiatives.
  • Solid understanding of NoSQL data modeling, partitioning, indexing, query optimization, performance tuning, scalability, and resiliency patterns.
  • Experience designing database platforms for high availability, disaster recovery, backup, recovery, monitoring, and operational support.
  • Working knowledge of cloud security principles, including identity and access management, encryption, private networking, secrets management, audit logging, and compliance controls.
  • Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar tools to support software development, automation, documentation, troubleshooting, or architecture activities.
  • Ability to responsibly apply AI tools while protecting confidential information, regulated data, source code, credentials, and enterprise intellectual property.
  • Ability to create technical documentation, architecture diagrams, standards, runbooks, implementation guidance, and operational support materials.
  • Strong leadership, communication, collaboration, and stakeholder engagement skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Enterprise Cloud Modernization programs
  • Experience with MongoDB Atlas, self-managed MongoDB, or enterprise MongoDB deployments.
  • Experience with Azure Cosmos DB, including API selection, partition key design, request unit planning, consistency levels, indexing policies, monitoring, and backup/recovery capabilities.
  • Experience with Cosmos DB to MongoDB migration planning, application compatibility analysis, data validation, or platform rationalization.
  • Experience with Neo4j Aura, self-managed Neo4j, graph data modeling, Cypher queries, and graph analytics use cases.
  • Experience with vector databases or vector search platforms supporting semantic search, retrieval-augmented generation, AI/ML workloads, or recommendation capabilities.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, cloud-native application platforms, containerized workloads, or managed database services.
  • Experience working in regulated industries such as healthcare, insurance, financial services, or other compliance-driven environments.

Student success will be measured by valid and reliable assessment data, parent and student satisfaction, and continued institutional growth within the academic community. Join us!

The Lead Teacher is a highly qualified, state certified teacher responsible for delivering specific course content in an on-line environment. Teachers provide instruction, support and guidance, manage the learning process, and focus on students’ individual needs. Additionally, the Lead Teacher acts as a member of the school leadership team, and mentoring teachers and supporting virtual academy (VA) efforts to improve student performance.

This is a full-time position. Ability to work independently, typically 40+ hours per week is required. Ability to maintain a professional home office without distraction during workday, typically 9-5 (or 8-4) or as defined by the school.

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend three weeks (paid).This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday – Friday

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel
  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs
  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process
  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations
  • Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares
  • Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans

  • Previous exposure to quality control processes to ensure the accuracy and compliance of travel bookings.

  • A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.

  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully
  • Reliable, high-speed internet connectivity required to support core job responsibilities, including but not limited to video conferencing, access to company systems, and secure handling of company data.

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset.   • Giving Back:Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

At BOLDSCIENCE, an Associate Client Service Director (ACSD) plays a pivotal role within the Client Services leadership team. They have a wealth of experience working within the medical communications industry and can execute a variety of deliverables and drive a diverse portfolio of accounts. As well as excellent project and client management skills, an aCSD has a high level of scientific and strategic knowledge, enabling them to quickly become a trusted partner to clients. They are forward-thinking and always looking for new ideas and fresh approaches to push BOLD’s offering to the next level. An aCSD is egoless and leads by example. They are never one to shy away from getting stuck in and pride themselves on the development of their line reports and team. They take the time to build relationships with the wider BOLDSCIENCE team (such as Scientific, Creative, Finance, and People Operations) and ensure that collaborations are successful. An ACSD is beginning to expand their role outside of day-to-day account management and will start to increase their visibility across the wider Client Services & BOLDSCIENCE team.

DAY TO DAY RESPONSIBILITIES:

At BOLDSCIENCE, an ACSD can apply high levels of scientific and/or industry expertise to function as a strategic partner to clients. They are responsible for tactical planning, financial management, resourcing, and driving organic and new business opportunities. Some typical activities will include:

Client Management:

  • Ability to build an open and honest partnership with clients and build the BOLD team around them. They have a sixth sense and can forward plan, knowing exactly when something needs to be changed/actioned
  • Extensive experience working across a range of therapeutic areas, clients, and medical education tactics
  • Provides onsite support where required
  • Ability to apply a high level of scientific and commercial expertise gained through extensive knowledge and experience in the industry to act as a true client partner
  • Provides strategic and operational direction to account teams
  • Acts as a strategic and trusted partner as well as pushing and challenging our clients’ thinking
  • Works in partnership with the Scientific Lead on accounts to develop and refine client strategy and tactics and ensure the BOLD plan for execution is feasible
  • Provides support to the account team on client discussions where appropriate and flags any potential conflicts across the business
  • Implements and maintains quality standards, cost efficiency, and best working practices alongside senior account team members

Project Management:

  • Overall responsibility for a large or a diverse portfolio of accounts
  • Effectively directs projects, overseeing and delegating tasks to the team as appropriate. Leads by example and is always happy to have a hands-on approach to support their team
  • Portfolio lead for strategic discussions and routine client/agency reviews, driving strategic and tactical organic growth
  • Drives alignment across client teams, ensuring the highest standards are met and providing internal leadership of accounts and teams
  • Holds regular team meetings to ensure that everyone is up to date, clear on actions, and can ask any questions
  • In collaboration with the scientific team leads, ensures the optimum level of resources to service account needs and pre-empt any resourcing challenges
  • Is accountable in driving actions forward and is solution focused to achieving company goals
  • Reviews content and provides sign-off on work, partnering with the scientific team leads

Financial Management:

  • Overall responsibility for account financials and business unit KPIs
  • Works closely with the VP, Client Services to set realistic revenue targets and ensure that BOLDs overall revenue target is achieved
  • Responsible for account and business unit forecasting, working closely with the Scientific Lead to ensure all financials are accurate
  • Consistently meets billability & recoverability targets and ensures the same from line reports and wider team members
  • Completes timesheets accurately on time and ensures the same from line reports and wider team members
  • Maintains strong relationships with senior clients and procurement teams and supports with MSA negotiations
  • Supports team in financial conversations with the client, including overall yearly budgeting, timely out-of-scope recovery, and billings

Business Development:

  • Identifies and drives new business opportunities across new and existing clients
  • Identifies opportunities for business growth, actively driving new business opportunities and leading in pitches
  • Responsible for keeping abreast with key events and innovations in the industry

People Management:

  • Manages and inputs into the career development of direct reports and their teams, closely reviewing goals and objectives
  • Line manages several team members of varying levels, providing constructive and actionable feedback to team members
  • Coaches and mentors others across the agency with the ability to adapt to get the best out of the BOLD team
  • Forms excellent senior-level relationships and is a trusted partner to the Business Unit founder

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Extensive experience working within the medical communications industry
  • Proven ability to work across different therapy areas and project deliverables in a client-facing role. Leading and actioning projects within a fast-paced agency environment
  • Excellent understanding of the pharma and competitor landscape
  • Extensive experience and knowledge within the medical communications industry
  • Experience collaborating with different departments such as Scientific Services, Creative, Digital, etc.
  • Able to lead a team effectively, including line management responsibilities and mentoring
  • Experienced financial management including budgets, forecasting, and recoverability

We’re hiring licensed clinicians to provide compassionate, evidence-based care to our more than 175,000 clients across the country. You may be a good fit for this role if you’re:

Fluent is building the next generation advertising network, Partner Monetize & Advertiser Acquisition. Our vision is to build an ML/AI first network of advertisers and publishers to achieve a common objective, elevating relevancy in E-commerce for everyday shoppers.

As a Data Engineer on Fluent's Data Engineering team, you will bring your Databricks development expertise to build the data products that power Fluent's Audience Solutions business: the syndicated and custom consumer segments we build, model, and deliver to leading data marketplaces. These data products translate raw survey and behavioral signals into declared and modeled audiences that our commercial teams and clients rely on every day.

You are known as a strong and efficient IC Data Engineer, with the ability to assist in designing engineering solutions, data modeling, and building architecture. You are familiar with the Databricks Lakehouse and how to work backwards from translating business requirements into engineering solutions. You are considered an expert in Python, SQL, and Spark.

You will work closely with the Data Engineering team and Data Science partners to build and operate high-impact audience data solutions. This role is fully Remote in the United States or Canada, with occasional travel to NYC.

What You'll Do:

  • Majority of the role will be data engineering: tables, views, jobs/pipelines, and orchestration within the Databricks environment, following Fluent’s data model and architecture best practices. You will help elevate standards across testing, code repository, ci/cd, and naming conventions.
  • Build and maintain pipelines that create and deliver syndicated and custom audience segments, spanning declared (survey-based) and modeled (ML driven) methodologies.
  • Support delivery and performance reporting of finished segments on distribution marketplaces such as LiveRamp, TruAudience (TransUnion), and Lotame.
  • Investigate and leverage Databricks' latest capabilities for real-time processing and operational workloads, such as Spark structured Streaming and Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines.
  • Contribute to and maintain a high-quality codebase with comprehensive data observability, metadata standards, and best practices, including compliant handling of consumer data in line with Fluent's data privacy standards.
  • Apply AI-assisted development practices, using tools such as Claude Code, to accelerate pipeline development, testing, and documentation, while upholding Fluent's engineering and data quality standards.
  • Partner with the Data Engineering team, Data Science, and commercial stakeholders to define business requests and translate them into functional requirements.
  • Keep track of emerging tech and trends within the Databricks ecosystem.
  • Share your knowledge by giving brown bags, tech talks, and evangelizing appropriate tech and engineering best practices.
  • Empower internal teams by providing communication on architecture, execution plans, releases, and training.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science or related field.
  • 4+ years of industry experience in Data Engineering, including expertise in SQL, Python, Spark, and distributed processing.

  • Strong foundation in database design, data structures, and algorithms.
  • Experience using AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) as part of a modern engineering workflow.

In addition we offer a fully stocked kitchen, catered breakfast and lunch, and our office manager keeps the calendar stocked with activity-filled events. jobs.title: B2B Content and Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt: About Bamboo WorksBamboo Works helps companies build global teams through flexible workforce solutions.
jobs.description:
About Bamboo Works

Bamboo Works helps companies build global teams through flexible workforce solutions. We are evolving from a traditional remote staffing company into a more strategic global workforce partner, helping businesses increase capacity, access international talent, reduce operational bottlenecks, and build flexible teams that support long-term growth.

With a newly launched website and refreshed positioning, we're entering the next stage of our growth. We're also developing focused strategies within specific B2B industries—including accounting and professional services—where we see an opportunity to become a specialist workforce partner.

We're now looking for a B2B Content & Growth Marketing Manager to help turn that positioning into visibility, authority, and qualified demand.

The Role

This is a hands-on strategic marketing role for someone who can develop the strategy and execute it.

You won't simply receive a content calendar and be asked to publish posts. You'll work closely with our founders to understand Bamboo Works' commercial priorities, target markets, and positioning, then translate those into a clear and consistent organic marketing strategy.

Your initial focus will span content, SEO, GEO/AI search, social media, lead magnets, website optimization, email marketing, and organic lead generation.

Paid advertising and performance marketing are not a core part of this role. We're looking for someone who understands how high-quality content and organic marketing can compound over time to build authority and generate qualified B2B opportunities.

Role Details

Commitment: Part-Time (20 hours/week)

Working Hours: Philippine business hours

Location: Fully Remote (PH-based candidates preferred)

Engagement: Independent Contractor

Start Date: ASAP

Monthly Rate: USD $800–$960/month (on a 20-hour workweek), can be higher (depending on experience)

What You'll Do

Content Strategy & Execution

  • Develop and execute a consistent B2B content strategy aligned with Bamboo Works' positioning and commercial priorities.

  • Create content around global teams, workforce strategy, international talent, AI-enabled teams, and the business challenges our target customers face.

  • Build targeted content strategies for priority niches, particularly accounting and professional services.

  • Write and edit LinkedIn posts, blogs, articles, educational resources, and other marketing assets.

  • Research customer pain points, industry trends, questions, and topics that can be turned into valuable content.

  • Repurpose high-performing ideas across multiple channels and formats.

  • Maintain a clear, authoritative, and consistent Bamboo Works brand voice.

SEO, GEO & Organic Growth

  • Develop and execute an SEO strategy aligned with our commercial priorities.

  • Conduct keyword, competitor, audience, and topic research.

  • Build topical authority through useful, high-quality content.

  • Optimize existing website pages and identify opportunities for new search-focused content.

  • Help develop our approach to GEO / AI search visibility, ensuring Bamboo Works' content is discoverable across both traditional and AI-powered search experiences.

  • Monitor organic traffic, rankings, search visibility, and other relevant indicators.

  • Continuously identify opportunities to strengthen our organic acquisition funnel.

Lead Magnets & Demand Generation

Lead magnets will be an important part of our marketing strategy, and we're looking for someone who can help us create them at scale.

  • Develop high-value lead magnets such as guides, reports, checklists, templates, calculators, and other useful B2B resources.

  • Research topics and formats that genuinely address the needs of our target audiences.

  • Write and develop lead magnet content from concept through completion.

  • Identify opportunities to integrate lead magnets across our website, social content, and marketing funnel.

  • Develop supporting landing page copy and promotional content.

  • Work closely with Sales to understand which topics and assets generate meaningful commercial interest.

  • Continuously improve the journey from content → lead → sales conversation.

  • Identify additional organic campaigns and channels that can generate qualified B2B leads.

Social Media & Brand Authority

  • Take ownership of Bamboo Works' organic social media presence, with a particular focus on LinkedIn.

  • Build content that establishes Bamboo Works as an authority in global workforce solutions and our priority niches.

  • Identify opportunities to grow reach, engagement, and relevant audiences organically.

  • Test different content formats, topics, and approaches based on performance.

  • Focus on meaningful business outcomes rather than vanity metrics alone.

Website, Email & Marketing Automation

  • Review website content and identify opportunities to improve messaging, CTAs, landing pages, and conversion paths.

  • Identify content gaps based on customer questions, search demand, and commercial priorities.

  • Develop email campaigns and nurture sequences for leads and prospects.

  • Build and manage straightforward marketing automation and lead follow-up workflows using tools such as GoHighLevel.

  • Help continuously improve our website as both a marketing and sales asset.

Analytics & Continuous Improvement

  • Establish and track meaningful KPIs across content, SEO, GEO, social media, and lead generation.

  • Monitor traffic, rankings, engagement, leads, and conversion performance.

  • Identify which content and channels are genuinely contributing to growth.

  • Regularly report on performance and recommend what we should do more, less, or differently.

  • Continuously test and improve rather than simply producing more content.

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

  • 3+ years of relevant marketing experience, ideally within B2B.

  • Strong experience developing and executing marketing strategies rather than working solely as an executor.

  • Excellent content marketing and copywriting skills, with the ability to produce authoritative, engaging English-language content.

  • Strong practical SEO knowledge and experience improving organic search performance.

  • Experience using organic content to generate leads and support business growth.

  • Experience creating B2B lead magnets, content assets, or conversion-focused resources.

  • Strong understanding of B2B customer journeys and organic demand generation.

  • Experience managing LinkedIn and other relevant social channels.

  • Ability to conduct independent market, competitor, keyword, and audience research.

  • Strong analytical skills and confidence using marketing data to guide decisions.

  • Ability to use AI tools effectively for research, ideation, production, optimization, and analysis without sacrificing human judgment or content quality.

  • Highly proactive and capable of independently taking ideas from strategy through execution.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience within staffing, recruitment, outsourcing, professional services, accounting, SaaS, or another B2B environment.

  • Understanding of GEO, AEO, AI search optimization, or how generative AI is changing organic discovery.

  • Experience with GoHighLevel or similar CRM/marketing automation platforms.

  • Experience with CMS, analytics, and common SEO tools.

  • Email marketing and nurture sequence experience.

  • Experience improving website content, landing pages, and conversion journeys.

Portfolio & Results

We're particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate measurable results from their previous work.

As part of your application, we'd love to see examples such as:

  • B2B campaigns that generated qualified leads.

  • Organic or social accounts you've successfully grown.

  • SEO improvements or rankings you've helped achieve.

  • Blogs or long-form content you've personally written.

  • Lead magnets, guides, reports, templates, or other resources you've created.

  • Content strategies that contributed to measurable business growth.

We're less interested in how much content you've produced than in understanding what you did, why you did it, and what happened as a result.

Ideal Candidate Profile

This role is ideal for someone who combines the mindset of a strategist with the ability of a hands-on marketer.

You're commercially minded and understand that marketing should ultimately create awareness, authority, and qualified business opportunities. You're an excellent writer, but you also understand SEO, distribution, funnels, analytics, and how individual marketing activities work together.

You're curious enough to deeply understand an industry rather than producing generic content. You proactively bring ideas to the table, test them, measure what happens, and continuously improve.

You also embrace AI as an everyday marketing tool—but you know that great marketing still requires strong human judgment, originality, and a genuine understanding of the customer.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first few months, we'd expect to see:

  • A clear and repeatable organic marketing strategy across our priority channels.

  • A consistent, high-quality social media presence aligned with our new positioning.

  • A structured content and blogging engine.

  • A measurable SEO and GEO strategy.

  • Increasing organic visibility for commercially relevant topics.

  • A strong content foundation within our priority niches, particularly accounting.

  • A growing library of high-quality lead magnets and marketing assets.

  • Stronger website content and conversion paths.

  • Clear marketing KPIs and regular performance reporting.

  • Increasing qualified inbound interest and stronger marketing support for our Sales team.

Ultimately, we want marketing to become a compounding asset for Bamboo Works—where every piece of content, search ranking, resource, and piece of industry knowledge contributes to stronger brand authority and future demand generation.

Recruitment Process

  1. Application & Portfolio Review

  2. Initial Interview

  3. Interview with Bamboo Works Leadership

  4. Practical Assessment (if required)

  5. Offer & Onboarding

About Remote

With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role.

We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.
If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

What this job can offer you

  • This role is a core technical and programme lead position within CX Operations, working alongside CX leadership and cross-functional partners to build the automation and AI capabilities that shape how the team operates at scale.

    You will own delivery end to end. You will work closely with CX leadership as priorities are shaped, bringing technical and operational input to inform decisions, bring technical judgment and operational context to those conversations, and then lead the work from scoping through to production and iteration. You will bring technical judgment and operational context to scoping discussions, and work with significant autonomy within agreed priorities to see initiatives through from design to production, while working as part of a broader team, not in isolation.

    The combination this role asks for is not common: someone technically confident to build and ship, with the programme management skills to run complex cross-functional work, and the communication skills to make both sides legible to each other. If that combination describes you, this is a role where you will have real ownership, real impact, and real variety.

How this role contributes to the department's and company's goals

As Remote grows and the complexity of its customer base increases, CX has to maintain quality and responsiveness without being overwhelmed by volume or operational fragmentation. Automation and AI are central to how we do that, not by replacing good judgment, but by removing friction, surfacing the right information at the right moment, and giving specialists the tools to focus on work that actually requires a human.

Beyond efficiency, this role is about empowering the CX team. The tooling and automation built here determine how well our specialists can do their jobs, how quickly customers get real resolution, and how effectively CX can absorb new products, new partners, and growing complexity. That impact is direct and measurable.

What you bring

  • A manager of one: you identify what needs doing, set your own direction, and deliver without needing to be chased. You default to action and close your own loops.
  • Strong programme management alongside your technical ability. You can scope a complex initiative, manage stakeholders across functions, communicate clearly to non-technical audiences, and see it through from start to done, not just the build, the whole thing.
  • Hands-on experience building automation and integration systems in a CX, support, or operations context. You understand what a support workflow looks like from the inside: what slows agents down, what good resolution actually means, and what tooling helps versus what just looks good in a demo.
  • Technical confidence: you can build, read, and debug code; design and work with APIs, webhooks, and integration standards including MCP; and move fast using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor as part of your standard workflow. You take ownership of complex technical systems end to end, from design through to production.
  • Solid experience with low-code and no-code workflow platforms such as n8n, Make, Zapier, Retool, Gumloop, or similar, to design and run cross-system automations.
  • You know when automation is the right answer and when it is not. You evaluate the problem before reaching for a tool, and you are as comfortable making the case against automating something as you are building it.
  • Experience deploying AI agents or AI-assisted workflows in a production environment, including designing for failure, building in human oversight, and maintaining auditability.
  • The ability to translate between operational needs and technical constraints in both directions, clearly, without jargon, and with the right level of detail for whoever is in the room.
  • You document what you build. Not as an afterthought, as part of how you work.
  • Writes and speaks fluent English.
  • Experience working in a remote-first environment is a plus but not required.

Key Responsibilities

Automation & AI Development

  • Contribute to and lead delivery of CX automation and AI initiatives, from scoping and design through to production and ongoing iteration.
  • Build and maintain AI agents and automated workflows that improve specialist effectiveness, reduce manual handling, and increase consistency across CX operations.
  • Deploy AI capabilities responsibly: design for failure, ensure appropriate human oversight is built in, and maintain the logs and auditability expected in a customer-facing support environment.
  • Stay across developments in AI and automation tooling, surface well-reasoned recommendations for your manager and the CX leadership team to evaluate.

CX Tooling & Systems

  • Own the technical delivery of CX tooling: the integrations, applications, and automated workflows that connect the platforms CX teams depend on every day.
  • Build and maintain integrations across the CX technology stack, including Zendesk and its application framework, Remote's internal platform, REST APIs, webhooks, and emerging integration standards such as MCP, ensuring data flows correctly, triggers fire reliably, and tooling holds up under operational load.
  • As Remote's customer and partner base grows, support the CX tooling requirements that come with it: new channels, new integrations, increasing complexity.

Programme Delivery & Documentation

  • Manage complex, multi-phase delivery: own dependencies, communicate proactively, and bring initiatives across the line without needing to be chased.
  • Document everything you own. Accurate, accessible documentation is part of the definition of done, not something that happens later.
  • Identify technical debt, undocumented processes, and fragile points in the CX automation stack and address them systematically.

Data & Continuous Improvement

  • Use operational data and CX performance metrics to inform priorities and validate what is working. Build visibility into the impact of automation for CX leadership.
  • Define success metrics for each initiative, track them, and use them to make decisions about what to iterate on and what to stop.

Cross-functional Partnership

COMPANY PROFILE

CodeAI is an education innovation nonprofit dedicated to the vision that every student in every school has the opportunity to learn about artificial intelligence (AI) and computer science (CS) as part of their core K-12 education. We increase participation in AI+CS education by reaching students of all backgrounds where they are — at their skill level, in their schools, and in ways that inspire them to keep learning, with a focus on increasing participation by young women and students from other underrepresented groups. The leading provider of K-12 AI+CS education curriculum across the globe, CodeAI also organizes the annual Hour of AI campaign, building on the legacy of the Hour of Code, which has engaged more than 15% of all students in the world!

A unifying approach in a divided world

CodeAI's global role in the K-12 computer science movement is only possible because we use a unifying approach across diverse and often divided stakeholders. At a time of increasing polarization, the idea of increasing opportunity for students unites people from across the political spectrum. CodeAI's team members, students, teachers, and supporters have diverse and diverging view points, and they are all welcome in our mission. Read more.

JOB SUMMARY

As Director of Global Strategy & Programs, you'll set the strategic direction for CodeAI's work expanding access to CS + AI learning experiences outside the U.S. You'll decide where and how Global can have the greatest impact, then build the programs, partnerships, and systems needed to get there.

You'll balance depth-market investment with breadth-market scale, translating big-picture strategy into operating models that actually work in classrooms while representing CodeAI's global work to ministries of education, partners, and media.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

In this role, you will:

Global Strategy & Impact

  • Define CodeAI's global strategy, setting the goals, KPIs, and market approaches that expand access to and adoption of CS + AI learning.
  • Own global performance, using data, market insight, and partner feedback to spot opportunities and improve impact.
  • Decide where Global can have the greatest impact, balancing deep engagement in priority markets against scalable approaches everywhere else.
  • Operate with a high degree of autonomy as a strategic leader, aligning priorities across the organization.

Programs, Markets & Partnerships

  • Build and scale global programs that help partners and ecosystems deliver CodeAI's learning experiences sustainably.
  • Design distinct strategies for breadth markets (in-market partners) and depth markets (direct investment in infrastructure and partnerships).
  • Design frameworks and partner models that bring curriculum, product, marketing, operations, and partnerships together into one coherent program.
  • Win leadership and cross-functional buy-in for global strategies, securing the resources needed to execute.
  • Adapt programs and operating models to local context while holding the line on CodeAI's mission and standards.

Team & Operational Leadership

  • Lead and grow a small Global team — setting goals, coaching, and supporting career development.
  • Manage the Global team's budget and oversee vendors and contracted partners (teacher training, localization, market implementation).
  • Build systems for consistent execution, measurement, and reporting across the partner ecosystem.

Advocacy & Organizational Alignment

  • Represent CodeAI's global work and partner ecosystem to government and ministry leaders, nonprofit and education partners, and media.
  • Turn complex global strategy and market dynamics into narratives that drive decisions across the organization.
  • Build cross-team understanding of how global insights and partnerships should inform CodeAI's broader strategy.

EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS

We seek candidates who have:

  • 7+ years of experience driving systemic change in K-12 education worldwide, particularly in AI and Computer Science education.
  • Deep experience in nonprofit settings, partnering with ministries of education, school systems, and teacher networks to expand equitable access to CS education.
  • An entrepreneurial, autonomous operating style — able to align programs and partnerships across complex education ecosystems to hit measurable outcomes.
  • The ability to design and scale programs spanning multiple workstreams: curriculum, teacher PD, government relations, and partner enablement.
  • Comfort operating at both ends of the spectrum — presenting strategic frameworks to boards and funders, and inspiring educators and partners directly.
  • A track record building data-driven systems that measure program effectiveness and student/teacher impact at scale.
  • A reputation as a trusted mentor and collaborator who builds alignment around shared goals across diverse teams and partners.

In addition, candidates must:

  • Be a U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident
  • Work within the continental United States
  • Pass a pre-employment background check
  • Be willing to travel a minimum of two times per year for team events

OUR CULTURAL PRINCIPLES

The way we work matters as much as the work itself. Before you apply, we invite you to take a look at our cultural principles. They reflect who we are, how we show up for each other, and what we look for in the people who join us.

OUR APPROACH TO AI IN HIRING

At CodeAI, we use AI thoughtfully and responsibly to support human-centered hiring. AI may help with administrative tasks, but every hiring decision is made by real people on our team. We welcome candidates to use AI appropriately in their job search while upholding our values of honesty and integrity throughout the process.

Read our full AI Use Policy in Hiring here.

WHAT IS THE INTERVIEW PROCESS LIKE?

Step 1: Informational Interview - learn more about the role and share your experience (30 minutes)

Step 2: Take-Home Assignment (~3 hours)

Step 3: Interviews with several members of the CodeAI team (3 hours)
Step 4: Final Interviews (2 hours)
Step 5: Reference Checks

All interviews are currently being conducted virtually via Google Meet

TO APPLY

Our team will review all applications on an ongoing basis and if we believe your qualifications would make a great fit, we'll contact you to schedule an informational interview.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS PACKAGE

The expected salary range for this position is $117,000 - $130,000. Most offers are on the lower end of the salary range and are at the company’s sole discretion based on the final candidate’s experience. This allows us to provide a fair and equitable approach to compensation when setting pay and maintaining internal pay equity.

Join us in redefining healthcare — so it doesn’t just survive, it thrives. To learn more about PointClickCare, check out Life at PointClickCare and connect with us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn.

Position Summary:

As a Senior Product Manager at PointClickCare, you will own and drive the AI product roadmap for Revenue Cycle Management, starting with Billing Advisor, our AI-powered platform that identifies potential billable events for skilled nursing and senior living facilities, and extending to the next generation of AI advisors across pre-billing validation, collections, and claims workflows.

This is not a greenfield role. You are taking ownership of a product that is live with customers and heading into general availability. You will work in a complex, high-stakes domain where your product outputs directly affect whether facilities get paid and whether claims are denied. You need to be equally fluent in AI product behavior and billing workflows.

You contribute to the vision and strategy of your product area, define and own roadmaps, and drive execution and delivery of compelling value to users and customers. To succeed in this role, you combine product management experience in AI or ML-powered products with a working understanding of how AI recommendations translate into real operational outcomes for billing and RCM teams. You bring a collaborative approach to leadership, a track record of shipping AI products to production customers, and the credibility to earn the trust of both engineering teams and clinical-financial end users.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the full product lifecycle for one or more RCM AI Products from 0-1, GA launch, and through growth. This includes managing active customers, defining adoption metrics, tracking recommendation utilization, and driving expansion.
  • Define and own the roadmap, prioritizing opportunities across billing, claims, collections, and pre-billing workflows where AI can reduce denials, surface missed revenue, and reduce manual effort.
  • Translate AI model outputs, confidence thresholds, and recommendation accuracy tradeoffs into product decisions and customer-facing feature design.
  • Define success metrics for AI products that go beyond traditional SaaS KPIs, including recommendation adoption rate, billing event capture rate, and measurable revenue impact per customer.
  • Partner with advanced technology, data science, engineering teams, and other cross-functional teams to evaluate model performance, define customer feedback loops, and close the gap between AI output quality and customer trust and adoption.
  • Use qualitative and quantitative techniques to understand current and future customer needs, including direct engagement with billing managers, RCM directors, and facility operators.
  • Understand company strategy and contribute to the multi-year RCM AI roadmap, identifying the sequence of AI advisors that maximize customer value and PointClickCare's competitive differentiation.
  • Prioritize product investments and trade-offs using data-driven analysis and good judgment to build compelling business cases and quantify return on investment.
  • Engage with UX, Engineering, Technical Writers, and other product managers using agile processes and Design Thinking to ensure concepts are valuable and feasible.
  • Work with Sales, Marketing, Professional Services, and Customer Success to drive successful product launches, beta programs, and customer adoption of AI capabilities.
  • Participate in industry events and lead customer-facing and partner-facing engagements as a product expert.
  • Understand the competitive landscape for AI in RCM and healthcare billing.
  • Inspire, energize, and motivate cross-functional teams.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in business, Healthcare technology, computer science, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of software product management experience, with at least 2 years as the primary product owner of an AI or ML-powered product shipped to production customers.
  • Healthcare billing, revenue cycle management, or claims experience is required. Candidates without working knowledge of RCM workflows, payer operations, or medical billing will not be competitive for this role.
  • Demonstrated track record of managing products through beta programs and into general availability, including customer onboarding, adoption tracking, and post-launch iteration.
  • Experience defining success metrics and feedback loops for AI products, including recommendation adoption, model performance monitoring, and customer trust signals.
  • Ability to work at the intersection of domain expertise and AI product design, translating billing workflow knowledge into AI feature requirements and vice versa.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills with internal and external stakeholders, including the ability to explain AI behavior and limitations to non-technical customers and executives.
  • Solid understanding of agile practices and experience working with cross-functional teams including data science and ML engineering.
  • Experience managing SaaS products.
