jobs.description:
Empower Pharmacy is a visionary healthcare company dedicated to making quality, affordable medication accessible to millions of patients nationwide. As the nation’s most advanced 503A compounding pharmacy and FDA-registered 503B outsourcing facility, we’re redefining what’s possible in personalized medicine and pharmaceutical manufacturing. We’re proud to be recognized as one of Houston’s fastest-growing private companies and ranked #116 in Healthcare & Medical on the Inc. 5000 List for 2025.

Our strength is built on four core values: People, Quality, Service, and Innovation. Guided by these principles, we’ve created a uniquely integrated healthcare platform powered by advanced technology, operational excellence, and a relentless commitment to patient care. From manufacturing and quality control to distribution and customer experience, our teams work together to raise industry standards, expand access to critical medications, and improve outcomes for patients and providers across the country.

At Empower, joining our team means more than starting a new role. It means becoming part of a mission-driven organization that’s transforming healthcare at scale. We invest deeply in our people, encourage bold thinking, and create opportunities for growth, leadership, and innovation at every level. Your ideas matter here, your development is supported, and the work you do has a direct impact on the lives of millions.

If you thrive in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment where innovation, collaboration, and ambition come together, Empower Pharmacy is the place for you. Let’s transform healthcare together.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Sales Enablement Manager converts product, pricing, formulary, process, and systems change into field execution that accelerates revenue, strengthens customer confidence, and reduces operational risk. This role owns the sales enablement operating rhythm, product-fluent guidance, cascade communications, adoption measurement, field reinforcement, and cross-functional translation across Sales Operations, Marketing, Product, and commercial leadership. AI is a force multiplier, used to increase speed, scale, quality, personalization, and decision-making while maintaining rigorous human judgment and compliance controls. In Empower's hyper-growth, highly regulated 503A/503B environment, the manager builds trusted, repeatable mechanisms that keep sellers current and accountable. Success requires P80-P90 talent: strategic thinking, disciplined execution, learning agility, strong product curiosity, and the ability to translate complex change into clear actions that improve seller performance and customer outcomes with enterprise-level consistency and sustained commercial discipline.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Enablement Strategy

  • Enablement Architecture: Build and continuously improve the sales enablement operating system that converts business priorities into clear field actions. Define intake, prioritization, communication, training, reinforcement, and measurement workflows across product, pricing, formulary, process, and systems changes. Use AI to synthesize inputs, identify gaps, tailor content by customer segment, and accelerate execution while applying human review and governance appropriate to Empower's regulated 503A/503B commercial environment and growth expectations.
  • Field Alignment: Translate enterprise priorities into customer-segment-specific direction that sellers can apply immediately in live conversations. Partner with sales leadership to understand performance barriers, field workflows, and adoption needs, then shape enablement plans that improve clarity, consistency, and speed. Use AI to analyze feedback, surface recurring friction, and personalize reinforcement at scale while preserving approved messaging, appropriate escalation paths, and disciplined execution across rapidly evolving commercial priorities.
  • Performance Focus: Establish outcome-oriented enablement priorities tied to seller readiness, adoption, customer experience, and commercial performance. Define success measures for major launches, changes, and campaigns, then use data to distinguish distribution from actual understanding and application. Apply AI to detect adoption patterns, summarize qualitative feedback, and support faster decisions about where reinforcement is needed. Maintain a high bar for measurable impact, accountability, learning agility, and continuous improvement across the sales organization.

Product and Change Enablement

  • Product Fluency: Develop deep working knowledge across assigned therapeutic areas, products, formulary status, pricing dynamics, positioning, and competitive context. Translate complex updates into concise, accurate guidance that reflects the realities of each customer segment and reduces dependence on upstream teams for interpretation. Use AI to accelerate research, compare source materials, draft field-ready explanations, and identify knowledge gaps, with rigorous validation against approved information and regulated commercial requirements before guidance reaches sellers.
  • Cascade Ownership: Own the end-to-end cascade for product-relevant news, including new product introductions, outages, restocks, marketing campaigns, pricing updates, process changes, and upcoming short-dated product. Match urgency, channel, and reinforcement to the business need so sellers receive timely, actionable direction. Use AI to rapidly summarize change, generate audience-specific drafts, and support channel orchestration while maintaining one accountable source, clear approvals, and disciplined controls over message accuracy and release timing.
  • Knowledge Governance: Maintain a trusted single source of truth for current enablement guidance, playbooks, job aids, frequently asked questions, and critical change history. Establish content ownership, review cadence, version control, and retirement standards so sellers can confidently find the latest direction. Use AI to improve searchability, identify conflicting or stale content, recommend updates, and generate concise summaries while ensuring human validation, traceability, and compliance safeguards remain embedded in knowledge-management practices.

Adoption and Accountability

  • Adoption Measurement: Build practical mechanisms that verify sellers received, understood, and applied material updates rather than assuming communication equals adoption. Create certifications, knowledge checks, completion tracking, reinforcement loops, and manager visibility for compliance-relevant or high-impact changes. Use AI to analyze completion data, flag comprehension risks, identify coaching themes, and prioritize interventions. Escalate meaningful gaps to sales leadership and provide transparent reporting that connects enablement activity to readiness, behavior change, and performance outcomes.
  • Learning Reinforcement: Design reinforcement experiences that convert one-time communication into sustained field behavior, including microlearning, manager toolkits, role-based practice, office hours, and targeted refreshers. Use observed confusion, seller questions, customer scenarios, and performance signals to determine where additional support is required. Apply AI to generate practice scenarios, personalize learning pathways, summarize recurring questions, and scale coaching content while preserving approved guidance and appropriate human oversight for regulated or high-risk topics.
  • Manager Enablement: Equip frontline sales leaders to reinforce changes consistently through clear talking points, coaching prompts, adoption dashboards, and escalation guidance. Establish expectations for manager follow-through and create visibility into teams that require additional support. Use AI to summarize team-level trends, identify likely coaching priorities, and prepare targeted reinforcement recommendations while ensuring leaders retain judgment and accountability. Strengthen the connection between centralized enablement, daily sales management, and measurable execution in the field.

Cross-Functional Execution

  • Stakeholder Partnership: Partner closely with Sales Operations, Marketing, Product, commercial leadership, and other subject-matter experts to convert complex initiatives into executable field plans. Clarify ownership, dependencies, approval requirements, launch timing, and reinforcement needs before communications reach sellers. Use AI to synthesize stakeholder inputs, surface inconsistencies, accelerate draft development, and improve decision quality. Resolve ambiguity early, protect message integrity, and ensure enablement reflects both business objectives and practical field realities.
  • Field Intelligence: Serve as a feedback channel from sellers and customer-facing teams into Sales Operations, Marketing, Product, and leadership. Capture recurring questions, workflow friction, content gaps, and customer objections, then convert patterns into actionable recommendations. Use AI to categorize qualitative feedback, identify emerging themes, and accelerate insight generation across large input volumes. Separate signal from noise, validate conclusions with stakeholders, and drive targeted changes that improve guidance, processes, tools, and seller effectiveness.
  • Execution Rigor: Manage multiple enablement initiatives with disciplined planning, prioritization, documentation, and follow-through in a fast-changing environment. Anticipate risks, sequence work against business urgency, and ensure critical updates are delivered accurately without creating unnecessary channel noise. Use AI to streamline project tracking, summarize decisions, flag dependencies, and accelerate routine work, freeing capacity for judgment-intensive execution. Model high ownership, responsiveness, learning agility, and operational precision expected of high-performing talent at Empower.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • Advanced sales enablement and commercial operations capability, including change communications, learning reinforcement, knowledge management, seller readiness, adoption measurement, and scalable operating-rhythm design.
  • Strong product and business acumen with the ability to translate complex pricing, formulary, process, system, and therapeutic-area information into clear, customer-segment-specific field guidance.
  • Fluency with AI-enabled productivity, analytics, content, and knowledge tools, paired with sound judgment around validation, governance, data sensitivity, and regulated commercial use cases.
  • Exceptional cross-functional communication, stakeholder management, prioritization, and analytical problem-solving skills, with the learning agility and execution rigor required in a high-growth, high-accountability environment.

EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Operations, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Six (6) or more years of experience in sales enablement, sales operations, commercial operations, training, product marketing, customer-facing operations, or related functions.
  • Demonstrated success leading programs, workstreams, or teams that translate complex change into field execution, establish repeatable communication cadences, and measure adoption and business impact.
  • Experience using AI-enabled productivity, knowledge management, analytics, or content tools to improve speed, scale, quality, and decision-making. Healthcare or life sciences experience preferred, but not required.
  • Experience utilizing CRM systems, AI-enabled customer analytics platforms, workflow automation technologies, forecasting tools, and executive reporting dashboards preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders, lead cross-functional initiatives, solve complex customer and operational challenges, and adapt rapidly within hyper-growth operational environments.

Key Competencies:

  • Customer Focus: Builds trust through customer-centric solutions.
  • Strategic AI: Guides responsible AI adoption and adaptation.
  • Optimizes Work Processes: Drives efficiency with continuous improvement.
  • Collaborates: Partners effectively to achieve shared goals.
  • Resourcefulness: Secures and deploys resources efficiently.
  • Manages Complexity: Simplifies and solves complex challenges.
  • Ensures Accountability: Delivers on commitments with integrity.
  • Situational Adaptability: Adjusts approach to shifting conditions.
  • Communicates Effectively: Tailors messages to diverse audiences.

Values:

  • People: Empowering people defines who we are.
  • Quality: Excellence in every product, every time.
  • Service: Serving others is our highest purpose.
  • Innovation: Advancing care through technology and discovery.

Employee Benefits, Health and Wellness:

We offer comprehensive benefits to support your health, well-being, and future, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, 401(k) matching, wellness perks, IV therapy, and compounded medications. Learn more:

Physical Requirements:

While performing the responsibilities of the job, the employee is required to talk and hear. The employee is often required to remain in a stationary position for a significant amount of the workday and frequently use their hands and fingers to handle or feel in order to access, input, and retrieve information from the computer and other office productivity devices. Employees are regularly required to move about the office and around the corporate campus. The employee is regularly required to stand, walk, reach with arms and hands, climb or balance, and to stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl.

jobs.excerpt: Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

About the Role

You’ll design coding tasks that challenge frontier AI coding agents. Each task is a self-contained Docker environment with a broken piece of software; an AI agent attempts the fix; automated tests verify the outcome. Your deliverable is the full task package: broken code, tests, instructions, and a reference solution proving the task is solvable.

Responsibilities:

  • Invent a realistic developer scenario — a real bug, a broken ETL, a missing feature — not a toy problem.
  • Build a reproducible Docker environment with pinned dependencies.
  • Write a pytest that verifies outcomes, not specific commands — deterministic, non-flaky, and does not leak the fix.
  • Write an instruction.md that reads like a Jira ticket a developer would receive.
  • Write a reference solve.sh proving the task is solvable.
  • Calibrate difficulty so current state-of-the-art agents solve the task 20–60% of the time.
  • Iterate based on feedback from expert QA reviewers.
  • Later: review other authors’ tasks as a QA reviewer.

Not in scope

  • Data labeling, prompt engineering.
  • Production code to ship — you design problems and verification for AI agents.
  • Leetcode puzzles — scenarios must look like real developer work.
  • Not every candidate task ships — quality over quantity.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of production software development in one backend stack — Python, Go, Node.js, Java, or Rust. Depth in one stack beats breadth.
  • Python + pytest fluency — required regardless of primary stack. The task harness is pytest-based even when the broken app is in another language. Fixtures, parametrize, monkeypatch, timeouts, conftest.py.
  • Docker authoring — reproducible Dockerfiles, pinned dependencies, multi-stage builds when needed, non-root user.
  • Linux & Bash — comfort debugging inside containers (strace, lsof, journalctl); shell beyond set -euo pipefail.
  • AI coding agent experience — Claude Code, Cursor, Roo Code, or similar, on non-trivial work. You can cite a specific time the AI was confidently wrong and how you caught it.
  • English — B2+ written.

Not a fit

  • Data Science, ML, or Computer Vision engineers without backend-engineering output.
  • Manual QA testers without automation or test authoring.
  • Frontend-only, low-code / no-code, IT Support, or Business Analysts.
  • Engineers who have never written pytest from scratch.
  • Junior, intern, or assistant as the most recent role.

Preferred qualifications

  • Domain depth in Security, System Administration (nginx / systemd / cron), Scientific Computing (NumPy / PyTorch / SciPy), DevOps, or Git internals.
  • Modern Python tooling (uv, poetry, pyproject.toml).
  • Coverage tooling (pytest-cov, coverage.py, gcov, llvm-cov, kcov).
  • Fuzzing or property-based testing (Hypothesis).
  • Prior contribution to agent-evaluation benchmarks or related frameworks.

Process

Apply → Pass qualification (90-minute sample-task screen + short behavioral interview) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid.

Time commitment

  • Onboarding: ~10 hours per first task.
  • Steady state: ~5 hours per task, 2–4 parallel tasks per author.
  • Realistic weekly load: 8–20 hours. Higher volume available for top performers.
  • You choose when and how to contribute; tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet acceptance criteria.

Compensation:

  • Paid contributions, rates up to $35/hour*.
  • Task-based compensation equivalent to hourly rate, depending on performance and volume.
  • Some projects include incentive payments.

*Rates vary based on expertise, skills assessment, location, project needs, and other factors. Higher rates may be provided to highly specialized experts. Lower rates may apply during onboarding or non-core project phases. Payment details are shared per project.

Apply

Submit your CV via the Mindrift platform. Indicate your English level, note this role (Software Engineering Evaluation Specialist — Terminal Bench), and include a GitHub profile link if available.

jobs.title: Freelance Performance Video Editor (m/w/d)
jobs.excerpt: Du schneidest Videos nicht einfach nur schön, sondern so, dass Menschen stoppen, weiterschauen und klicken?
jobs.description:
Du schneidest Videos nicht einfach nur schön, sondern so, dass Menschen stoppen, weiterschauen und klicken? Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

AYLASHES ist eine erfolgreiche D2C-Beauty-Brand für DIY-Wimpernextensions. Mit unseren Produkten können sich unsere Kundinnen ihren individuellen Studio-Look in wenigen Minuten selbst zu Hause kreieren.

Für unsere weitere Entwicklung suchen wir einen erfahrenen Freelance Performance Video Editor, der vorhandenen UGC-Content, B-Roll, Produktaufnahmen, Voice-over und Skripte in aufmerksamkeitsstarke Werbeanzeigen für Meta und TikTok verwandelt.

Du solltest nicht nur dein Schnittprogramm beherrschen, sondern verstehen, wie erfolgreiche Paid-Social-Creatives aufgebaut sind: von einer starken Hook über gutes Storytelling bis hin zu einem klaren Call-to-Action.

Aufgaben

  • Du schneidest performanceorientierte Video-Ads für Meta, Instagram Reels und TikTok.
  • Du verwandelst UGC-Content, B-Roll, Produktaufnahmen, Voice-over und vorhandene Skripte in dynamische, überzeugende Werbeanzeigen.
  • Du entwickelst und schneidest unterschiedliche Hooks, Einstiege, Storylines und Varianten, damit wir verschiedene Creative Angles gezielt testen können.
  • Du arbeitest mit schnellen Schnitten, Untertiteln, Text-Overlays, Sounddesign, Animationen, Zooms, Pattern Interrupts und passenden Effekten – immer mit dem Ziel, Aufmerksamkeit und Watchtime zu erhöhen.
  • Du wählst eigenständig passende Szenen und B-Rolls aus und setzt Produkt, Anwendung, Ergebnis und Vorteile von AYLASHES wirkungsvoll in Szene.
  • Du adaptierst Creatives für verschiedene Plattformen und Formate, insbesondere 9:16 sowie bei Bedarf 4:5 und 1:1. Dabei achtest du auf Safe Zones, Lesbarkeit und eine saubere mobile Darstellung.
  • Du erstellst aus erfolgreichen Ads neue Varianten und Iterationen, beispielsweise mit anderen Hooks, Szenen, Captions, Längen oder CTAs.
  • Du setzt Feedback schnell und zuverlässig um und bringst gleichzeitig eigene Ideen ein, wie ein Creative noch stärker werden kann.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast nachweisbare Erfahrung im Schnitt von Performance-Ads für Meta, TikTok oder vergleichbare Paid-Social-Plattformen.
  • Du besitzt ein aussagekräftiges Portfolio mit relevanten Video-Ads – idealerweise aus den Bereichen E-Commerce, Beauty oder UGC.
  • Du verstehst die grundlegende Creative Strategy hinter erfolgreichen Werbeanzeigen und weißt, warum Hook, Retention, Storytelling, Produktinszenierung und CTA entscheidend sind.
  • Du beherrschst mindestens ein professionelles Schnittprogramm sicher, beispielsweise Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro oder CapCut.
  • Du hast ein gutes Gespür für dynamisches, modernes und plattformgerechtes Editing, ohne jedes Video unnötig mit Effekten zu überladen.
  • Du kannst aus vorhandenem Material selbstständig die stärksten Szenen auswählen und daraus eine klare, verkaufsorientierte Geschichte entwickeln.
  • Du arbeitest zuverlässig, strukturiert und detailgenau und kannst vereinbarte Deadlines einhalten.
  • Du kannst deutschsprachige Voice-over, Captions und Werbetexte sicher verarbeiten.
  • Erfahrung mit A/B-Tests, Creative Iterations oder der Auswertung von Ad-Performance ist ein starkes Plus.

Benefits

  • Flexible und ortsunabhängige Zusammenarbeit auf Freelance-Basis.
  • Die Möglichkeit einer langfristigen Zusammenarbeit mit regelmäßigen Projekten.
  • Klare Briefings, Skripte und vorhandenes Content-Material als Grundlage für deine Arbeit.
  • Direkte Kommunikation, schnelle Entscheidungen und konkrete Feedback-Loops.
  • Einblicke in die Performance deiner Creatives, damit du nachvollziehen kannst, welche Ads funktionieren und warum.
  • Raum für eigene Ideen, neue Hook-Konzepte und kreative Testansätze.
  • Abwechslungsreiche Projekte mit UGC, Produktvideos, Voice-over, B-Roll und unterschiedlichen Werbeformaten.
  • Faire und transparente Vergütung, abgestimmt auf Erfahrung, Qualität und Projektumfang.

Uns ist nicht wichtig, dass dein Lebenslauf perfekt aussieht. Entscheidend ist, was du schneiden kannst und ob du Performance Creatives wirklich verstehst.

Bitte sende uns mit deiner Bewerbung:

  • eine kurze Vorstellung von dir,
  • drei bis fünf deiner stärksten und relevantesten Video-Ads,
  • eine kurze Information dazu, was genau du bei den gezeigten Ads übernommen hast,
  • die Schnittprogramme und Tools, mit denen du arbeitest,
  • deine aktuelle Verfügbarkeit und ungefähre wöchentliche Kapazität,
  • deine Preisvorstellung pro Video, Stunden- oder Paketpreis.

Wenn du bereits an einer besonders erfolgreichen Ad gearbeitet hast, erzähle uns gerne kurz, was daran funktioniert hat und welchen Beitrag du geleistet hast.

Bewerbungen ohne relevantes Portfolio können wir leider nicht berücksichtigen. Wenn dein Profil zu uns passt, erhältst du von uns einen kurzen und klar abgegrenzten Test-Task.

Wir freuen uns darauf, deine Arbeiten zu sehen und gemeinsam Creatives zu entwickeln, die nicht nur gut aussehen, sondern echte Ergebnisse erzielen.

As a Customer Success Account Manager for ANZ at Zensai, you will own the customer relationship across adoption, value realization, renewal, retention, and account growth. What You Bring

Why Join Zensai?

  • Represent a differentiated platform built for Microsoft 365 and Teams.

Apply in just a few minutes. You’ll answer a few role-specific questions plus one about what you need to do your best work. We review applications weekly and keep you updated throughout the process. Learn more about how we hire at Zensaihere!

Job Description:

Title: Software Developer IV

The Role:

JD Power is looking for a senior data engineer with excellent quantitative and analytical skills who can combine multiple data sources to solve complex challenges around vehicle valuations, market readiness, and customer purchase decisions. You'll work hands-on with quantitative data to create new capabilities and improve existing ones. Beyond day-to-day engineering, you'll be a strategic technical advisor, translating complex data problems into business solutions and mentoring the next generation of data engineers.

The Impact You Will Have in This Role:

We build data products that solve critical problems for the auto industry. Every data engineer works on production initiatives that directly impact new and existing products. In this role, you'll own end-to-end responsibility for business-critical projects, ensure technical excellence across the team, and drive organizational capability through knowledge transfer and mentorship.

What You’ll Be Doing in This Role:

Core Job Duties and Responsibilities

  • Daily immersion in automotive industry data, with deep expertise in complex business rules and data management

  • Own full development lifecycle—architecture, development, testing, and bug resolution—for business-critical data initiatives

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define data requirements and translate business problems into technical solutions

  • Engineer robust, extensible data pipelines using modern cloud technologies (Snowflake, DATAPROC, AIRFLOW, Cloud Composer, Big Query)

  • Design, troubleshoot, and execute repeatable data processes; identify bottlenecks and optimize for efficiency and reliability

  • Bridge technical and business teams: analyze complex issues and communicate findings in terms business leadership understands

  • Enforce engineering best practices and proactively identify security vulnerabilities across the team

  • Mentor junior engineers on new technologies, processes, and industry domain knowledge

  • Lead cross-functional initiatives across Consulting, New Product Development, Data, and Engineering teams

Qualifications of this Role:

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Econometrics, Operations Research, Quantitative Marketing, Finance, Engineering, or similar field

  • 6+ years of full-time quantitative analytics and data engineering experience

  • Expert in SQL and Python; proficiency in modern cloud data platforms (GCP Bigquery, Snowflake)

  • Highly skilled in extract, transform, and load (ETL) processes with demonstrated efficiency and accuracy outcomes

  • Hands-on experience with orchestration tools (AIRFLOW, Cloud Composer) and distributed computing (DATAPROC)

  • Proven ability to integrate complex, multi-source data sets with multiple dimensions and layers of complexity

  • Track record of resolving data quality issues creatively and effectively; strong judgment to flag anomalies and inconsistencies

  • Ability to translate technical analysis into clear business insights; effective communicator in written and verbal formats

  • Subject matter expertise or demonstrated ability to quickly develop deep domain knowledge in industry-specific business rules and processes

AI-Assisted Development

  • Proficient with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) and able to judge when to accept, edit, or reject generated output

  • Skilled at providing effective context — codebase conventions, requirements, constraints — to produce production-quality results

  • Experience using AI to accelerate test authoring, documentation, and routine refactoring

  • Aware of AI tool limitations: hallucinated APIs, outdated patterns, security pitfalls in generated code, and the need for human verification before merge

Personal Attributes

  • Self-directed and detail-oriented, able to take ownership of work from requirements through release

  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, comfortable working across technical and business stakeholders

  • Supports the growth of other team members through peer reviews, pairing, and mentorship

Power.

You’ll be supported by experienced developers and expected to contribute thoughtfully — taking ownership, asking questions, and helping the team succeed together.”

Election Integrity Reporting Intern

Are you a college student or recent graduate who is worried about the state of democracy in the US? Do you want to hone your journalistic skills?

Then we have an amazing opportunity for you: A spot just opened up on our election integrity team.

From right now through the midterms (and the legal fights that will undoubtedly follow), we are looking for a young reporter with the passion and drive to cover threats to free and fair elections.

Who We Are

WhoWhatWhy is a non-profit news organization. We are staffed largely with skilled volunteers dedicated to elevating public awareness of any form of injustice in the US and across the globe.

Internship Program Overview

Since its founding, WhoWhatWhy has worked with aspiring young journalists and offered them opportunities no class, college newspaper, or internship with a local publication can provide.

Because WhoWhatWhy has always operated on a remote basis, our mentors are experienced in providing the sort of “distance learning” that is now needed for young people counting on in-person internships to get their careers underway.

Interns will be trained in all facets of reporting and work with their mentors to write various kinds of news articles – from wire-service style pieces to investigative stories. They will not have to share their bylines with anybody else and leave with a portfolio of quality articles. Some of them also stay on as paid freelancers or fellows.

We are looking for college students and recent graduates. Some reporting and writing experience is required. The commitment is a minimum of 10-15 hours per week from now through November.

Our Editors

Many of our editors have decades of combined experience working with young reporters at such publications as The New York Times, The New Yorker, and The Hill, as well as local, regional, and online publications like Buzzfeed and Vice. Others have taught journalism at the college and graduate school levels.

WhoWhatWhy mentors and staff also help interns find jobs through letters of recommendation, references, networking, and coaching

Expectations

You will work remotely and on your own schedule (apart from attending live Zoom calls for a mix of instruction and discussion with your mentor and peers).

Arlington, VA/Remote

Data Privacy

PCI Compliance

Client Assurance

Competencies, Skills & Qualifications

Qualifications

jobs.description:
Director of Marketing

Location: Santa Barbara, CA or Remote (US) —35% travel for events, customers, and team onsites

Come build with us. In this role, you will build and run the marketing engine behind CrossnoKaye’s 2026–2028 Brand & Demand strategy — establishing category authority in Software-Defined Automation (SDA), scaling a measurable demand engine, and helping double the business.

We’re hiring: A senior marketing leader who knows heavy industry and industrial software, has launched bleeding-edge technology, and can run brand, demand gen, analyst relations, and a flagship event program — hand in hand with sales and product.

This role reports to: Chief Revenue Officer (CRO)

What you’ll be doing:

  • Own execution of the Brand & Demand strategy: a long-cycle brand engine that builds Software-Defined Automation (SDA) category authority, and a short-cycle demand engine that converts intent against our named-account list.
  • Build our analyst footprint from the ground up: brief and cultivate relationships with the likes of ARC Advisory, LNS, IDC, ABI, etc. to earn analyst-validated positioning in food processing and heavy industry.
  • Stand up dedicated demand generation with Account-Based Marketing (ABM) as the spine (1:1 / 1:few / 1:many) across the Top 200 North American food processors — paid LinkedIn ABM, trade-pub native, SEO/AEO/web anchored on the SDA pillar, and an ROI calculator backed by customer proof.
  • Grow marketing-sourced pipeline from <15% to ~30% of the funnel, with clear attribution, dashboards, and a shared definition of pipeline with sales.
  • Own the three-tier events strategy: scale the Innovation Summit (75 → 150 → 200 attendees) into the category-defining SDA event, expand the trade show program into food processing (IPPE, Pack Expo, Process Expo, ARC Industry Forum), and run high-conversion road shows and executive dinners.
  • Partner with product and sales to install a disciplined product marketing and launch framework (Pragmatic-style) for ATLAS — from positioning and pricing inputs through launch and sales enablement.
  • Arm the field: sales plays, buying signals, contact data, references, customer marketing, and a customer advisory board that keeps sales and marketing on one motion.
  • Build and lead the marketing team as we scale from a two-person function — hiring, agencies, and budget ownership with a growth-stage mindset.

What we’re looking for:

  • 12+ years of B2B technology marketing with 5+ years leading teams, including time in industrial software or automation — ideally at (or competing with) a major controls company such as Rockwell, Siemens, Emerson, Honeywell, Schneider Electric, or Johnson Controls.
  • Fluency in heavy industry — food processing, chemicals, petrochemicals, energy, metals, cement — and the buying committees that run it (VP Ops, Director of Controls & Automation, CFO, CIO/CDO).
  • A track record of launching bleeding-edge technology into conservative markets
  • Well versed in Software-Defined Automation (SDA) and / or, Software-Defined Controls (SDC) advanced process control (APC) and / or industrial AI.
  • Proven success building brand and running demand generation in an Industrial software context — you have owned a marketing-sourced pipeline number and hit it.
  • Hands-on analyst relations experience (ARC, LNS, IDC, Gartner, or similar) turning briefings into coverage and category validation.
  • Experience running flagship owned events and multi-show trade programs that produce pipeline, not just presence.
  • A cross-functional operator who works shoulder to shoulder with sales and product to launch new products and build a solid, measurable sales funnel.

Nice to Have:

  • Category-creation experience — you have named, evangelized, and defended a category before.
  • An engineering or controls/automation background (or a degree that lets you keep pace with one).
  • Fluency with the modern ABM and marketing stack (HubSpot/Salesforce, 6sense/Demandbase, LinkedIn ABM).
  • Experience scaling marketing at a growth-stage company from ~$25M toward $100M revenue.

What Success Looks Like:

  • 3 months — Full audit of positioning, funnel, and events complete; the 2026 Innovation Summit is on track and you own its success; first analyst briefings (ARC, LNS) scheduled; the named-account list and ABM tiers are operational.
  • 6 months — SDA manifesto refined / published and the first “State of SDA” report fielded; ABM programs live against the Top 200 food processors; the launch framework is running with product on a shared cadence; the 2027 events calendar is locked.
  • 9 months — Analyst coverage secured and referenced by sales; marketing-sourced pipeline measurably climbing toward the ~30% target; at least one major product launch executed end-to-end; the core marketing team is hired and performing.

Compensation:

The estimated base salary range for this role is $200,000-$215,000. In addition to base pay, full-time team members are eligible for a company-wide bonus and equity options - giving you the opportunity to grow alongside the company and share in the long-term success we’re building together. Estimated total cash compensation may range from approximately $226,000-$243,000.

Final compensation is determined by several factors including prior experience, skills, and alignment with the role. The range above is intended to provide a helpful benchmark, though it may be updated as needed.

Why Join CrossnoKaye?

  • Impactful Mission: Be part of a team driving sustainable transformation in a resource-heavy industry.
  • Cutting-Edge Technology: Work with advanced IoT solutions and industry-leading experts.
  • Career Growth: As we scale, you’ll have opportunities for personal and professional advancement.
  • Inclusive Culture: We love innovation, embrace curiosity, and value well-being and professional development.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive salary with equity opportunities
  • Health, dental, vision insurance
  • 401(k) plan and parental leave
  • Untracked PTO and sick days
  • Cell phone reimbursements and other perks

At CrossnoKaye, we're building the first-ever operating system for heavy industries, revolutionizing how they operate and bringing them into the digital age. Our platform, ATLAS, unifies operational data, deploys AI-driven intelligence through AURA, and delivers Advanced Process Control at portfolio scale. We’re already driving measurable gains in throughput, energy efficiency, and uptime across the industries we serve. Our goal? Making industrial operations smarter and safer, with a measurable impact on climate change along the way.

We are an equal opportunity employer and we welcome applications from all backgrounds. We seek to build a diverse pool of applicants that will help to push our company forward. We believe that our true success will come from a diverse, dynamic, and inclusive environment. We seek and will consider all qualified candidates regardless of race, ancestry, color, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, citizenship, disability, Veteran status, marital status, or any other classification protected by law.

jobs.description:
Posting closing date: September 4, 2026

Date de fin d’affichage : le 4 septembre 2026

Status : Regular, full-time

Statut :Régulier, temps plein

(English version below)

Associé de recherche cliniqueII

RÉSUMÉ DU POSTE

La personne titulaire du poste depremier·èreadjoint·e de recherche clinique II assure la gestion, la surveillance et la conclusion pour les essais cliniques dans des centres de recherche assignés en vue d’assurer la sécurité des patients et la qualité de l’exécution des études, conformément aux lois en vigueur, aux bonnes pratiques cliniques (BPC) et aux normes de Pfizer applicables.

Elle gère et surveille les centres de recherche, gère les relations avec les investigateurs et investigatrices des centres de recherche afin d’assurer l’exécution efficace des essais cliniques (p. ex. recrutement des sujets, diffusion des données), de préserver la qualité des centres de recherche (p. ex. sécurité des patients, assurance qualité des sites et conformité aux bonnes pratiques cliniques) ainsi que de maintenir l’engagement et la satisfaction des investigateurs et du personnel des centres et de renforcer l’image de l’entreprise auprès de ses parties prenantes externes.

Elle se charge également de résoudre tous les problèmes liés au protocole qui surviennent dans les centres de recherche assignés et, au besoin, collabore de près avec le ou la partenaire responsable des centres de recherche et les membres de l’équipe de l’étude dans le cadre d’activités associées à l’organisation, à l’exécution et à la conclusion d’un essai clinique.

FONCTIONS

Gestion de centres de recherche et surveillance des centres assignés :

Surveillance des essais cliniques

  • Assurer le bon déroulement des essais cliniques conformément au plan de surveillance de l’étude ainsi qu’aux lois en vigueur, aux bonnes pratiques cliniques et aux normes de Pfizer afin que soient respectés les objectifs, les échéanciers et les attentes en matière de qualité.
  • Gérer les aspects opérationnels assignés pour la mise en œuvre des activités liées aux essais cliniques dans les centres de recherche assignés, de la mise en route du centre jusqu’au verrouillage de la base de données, en s’assurant que les échéanciers et les attentes en matière de qualité sont respectés.
  • Pendant le déroulement de l’étude, agir comme principale personne-ressource pour les centres de recherche assignés.Collaborer avec les partenaires responsables des centres de recherche ou leur soumettre les problèmes afin d’assurer la qualité de l’exécution des centres de recherche.
  • Interagir au besoin avec l’équipe de l’étude et faciliter l’échange d’information entre les membres de l’équipe, les fournisseurs et les centres de recherche assignés.
  • collaborer avec les partenaires responsables des centres de recherche pour offrir du perfectionnement, de l’encadrement et de la formation au personnel du centre de recherche afin d’assurer sa conformité au protocole et la sécurité des patients; offrir une formation sur le protocole au personnel du centre et répondre à ses questions, s’il y a lieu, notamment sur les risques opérationnels et les risques liés aux essais cliniques qui sont connus/prévus.
  • Au besoin, assister aux réunions des investigateurs(présence virtuelle ou en personne).
  • Offrir du soutien pour le recrutement des sujets et veiller à sa progression en réagissant aux problèmes des investigateurs concernant le démarrage de l’étude et le recrutement. Collaborer avec les partenaires responsables des centres de recherche et l’équipe de l’étude afin de définir et de soutenir les initiatives de recrutement du centre.
  • Effectuer la surveillance sur place et à distance/électronique selon les besoins afin de s’assurer que le démarrage de l’étude, la surveillance régulière et les activités de clôture sont conformes au plan de surveillance et aux MON en vigueur et prennent en compte les technologies et les problèmes émergents.
  • Exercer la surveillance des événements indésirables et des événements indésirables graves dans les centres de recherche, collaborer avec les membres de l’équipe chargée de l’innocuité des médicaments et, le cas échéant, assurer un suivi auprès des investigateurs des centres afin de résoudre tout problème soulevé dans les rapports de événements indésirables graves pour lequel une mesure doit être prise.
  • Présenter l’ensemble des rapports, des documents, des mises à jour et des suivis requis conformément aux échéanciers établis, y compris, mais sans s’y limiter, la documentation relative au fichier maître de l’étude, les rapports du centre, les lettres de suivi des visites du centre, les écarts par rapport au protocole, le recrutement des sujets, la gestion de l’approvisionnement pour les essais cliniques, la progression des études et les paramètres.
  • Repérer et résoudre les problèmes du centre de recherche conformément aux échéanciers établis; convenir avec les investigateurs et le personnel du centre des mesures correctrices et préventives à prendre pour résoudre les problèmes et prévenir leur récurrence/persistance.
  • Répondre aux interrogations de données conformément aux échéanciers établis, préparer le plan de conclusion de l’étude au centre de recherche et faire la visite de conclusion conformément aux échéanciers établis.
  • Assurer la surveillance adéquate des produits à l’étude au centre de recherche, notamment les activités de réception, de manutention, de comptabilité, d’entreposage et de destruction.
  • Soutenir la diffusion des données, au besoin.
  • Peut assumer les responsabilités d’un·e Moniteur-trice de l’étude non soumis·e à l’insu lorsque cela est nécessaire.

Risques cliniques/scientifiques et risques liés à la surveillance du centre :

  • Maintenir des connaissances approfondies sur les produits, les protocoles et les domaines thérapeutiques qui sont suffisamment détaillées pour que des discussions appropriées soient possibles avec les investigateurs et le personnel du centre.
  • Interagir avec les professionnel·le·s de la santé du centre de recherche de façon à rehausser la crédibilité et le leadership scientifique de Pfizer et à favoriser l’atteinte des objectifs de développement clinique de Pfizer.
  • Aider le clinicien ou la clinicienne de l’étude à assurer la sécurité et l’admissibilité des patients et à fournir une orientation clinique aux investigateurs.
  • Mettre en œuvre des mesures correctives liées aux événements touchant la qualité, le cas échéant.
  • Agir à titre de personne-ressource pour la conduite des audits et piloter l’élaboration et la vérification des mesures correctives et préventives issues des observations d’audit, le cas échéant.

Autres :

  • Accompagner et former les adjoint·e·s de recherche clinique et les premiers·ères adjoint·e·s de recherche clinique I qui lui sont assigné·e·s
  • Faire office d’expert·e pour les processus liés à l’ARC
  • Participer à des groupes de travail ou à des initiatives d’amélioration des processus à l’échelle mondiale, régionale ou locale, ou en assurer la direction
  • Exercer les fonctions de partenaire responsable du centre de recherche pour des petits projets ou sous la supervision d’un ou d’une partenaire responsable du centre de recherche dans le cadre de projets de plus grande envergure, dont la faisabilité et la sélection du centre, les évaluations préalables aux essais (PTA, pour Pre-Trial Assessment), la coordination des éléments de la liste de vérification de l’activation des centres, la mise au point des formulaires d’information et de consentement (FIC) et les visites d’activation des centres (SIV, pour Site Initiation Visit), selon le cas, ce qui comprend la gestion des problèmes pouvant retarder l’activation des centres
  • Mener des activités de surveillance conjointe

QUALIFICATIONS ET COMPÉTENCES

  • Baccalauréat en sciences de la vie ou diplôme professionnel en sciences de la vie (sciences infirmières, pharmacie, médecine ou équivalent)
  • Vaste connaissance des méthodes d’essais cliniques, de la Conférence internationale sur l’harmonisation des bonnes pratiques cliniques (ICH-GCP), des règles de la FDA et des règlements locaux
  • Expérience en surveillance : au moins cinq années d’expérience pertinente en surveillance de centres de recherche clinique (de preference trois années en oncologie)
  • Expérience thérapeutique souhaitée en oncologie, en vaccins, en médecine interne ou en maladies infectieuses
  • Expérience dans le domaine des essais cliniques d’envergure mondiale
  • Doit maîtriser l'anglais et la ou les langues maternelles du pays dans lequel il ou elle travaillera **Bilinguisme (français et anglais) – Un niveau avancé d’anglais, tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit, est requis afin de permettre à la personne de collaborer efficacement avec des collègues et partenaires situés ailleurs au Canada et à l’international de façon quotidienne dans le cadre de ses responsabilités.

APTITUDES PHYSIQUES OU MENTALES

·Connaissance supérieure des méthodes des études et du développement clinique, et capacité de maîtriser les détails des processus

·Connaissance établie des exigences de la réglementation locale et mondiale

·Compréhension supérieure des principaux éléments opérationnels de la recherche clinique (p. ex. surveillance, acquisition et classement des données, déclarations, etc.)

·Connaissance supérieure des maladies et des domaines techniques se rapportant aux études cliniques, y compris la direction de l’entreprise, les produits étudiés et les plans de développement associés

·Aptitude éprouvée à participer aux interactions avec l’équipe de réglementation du parraineur et les interactions et inspections réglementaires

·Connaissance poussée des processus entourant la conception du protocole et l’évaluation de faisabilité

·Compréhension approfondie de la culture et de la pratique médicale de la région/du pays et de leur incidence sur l’exécution de l’étude clinique

·Capacité démontrée à travailler dans une équipe matricielle et à influencer, à motiver et à diriger les autres en vue de favoriser la mise en œuvre réussie de l’étude clinique

·Capacité supérieure à évaluer, à interpréter et à présenter des questions et des données complexes pour soutenir la gestion et l’atténuation du risque

·Aptitudes supérieures pour la communication orale et écrite avec ses collègues et d’autres intervenants et intervenantes à l’intérieur et à l’extérieur de l’entreprise

  • Capacité démontrée à motiver et à mobiliser la communauté de surveillance par le biais du leadership et du mentorat

·Déplacements (de 60 à 80 % du temps) au sein de la région.Possibilité de voyages internationaux et durant la fin de semaine

Passeport et permis de conduire valides

Le salaire annuel de base pour ce poste varie de 92,100$ à 153,500$.

L’échelle salariale fournie s’applique seulement au Canada, et ne s’applique à aucun autre endroit à l’extérieur du Canada.

Senior Clinical Research Associate II

​JOB SUMMARY

The Senior Clinical Research Associate II is responsible for the site management, site monitoring and closeout of assigned clinical trials investigator sites to ensure patient safety and quality study execution in accordance with applicable prevailing laws, Good Clinical Practices, and Pfizer standards.

The Senior Clinical Research Associate II role is accountable for site management and monitoring, managing investigator site relationships to ensure effective delivery of clinical trials (e.g. enrollment, database release), to safeguard the quality of investigator sites (e.g. patient safety, site quality and compliance with GCP), to maintain investigator and site staff engagement and satisfaction, and to enhance the company’s image with its external stakeholders.

The Senior Clinical Research Associate II is responsible for the resolution of all protocol-related issues for assigned investigator sites and will work closely with the Site Care Partner, and other members of the study team, as required, in activities associated with the set-up, running and close out of sites in a clinical trial.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Responsible for investigator site management and monitoring for assigned sites:

Clinical Trial Monitoring

  • Ensure proper conduct of clinical trials in accordance with the Study Monitoring Plan and applicable prevailing laws, Good Clinical Practices, and Pfizer standards to achieve project goals, timelines and quality
  • Manage assigned operational aspects for implementation of clinical trial activities at assigned investigator sites from site initiation through database lock, ensuring relevant timelines and quality deliverables are met
  • During study conduct, serve as the primary point of contact for assigned investigator sites. Work in partnership with and/or escalate to the SCP to ensure quality of site delivery
  • Interface with the study team as needed, facilitate information flow between members of the study team, vendors and assigned investigator sites
  • Partner with SCP to perform investigator site development, coaching and training of site personnel to ensure ongoing compliance with protocol and the safeguarding of patients; provide protocol training to, and address protocol related questions from the investigator site staff when required, including discussions on known/anticipated operational and clinical trial risks
  • Attend investigator meetings when required (virtual or F2F).
  • Provide enrollment support and ensure progress by responding to site activation and recruitment issues from investigators. Partner with SCP and the study team to define and support recruitment initiatives at site level
  • Conduct onsite, remote/electronic monitoring as needed for study site initiation, routine monitoring and study site closure activities and ensure these are conducted accordance to the Study Monitoring Plan, SOPs and commensurate with emerging issues and technologies.
  • Monitor site level AEs and SAEs and collaborate with the Drug Safety Unit and follow-up with investigators sites, as needed, to bring SAE reports required information to resolution
  • Submit all required reports, documentation, updates and tracking within required timeframes, including but not limited to Trial Master File documentation, site reports, site follow up letters, protocol deviations, patient recruitment, clinical supply management, study progress and metrics
  • Identify and resolve investigator site issues within required timeframes; agree and develop corrective and preventative actions with investigator and site personnel to close open issues and to prevent recurrence/persistence of issues
  • Resolve data queries within required timelines, prepare investigator site close-out plan and conduct close-out activities within required timelines
  • Ensures adequate oversight of the investigational product at the investigator site, including receipt, handling, accounting, storage conditions, and destruction activities.
  • Support database release as needed
  • May undertake the responsibilities of an unblinded monitor where required

Clinical/Scientific and Site Monitoring Risk:

  • Maintain thorough understanding of the product, protocol and therapy area in sufficient details to have appropriate discussions with the investigator and site team
  • Interact with investigator site heath care professionals in a manner which enhances Pfizer’s credibility, scientific leadership and in order to facilitate Pfizer’s clinical development goals
  • Support the study clinician in ensuring patient safety, eligibility and providing clinical guidance to investigators
  • Drive Quality Event remediation, when applicable
  • Serve as a point of contact for audit conduct, and drive Audit Observation CAPA development and checks, when applicable

Other:

  • Mentor/train Clinical Research Associates and Senior Clinical Research Associates I, as assigned
  • Serve as an SME for CRA-related processes
  • Participate in or lead global, regional or local working groups/process improvement initiatives
  • Perform the duties of a Site Care Partner for small projects or under guidance of a Site Care Partner in larger projects e.g. feasibility and site selection, PTA, coordination of site activation checklist items, ICD finalization, SIV (as applicable), including management of issues that may compromise time to site activation
  • Conduct co-monitoring activities

QUALIFICATIONS / SKILLS

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences or professional degree in life sciences such as nursing, pharmacy, medical background or equivalent
  • Extensive knowledge of clinical trial methodologies, ICH/GCP, FDA and local country regulations
  • Monitoring Experience: Minimum 5 years relevant experience in clinical research site monitoring (preferably 3 years in Oncology)
  • Preferred therapeutic experience in Oncology, Vaccines, Internal Medicine or Infectious Diseases
  • Global clinical trial experience
  • Must be fluent in English and in the native language(s) of the country they will work in **Bilingualism (French and English): An advanced level of English, both spoken and written, is required to enable the individual to collaborate effectively with colleagues and partners located elsewhere in Canada and internationally daily as part of their responsibilities.

PHYSICAL/MENTAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Superior knowledge of clinical research and development processes and ability to gain command of process details
  • Demonstrated knowledge of global and local regulatory requirements
  • Superior understanding of key operational elements of clinical research (e.g., monitoring, data acquisition and cleaning, reporting, etc.)
  • Superior knowledge in disease and technical areas pertaining to clinical studies, including knowledge of company direction, investigational product(s), and associated development plan(s)
  • Demonstrated ability to support sponsor regulatory interactions/inspections
  • Advanced knowledge of the processes around protocol design and feasibility assessment
  • Advanced understanding of region/country, culture, and medical practice and how they affect clinical trial delivery
  • Proven ability to work in a matrix team environment with the ability to influence, drive / lead and work through others for successful delivery of clinical trial
  • Superior ability to critically evaluate, interpret and present complex issues and data to support risk management and mitigation
  • Superior verbal and written communication skills in relating to colleagues and associates both inside and outside of the organization
  • Demonstrated ability to motivate and align monitoring community through leadership and mentorship
  • Significant travel (60-80%) within cluster is required. May require some international travel and some weekend travel
  • Valid passport and driver’s license

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $92,100 to $153,500.

The salary range provided applies to Canada only and does not apply to any other locations outside of Canada.

This role is posted in multiple locations. If you are applying for the role in an secondary job posting location where pay transparency regulations apply, your Talent Advisor will share the local pay information with you during the first interview.

jobs.excerpt: Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
jobs.description:
Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States. This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title

Connected Systems Engineer

Location: 100% Remote (Only Local U.S. Candidates)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $130,000–$180,000 Annually (adjust as appropriate for your budget)
Experience Required:10+ Years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply.

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly experienced Connected Systems Engineer with 10+ years of experience designing, developing, and deploying connected, data-driven industrial systems that integrate factory-floor operations with enterprise and cloud platforms. jobs.excerpt: Our client is building an operations management platform that handles workforce planning, rostering, dispatching, and performance analytics for a large-scale field operations environment.
jobs.description:
Our client is building an operations management platform that handles workforce planning, rostering, dispatching, and performance analytics for a large-scale field operations environment. You will own the Python engine layer, responsible for the algorithms and data processing that power the core operational workflows used daily by operations teams.

This is not a typical web backend role. You will be working on constraint-based planning algorithms, large-scale data processing pipelines, and event-driven dispatch engines that operate in real time against live operational data.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN:

  • Planning engine: processing large volumes of operational schedule data through constraint evaluation, business rules, and engagement profiles to produce workforce planning demands. Built on Celery, Polars, and OR-Tools running on Azure App Service
  • Rostering engine: generating periodic staff rosters by solving constraint problems against planning demands, employee certifications, and leave data pulled from third-party HR systems. Running as an Azure Function App
  • Dispatch engine: real-time task assignment using proximity scoring against live employee location data, attendance records, and operational schedule data. Running as an always-on Azure Function App or App service.
  • Performance engine: scheduled KPI aggregation and SLA scoring across all modules. Running as a timer-triggered Azure Function App

WHY'S THIS ROLE INTERESTING:

The planning engine is the core of this platform. The algorithm you build determines how efficiently an operations team deploys its workforce against a complex schedule of demands. When the platform matures, the rule-based constraint engine you build will become the foundation for an ML-driven prediction model. You are building something that runs in a live operational environment and directly impacts how a team performs on the ground every day.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK WITH:

  • Python 3.11
  • Celery with Redis as broker for long-running jobs
  • Polars for large-scale data processing
  • OR-Tools for constraint solving and optimisation
  • Azure Functions for event-driven and scheduled workloads
  • Azure SQL via SQLAlchemy for output persistence
  • Azure Blob Storage for intermediate file handling
  • Azure Service Bus for async message queuing between modules
  • Third-party HR and workforce management API integrations
  • Real-time location data streams for proximity-based task assignment

Requirements

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

Required:

  • 5 or more years of Python backend or data engineering experience
  • Experience with constraint solving, optimization, or scheduling algorithms (OR-Tools, PuLP, or equivalent)
  • Strong data processing experience with large datasets (Polars, pandas, or Apache Spark)
  • Experience with task queues and async processing (Celery, RQ, or equivalent)
  • Familiarity with Azure
  • Comfortable working with SQL databases and writing performant queries
  • Experience consuming REST APIs and message queues

Preferred:

  • Experience with Azure Functions or equivalent serverless compute
  • Experience with OR-Tools specifically
  • Knowledge of scikit-learn or ML model integration (ONNX, Azure ML) for a future ML upgrade path
  • Experience with Pydantic for data validation and schema enforcement

Nice to have:

  • Experience with large-scale workforce management or scheduling systems
  • Familiarity with SLA-based operational frameworks
  • Experience working in fast-paced, operationally critical environments

WHAT YOU "DO NOT NEED" TO KNOW:

This is a pure Python engineering role. You will not be expected to write TypeScript, work on the API layer, or contribute to the frontend.

Your responsibility sits clearly within the Python processing layer. The integration boundary between your work and the wider platform is Redis and Azure SQL. You will write clean, reliable outputs into these systems, and the surrounding services will consume them from there.

In simple terms: you own the Python logic and data processing. The rest of the platform reads from what you produce.

At Pace, we transform girls’ lives through academic, counseling, and supportive services delivered through a gender-responsive, strength-based, and trauma-informed approach. Our team members create safe spaces where girls can learn, heal, build confidence, and achieve their full potential.

The Accounting Manager oversees Pace’s day-to-day accounting operations and supports the financial stewardship of an organization with an annual budget of approximately $50 million. Reporting to the Controller, this role ensures accurate financial reporting, effective internal controls, and compliance with GAAP, nonprofit accounting standards, grant and donor requirements, and applicable regulations. The Accounting Manager leads the accounting team and partners across the organization to strengthen financial processes and provide timely information that supports sound decision-making.

Who We Are:

At Pace we transform girls’ lives through academic and counseling programs based on girl-centered, strength-based and trauma informed framework. Team members create a safe place for girls to learn, process, heal and begin again.

Founded in 1985, Pace Center for Girls is a nonprofit organization that believes all girls, regardless of their story, deserve a safe and supportive space where they can become strong, compassionate and successful women.

  • Our Day program offers a comprehensive educational experience aligned with local school districts’ curriculum and Florida Department of Education requirements. The year-round program provides academics, counseling and life skills training for middle and high-school aged girls.
  • Our Reach program brings support directly to girls, ages 11-17, meeting them in their local schools, within their communities, or even at home.

Our Culture:

At Pace, our culture is built on core beliefs that foster a supportive, mission-driven, and empowering environment where girls can thrive and reach their full potential. Our culture is rooted in the following foundational behaviors:

Caring – We are warm, sincere, compassionate, and collaborative, fostering an environment of support and connection.

Purposeful – We are focused on our mission and committed to social responsibility, ensuring our efforts make a meaningful impact.

Learning Oriented – We are open, inventive, and exploratory, continuously seeking growth and improvement.

Results Driven – We are focused on achieving goals and measurable success, ensuring accountability and progress.

Girl-Centered – The ways that girls learn and develop are unique. That's why we've created an environment that responds to their needs so they can feel safe enough to develop meaningful and trusting relationships while embracing their capabilities, strengths and autonomy.

Using Your Strengths – Every girl brings something exceptional to the table. At Pace, we focus on developing these special characteristics. By supporting a girl's talents and positive attributes we help her achieve her goals.

Understanding Trauma – Trauma can alter the course of a girl's life. At Pace, we recognize that trauma may be the root cause of unhealthy behaviors, which is why we work hard to help heal and empower girls.

What We Offer:

  • Growth and Development - Competitive salaries, ongoing learning and development opportunities, and subject-specific instructional coaching to support growth and success.

jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

About the Role

You’ll design coding tasks that challenge frontier AI coding agents. Each task is a self-contained Docker environment with a broken piece of software; an AI agent attempts the fix; automated tests verify the outcome. Your deliverable is the full task package: broken code, tests, instructions, and a reference solution proving the task is solvable.

Responsibilities:

  • Invent a realistic developer scenario — a real bug, a broken ETL, a missing feature — not a toy problem.
  • Build a reproducible Docker environment with pinned dependencies.
  • Write a pytest that verifies outcomes, not specific commands — deterministic, non-flaky, and does not leak the fix.
  • Write an instruction.md that reads like a Jira ticket a developer would receive.
  • Write a reference solve.sh proving the task is solvable.
  • Calibrate difficulty so current state-of-the-art agents solve the task 20–60% of the time.
  • Iterate based on feedback from expert QA reviewers.
  • Later: review other authors’ tasks as a QA reviewer.

Not in scope

  • Data labeling, prompt engineering.
  • Production code to ship — you design problems and verification for AI agents.
  • Leetcode puzzles — scenarios must look like real developer work.
  • Not every candidate task ships — quality over quantity.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of production software development in one backend stack — Python, Go, Node.js, Java, or Rust. Depth in one stack beats breadth.
  • Python + pytest fluency — required regardless of primary stack. The task harness is pytest-based even when the broken app is in another language. Fixtures, parametrize, monkeypatch, timeouts, conftest.py.
  • Docker authoring — reproducible Dockerfiles, pinned dependencies, multi-stage builds when needed, non-root user.
  • Linux & Bash — comfort debugging inside containers (strace, lsof, journalctl); shell beyond set -euo pipefail.
  • AI coding agent experience — Claude Code, Cursor, Roo Code, or similar, on non-trivial work. You can cite a specific time the AI was confidently wrong and how you caught it.
  • English — B2+ written.

Not a fit

  • Data Science, ML, or Computer Vision engineers without backend-engineering output.
  • Manual QA testers without automation or test authoring.
  • Frontend-only, low-code / no-code, IT Support, or Business Analysts.
  • Engineers who have never written pytest from scratch.
  • Junior, intern, or assistant as the most recent role.

Preferred qualifications

  • Domain depth in Security, System Administration (nginx / systemd / cron), Scientific Computing (NumPy / PyTorch / SciPy), DevOps, or Git internals.
  • Modern Python tooling (uv, poetry, pyproject.toml).
  • Coverage tooling (pytest-cov, coverage.py, gcov, llvm-cov, kcov).
  • Fuzzing or property-based testing (Hypothesis).
  • Prior contribution to agent-evaluation benchmarks or related frameworks.

Process

Apply → Pass qualification (90-minute sample-task screen + short behavioral interview) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid.

Time commitment

  • Onboarding: ~10 hours per first task.
  • Steady state: ~5 hours per task, 2–4 parallel tasks per author.
  • Realistic weekly load: 8–20 hours. Higher volume available for top performers.
  • You choose when and how to contribute; tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet acceptance criteria.

Compensation:

  • Paid contributions, rates up to $35/hour*.
  • Task-based compensation equivalent to hourly rate, depending on performance and volume.
  • Some projects include incentive payments.

*Rates vary based on expertise, skills assessment, location, project needs, and other factors. Higher rates may be provided to highly specialized experts. Lower rates may apply during onboarding or non-core project phases. Payment details are shared per project.

Apply

Submit your CV via the Mindrift platform. Indicate your English level, note this role (Software Engineering Evaluation Specialist — Terminal Bench), and include a GitHub profile link if available.

jobs.description:
Empower Pharmacy is a visionary healthcare company dedicated to making quality, affordable medication accessible to millions of patients nationwide. As the nation’s most advanced 503A compounding pharmacy and FDA-registered 503B outsourcing facility, we’re redefining what’s possible in personalized medicine and pharmaceutical manufacturing. We’re proud to be recognized as one of Houston’s fastest-growing private companies and ranked #116 in Healthcare & Medical on the Inc. 5000 List for 2025.

Our strength is built on four core values: People, Quality, Service, and Innovation. Guided by these principles, we’ve created a uniquely integrated healthcare platform powered by advanced technology, operational excellence, and a relentless commitment to patient care. From manufacturing and quality control to distribution and customer experience, our teams work together to raise industry standards, expand access to critical medications, and improve outcomes for patients and providers across the country.

At Empower, joining our team means more than starting a new role. It means becoming part of a mission-driven organization that’s transforming healthcare at scale. We invest deeply in our people, encourage bold thinking, and create opportunities for growth, leadership, and innovation at every level. Your ideas matter here, your development is supported, and the work you do has a direct impact on the lives of millions.

If you thrive in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment where innovation, collaboration, and ambition come together, Empower Pharmacy is the place for you. Let’s transform healthcare together.

POSITION SUMMARY

The QA Automation Engineer designs, builds, and maintains automated testing frameworks and test suites that validate the software systems supporting Empower's rapidly scaling 503A/503B operations, including manufacturing, order management, and compliance-critical applications. This role owns disciplined technical execution from test strategy and script development through CI/CD integration, defect analysis, and continuous improvement of test coverage and reliability. The engineer applies strong technical judgment to identify quality risks early, reduce manual testing effort, and ensure automated testing evidence meets the traceability and documentation standards expected in a regulated pharmacy environment. Success requires close partnership with developers, QA analysts, business stakeholders, and validation teams to deliver reliable, well-tested software under changing priorities. The role is expected to learn quickly, challenge assumptions constructively, and use AI-enabled analysis when appropriate to accelerate test design and defect triage while preserving human review, data integrity, and accountable decision-making.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Test Automation Development

  • Automation Frameworks: Design, build, and maintain automated test scripts and frameworks (UI, API, and regression) that increase test coverage, execution speed, and release confidence.
  • Test Strategy & Planning: Translate requirements and user stories into clear test plans, automated test cases, and acceptance criteria that support safe, repeatable, scalable releases.
  • CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines so tests run reliably on every build, and maintain the supporting test environments and test data.

Quality And Problem Solving

  • Defect Management: Identify, document, and track defects using structured methods; work with development teams to determine root cause and verify fixes through automated regression.
  • Risk Assessment: Evaluate the impact of code and system changes on existing test coverage, prioritize testing effort by risk, and flag significant quality risks before release.
  • Continuous Improvement:Identify opportunities to reduce manual testing, improve test stability and maintainability, and strengthen overall test suite health through disciplined analysis and follow-through.

Regulated Collaboration

  • Cross Functional: Partner with developers, QA analysts, product owners, validation, and quality teams to align priorities, resolve technical blockers, and coordinate reliable test execution.
  • Compliance Discipline: Execute automated testing work with strong documentation, traceability, and data integrity practices consistent with computer system validation (CSV) and 21 CFR Part 11 expectations.
  • Operational Learning: Build technical knowledge rapidly from test results, production incidents, and stakeholder feedback to improve test coverage and prevent recurring defects.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • Strong knowledge of test automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or similar) and experience building and maintaining automated UI and API test suites.
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language commonly used for test automation (e.g., Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript).
  • Experience with API testing tools (e.g., Postman, REST Assured) and working knowledge of SQL for test data validation.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI) and version control systems (e.g., Git).
  • Understanding of the software development lifecycle, Agile/Scrum practices, and defect-tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps).
  • Ability to analyze test results and production data, identify failure patterns, determine root causes, and convert findings into practical improvements.
  • Working capability with AI-enabled analysis for test design and defect triage, while maintaining human validation, data integrity, and accountable engineering judgment.

EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Required: Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field, or an equivalent combination of relevant education and practical experience.
  • Required: 6+ years of experience in QA automation, building and maintaining automated test scripts and frameworks in a professional software environment.
  • Required: Proven ability to design test strategies, troubleshoot automation failures, document test evidence, and deliver reliable testing outcomes across cross-functional stakeholder groups.
  • Preferred: Experience testing within regulated, quality-controlled, or highly documented software environments (e.g., pharma, healthcare, life sciences) where computer system validation (CSV), 21 CFR Part 11, and traceability are important.
  • Preferred: Experience with performance or load testing tools (e.g., JMeter, k6) and exposure to cloud platforms (AWS or Azure).
  • Required: ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level (CTFL).
  • Preferred: ISTQB Advanced Level – Test Automation Engineering (CTAL-TAE), or equivalent test automation certification.
  • A plus: Microsoft 365 Certified: Copilot and Agent Administration Fundamentals.
  • A plus: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner or Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900).

Key Competencies:

  • Customer Focus: Builds trust through customer-centric solutions.
  • Strategic AI: Guides responsible AI adoption and adaptation.
  • Optimizes Work Processes: Drives efficiency with continuous improvement.
  • Collaborates: Partners effectively to achieve shared goals.
  • Resourcefulness: Secures and deploys resources efficiently.
  • Manages Complexity: Simplifies and solves complex challenges.
  • Ensures Accountability: Delivers on commitments with integrity.
  • Situational Adaptability: Adjusts approach to shifting conditions.
  • Communicates Effectively: Tailors messages to diverse audiences.

Values:

  • People: Empowering people defines who we are.
  • Quality: Excellence in every product, every time.
  • Service: Serving others is our highest purpose.
  • Innovation: Advancing care through technology and discovery.

Employee Benefits, Health and Wellness:

We offer comprehensive benefits to support your health, well-being, and future, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, 401(k) matching, wellness perks, IV therapy, and compounded medications. Learn more:

Physical Requirements:

While performing the responsibilities of the job, the employee is required to talk and hear. The employee is often required to remain in a stationary position for a significant amount of the workday and frequently use their hands and fingers to handle or feel in order to access, input, and retrieve information from the computer and other office productivity devices. Employees are regularly required to move about the office and around the corporate campus. The employee is regularly required to stand, walk, reach with arms and hands, climb or balance, and to stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl.
