Your dual-track capabilities allow you to design long-range operational strategies while meticulously optimizing granular technical bottlenecks. You possess the executive presence to influence senior leadership through data-backed insights, fostering consensus across departments. Furthermore, you distinguish meaningful automated outcomes from mere deflection, maintaining a sharp focus on quantifiable success metrics.

What You’ll Be Doing:

STRATEGIC PARTNERSHIP & LEADERSHIP ALIGNMENT

You are the embedded RevOps partner and strategic advisor to Support leadership. Your mandate is to make the Support organization more effective by owning the operational and analytical layer that connects their work to business outcomes.

  • Partner with the Sr. Director of RevOps and Support leadership to lead annual and quarterly planning — building bottoms-up operational plans grounded in real capacity drivers and demand signals
  • Own forecasting frameworks for the Support organization — ticket volume projections, channel mix trends, resolution capacity, and cost-per-resolution modeling
  • Track actuals against plan with discipline — identify deviations early, understand root causes, and bring forward-looking recommendations rather than backward-looking reports
  • Lead monthly and quarterly business reviews for Support leadership — owning the narrative, surfacing strategic gaps, and driving prioritized action
  • Build the financial models and business cases that support investment decisions — new tooling, AI capability expansions, channel investments, and headcount planning
  • Challenge assumptions with data — if Support leadership is making prioritization decisions based on instinct or anecdote, your job is to stress-test them with rigour and evidence

BUSINESS IMPACT FRAMEWORK — CONNECTING SUPPORT TO REVENUE OUTCOMES

This is one of the most strategically important mandates in this role. Support at HighLevel operates at scale — but the connection between support quality and the business outcomes that matter most (customer retention, lifetime value, churn) has not been formally built. You will build it.

  • Design and own the analytical framework that connects Support activity and quality to downstream customer outcomes — retention rates, churn signals, and customer lifetime value
  • Quantify the business impact of Support at the leadership level — translating operational metrics into revenue and retention outcomes that resonate at the executive level
  • Build the early warning system that gives Support leadership visibility into customer health signals emerging through support interactions — before they become retention problems
  • Identify where recurring ticket patterns reveal product gaps, friction points, or customer experience failures — and surface structured findings to Product and GTM leaders with clear business impact framing
  • Feed Support intelligence into the broader GTM customer lifecycle analytics layer, in partnership with the GTM Strategy function
  • Establish Support as a strategic contributor to retention decisions — not just an operational function measured on speed and volume

SUPPORT OPERATIONS — PERFORMANCE MANAGEMENT & ANALYTICS

The Support organization runs a sophisticated tiered operation across multiple channels and time zones. Building the RevOps layer that gives leadership real-time operational intelligence is a core deliverable of this role.

  • Own the KPI framework for the Support organization — defining what good looks like across CSAT, turnaround time, resolution quality, first contact resolution, escalation rates, and tier distribution
  • Build and maintain the analytics infrastructure that gives Support leadership visibility into team and channel performance at the granularity they need to make operational decisions
  • Track performance across L1, L2, and L3 tiers — identifying where escalation patterns reveal training gaps, process breakdowns, or product complexity issues
  • Own channel performance analytics — how are ticket volumes, resolution rates, and customer satisfaction scores distributed across chat, platform, and live Zoom channels, and what does the optimal channel mix look like
  • Build cost efficiency models — cost per resolution, cost by channel, cost by tier — enabling leadership to make evidence-based decisions about where to invest and where to optimize
  • Design and govern the operating cadences that keep Support leadership aligned, informed, and action-oriented — weekly business reviews, performance reviews, and escalation governance

AI & AUTOMATION — STRATEGIC OPERATIONS

HighLevel has deployed AI-assisted support tooling that is already delivering meaningful results at scale. This role is responsible for ensuring that investment continues to grow in impact — not just in volume.

  • Own the RevOps operational layer for the Support AI bot — tracking deflection performance, measuring impact on customer satisfaction and resolution quality, and identifying where AI is creating gaps versus solving them
  • Build the measurement framework that distinguishes between AI deflection (a ticket was not raised) and AI resolution (a customer's problem was actually solved) — and track both with rigour
  • Work with the AI/Innovation team on continuous improvement priorities — bringing structured operational findings, edge cases, and quality gaps that should inform the next phase of AI capability development
  • Identify where automation can reduce manual operational overhead within the Support RevOps function itself — and implement those automations proactively
  • Partner with the AI/Innovation team on the roadmap for Support AI expansion — providing the operational intelligence and requirements that should shape future AI investments

Process Design, Systems & Data Infrastructure

  • Audit and redesign operational workflows across the Support organization — from ticket routing and triage logic to escalation pathways and resolution standards
  • Define and govern handoff standards between Support tiers and between Support and other GTM functions — ensuring customers do not fall through the cracks as they move between channels and teams
  • Design process documentation standards for the Support organization — every key workflow should be documented, version-controlled, and accessible
  • Lead change management for new processes and systems — adoption is the measure of success, not design
  • Identify and eliminate operational redundancies — the Support organization operates at a scale where small inefficiencies compound significantly
  • Partner with the RevOps systems team and the AI/Innovation team to ensure the Support organization has the tools, data pipelines, and automation infrastructure it needs to operate at scale
  • Own data integrity for the Support organization — clean metric definitions, consistent tagging and categorization, and reliable reporting pipelines across all support platforms
  • Define requirements for tooling investments — translating operational needs into clear specifications for build vs. buy decisions

What You’ll Bring:

  • Possess exceptional analytical rigor with the ability to engineer complex fiscal models, operational frameworks, and bottom-line impact evaluations from the ground up
  • Act as a strategic visionary possessing deep tactical expertise, capable of architecting long-range directions while simultaneously mastering granular execution
  • Demonstrate the executive presence required to influence senior leadership, leveraging data-driven skepticism to foster institutional alignment and challenge status-quo assumptions
  • Deep experience navigating sophisticated service-centric ecosystems and omnichannel engagement platforms such as Freshdesk, Zoom, or similar enterprise solutions
  • Proficient in optimizing AI-driven automation workflows, maintaining a sharp focus on distinguishing verified problem resolution from superficial ticket deflection
  • Instinctively proactive, with a disciplined approach to surfacing critical operational trends and risks before they escalate into urgent bottlenecks
  • Exceptional people leader dedicated to cultivating high-performing analyst cohorts through extreme ownership, rigorous standards, and strategic foresight
  • Thrive within institutional ambiguity, possessing the architect’s mindset to transform unstructured challenges into scalable, high-fidelity organizational structures

Experience/Education/Certifications Required:

  • Possess 10+ years of professional trajectory within Revenue, Support, or Customer Success Operations, demonstrating significant mastery in managing high-volume, client-centric GTM ecosystems
  • Tier-1 MBA or a background in management consulting is highly preferred, emphasizing the analytical rigor required to engineer solutions for complex operational bottlenecks and engage leadership with executive clarity
  • Proven architect who has designed and scaled support operations infrastructure within expansive, enterprise-grade environments from the ground up
  • Deep expertise in establishing the causal nexus between service excellence metrics and quantifiable bottom-line outcomes like customer retention and revenue health
  • Operational mastery of AI-driven automation workflows, with a disciplined focus on verifying resolution throughput, quality auditing, and deflection efficacy
  • Significant experience navigating high-velocity SaaS landscapes where scaling requires the ability to architect robust frameworks while managing real-time institutional ambiguity
  • Formal certifications are secondary to a documented history of driving high-fidelity organizational impact and strategic foresight

Global Payroll Specialist

Assembled Intelligence is comprised of Minds+Assembly, BOLDSCIENCE, and Stratevi with a presence in the US and UK.

The Payroll Specialist at Assembled Intelligence will play a critical role in ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant payroll processing for all entities and regions. Primarily this position will work in collaboration with the Associate Director, Global Payroll and Benefits.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

The Global Payroll Specialist will assist with the execution of payroll operations for the global workforce. The role includes onboarding employees for payroll purposes, processing payroll, ensuring compliance with various state, federal, and HMRC regulations, and managing detailed reporting. This role requires balancing meticulous attention to detail with the ability to identify and implement process improvements in a growing organization. In general, the Payroll Specialist will:

Payroll Operations:

  • Onboard employees across the United States and United Kingdom, ensuring compliance with country specific payroll, tax, and statutory documentation requirements.
  • Maintains accurate employee records and coordinates all necessary setup activities to support seamless and compliant payroll processing.
  • Process bi-weekly, semi-monthly, and monthly payrolls across multiple entities with multiple states and the UK ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely delivery.
    • Manage and process payroll inputs, including regular earnings, bonuses, and deductions (e.g., benefits, garnishments).
    • Reconcile payroll prior to transmission to ensure all adjustments and changes are accurately reflected.
  • Establish new accounts for Withholding, SUI, and Local taxes as needed.
  • Collaborate with other stakeholders to update employee records, pay rates, and other relevant data.
  • Maintain a workflow with other members of the People+ Team to ensure all types of leave (such as maternity, paternity, leave without pay, etc.) which impact payroll is executed correctly.

Time Off Management:

  • Administer employee vacation, sick leave, and other paid time off accruals in accordance with company policies.
  • Perform regular audits to ensure time-off balances are accurately calculated and communicated.

Compliance and Regulations:

  • Maintain compliance with applicable US federal, state, and local payroll laws and UK payroll regulations, including wage and hour requirements, tax reporting, statutory payments, employee deductions, pension administration, and other payroll-related compliance obligations.
  • Remain current on payroll, tax, leave, and employment law developments across the United States and United Kingdom, with a focus on states and jurisdictions that have unique regulatory requirements, ensuring payroll practices remain compliant and aligned with applicable legislation.
  • Assist with responding to inquiries from tax agencies as needed.

Reporting and Analysis:

  • Support financial audits and reconciliations by preparing detailed payroll documentation and addressing inquiries.
  • Collaborate with the Finance team to reconcile payroll and resolve discrepancies.
  • Ability to create and deliver Ad Hoc reports as requested by Senior Leadership.

System Management:

  • Utilize Dayforce and other benefit systems to manage employee records, support payroll transactions, and ensure data accuracy for employees across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Collaborate on system implementations, upgrades, testing, and integrations to optimize payroll, benefits, and time-off processes and improve operational efficiency.

Excel Expertise:

  • Create and maintain complex spreadsheets and reporting tools to support payroll calculations, reconciliations, audits, and compliance reporting.
  • Utilize Excel knowledge and data analysis techniques to manage large datasets, validate payroll information, identify discrepancies, and improve reporting efficiency.

Required Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of relevant payroll experience, preferably in a multi-state or global organization
  • A bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as accounting or business administration is preferred
  • Strong understanding of US and UK payroll legislation, tax regulations, and compliance requirements, including federal, state, local, and statutory payroll obligations.
  • Proficiency in Dayforce Payroll and HCM, with experience supporting multi-jurisdiction payroll operations, maintaining data integrity, and generating payroll, compliance, and workforce reports.
  • Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills
  • High level of attention to detail, accuracy, and organizational skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain complex payroll concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while taking initiative to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines
  • Highly motivated, decisive, solution- and results-oriented with flexibility and creativity to excel in a rapidly growing and changing environment

jobs.description:
Empower Pharmacy is a visionary healthcare company dedicated to making quality, affordable medication accessible to millions of patients nationwide. As the nation’s most advanced 503A compounding pharmacy and FDA-registered 503B outsourcing facility, we’re redefining what’s possible in personalized medicine and pharmaceutical manufacturing. We’re proud to be recognized as one of Houston’s fastest-growing private companies and ranked #116 in Healthcare & Medical on the Inc. 5000 List for 2025.

Our strength is built on four core values: People, Quality, Service, and Innovation. Guided by these principles, we’ve created a uniquely integrated healthcare platform powered by advanced technology, operational excellence, and a relentless commitment to patient care. From manufacturing and quality control to distribution and customer experience, our teams work together to raise industry standards, expand access to critical medications, and improve outcomes for patients and providers across the country.

At Empower, joining our team means more than starting a new role. It means becoming part of a mission-driven organization that’s transforming healthcare at scale. We invest deeply in our people, encourage bold thinking, and create opportunities for growth, leadership, and innovation at every level. Your ideas matter here, your development is supported, and the work you do has a direct impact on the lives of millions.

If you thrive in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment where innovation, collaboration, and ambition come together, Empower Pharmacy is the place for you. Let’s transform healthcare together.

POSITION SUMMARY

Empower is seeking a Staff QA Automation Engineer to serve as the enterprise technical authority for quality engineering, driving the architecture, governance, and evolution of scalable automation capabilities across the organization. This role owns the long-term strategy for automation frameworks, testing practices, and quality engineering standards that improve software reliability, accelerate delivery, and enable data-driven decision making. Leveraging AI as a force multiplier, the Staff QA Automation Engineer advances automation speed, scale, quality, and engineering productivity through intelligent tooling, predictive insights, and reusable platform capabilities. Operating with significant autonomy, this role influences engineering strategy across Empower's hyper-growth, highly regulated 503A and 503B environment, partnering with technology leaders to solve complex technical challenges while demonstrating exceptional strategic thinking, execution rigor, innovation, and continuous learning agility.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Automation Strategy

  • Framework Ownership: Own the technical architecture, governance, and multi-year roadmap for Empower's enterprise automation ecosystem, ensuring scalable, reusable, and maintainable capabilities across UI, API, performance, accessibility, visual, and end-to-end testing. Leverage AI-assisted engineering, predictive analytics, and emerging automation technologies to accelerate framework evolution, improve engineering efficiency, and establish enterprise-wide quality engineering standards that support long-term business growth.
  • Architecture Design: Define automation architecture and quality engineering strategy for new platforms, products, and enterprise initiatives before implementation begins. Establish scalable design patterns, reusable framework components, and engineering standards that enable consistent automation practices while improving delivery speed, software quality, maintainability, and cross-team collaboration throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Technology Innovation: Evaluate, pilot, and introduce emerging automation technologies, including AI-assisted test generation, self-healing automation, intelligent test optimization, and next-generation observability solutions. Continuously assess industry trends to modernize engineering capabilities, improve execution quality, reduce maintenance effort, and position Empower's automation ecosystem for future scalability.

Technical Excellence

  • Framework Standards: Architect reusable framework components including Page Objects, API clients, authentication utilities, fixtures, reporting modules, test data management, and validation libraries that establish consistent engineering patterns across teams. Define coding standards, documentation, and governance processes that improve automation quality, maintainability, scalability, and long-term platform sustainability.
  • Validation Strategy: Define enterprise strategies for API contract validation, response schema verification, database validation, Salesforce integration testing, and cross-platform data integrity. Resolve highly complex integration challenges while establishing repeatable validation methodologies that improve confidence in application behavior, data accuracy, and enterprise system reliability.
  • Performance Engineering: Lead enterprise performance testing strategy using modern load testing frameworks, establishing methodologies for capacity planning, scalability assessment, stress testing, spike testing, and production readiness. Apply AI-driven analytics and performance intelligence to identify bottlenecks, predict capacity risks, and support informed architectural decisions before release.

Platform Reliability

  • Pipeline Optimization: Own the technical health, architecture, scalability, and reliability of automated execution pipelines across Azure DevOps, GitHub, Docker, and cloud environments. Continuously optimize execution performance through automation, intelligent orchestration, AI-assisted diagnostics, and resilient engineering practices that improve deployment confidence and reduce operational risk.
  • Quality Visibility: Define enterprise reporting strategies integrating Jira, Xray, Allure, Microsoft Teams, Prometheus, Grafana, and other engineering platforms to deliver trusted quality metrics and actionable operational insights. Ensure automation results provide meaningful visibility that supports leadership decision-making, release readiness, and continuous improvement across engineering organizations.
  • Root Cause: Lead investigation of the organization's most complex automation failures, pipeline instability, flaky tests, performance degradation, and integration issues. Drive systemic engineering improvements by identifying underlying technical causes, implementing durable architectural solutions, and eliminating recurring quality risks rather than applying temporary fixes.

Technical Leadership

  • Engineering Governance: Establish enterprise-wide automation governance through technical reviews, engineering standards, architectural guidance, and quality engineering best practices. Influence engineering decisions across multiple teams while ensuring consistent implementation of scalable automation patterns that strengthen software quality and accelerate product delivery.
  • Technical Mentorship: Mentor senior and mid-level quality engineers by providing technical coaching, architectural guidance, and expert support for the organization's most challenging automation initiatives. Foster engineering excellence through knowledge sharing, design reviews, and continuous development that elevates technical capability across the quality engineering function.
  • Strategic Partnership: Partner with engineering leadership, architects, product management, DevOps, and cross-functional stakeholders to align automation strategy with business objectives, product roadmaps, and technology investments. Represent quality engineering in architectural planning while communicating automation value, engineering metrics, AI adoption strategies, and return on investment to executive leadership.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • Expert knowledge of enterprise test automation architecture, quality engineering principles, and modern software development practices, with advanced proficiency in Playwright, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, API automation, CI/CD, and scalable automation framework design.
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate and implement AI-assisted engineering capabilities, predictive quality analytics, self-healing automation, and intelligent test optimization that improve engineering productivity, software quality, decision-making, and enterprise scalability.
  • Advanced expertise in performance engineering, API contract validation, cloud-based development platforms, Git workflows, Azure DevOps, GitHub, SQL, enterprise integrations, and observability technologies, with the ability to solve highly complex technical challenges across distributed systems.
  • Exceptional strategic thinking, technical leadership, communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills, with the ability to influence architecture decisions, establish enterprise engineering standards, build organizational consensus, and drive continuous improvement across multiple cross-functional teams.

EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and progressive professional experience in software quality engineering, automation architecture, or software development.
  • Twelve (12) or more years of progressive experience in software quality assurance, test automation, quality engineering, or software development in test, including demonstrated success leading enterprise automation strategy, architecting scalable frameworks, and influencing technical direction across multiple engineering teams without direct authority.
  • Extensive hands-on experience designing enterprise automation frameworks using Playwright, TypeScript, JavaScript, and Node.js, with deep expertise in UI, API, integration, regression, end-to-end, contract, and performance testing, CI/CD pipeline architecture, cloud-native engineering practices, and enterprise system integrations.
  • Preferred experience includes designing enterprise automation platforms from inception, implementing AI-assisted testing technologies, accessibility automation, containerized execution, cloud platforms, healthcare or other regulated industries, and industry-recognized certifications such as ISTQB Advanced or Expert Level, Test Automation Engineer, Microsoft Azure, AWS, GitHub, Salesforce, Agile, or DevOps professional certifications.

Key Competencies:

  • Strategic AI: Guides responsible AI adoption and adaptation.
  • Optimizes Work Processes: Drives efficiency with continuous improvement.
  • Collaborates: Partners effectively to achieve shared goals.
  • Resourcefulness: Secures and deploys resources efficiently.
  • Manages Complexity: Simplifies and solves complex challenges.
  • Ensures Accountability: Delivers on commitments with integrity.
  • Situational Adaptability: Adjusts approach to shifting conditions.
  • Communicates Effectively: Tailors messages to diverse audiences.

Values:

  • People: Empowering people defines who we are.
  • Quality: Excellence in every product, every time.
  • Service: Serving others is our highest purpose.
  • Innovation: Advancing care through technology and discovery.

Employee Benefits, Health and Wellness:

We offer comprehensive benefits to support your health, well-being, and future, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, 401(k) matching, wellness perks, IV therapy, and compounded medications. Learn more:

jobs.title: Product Engineer (Contract)
jobs.excerpt: There is a working product.  There is one founder.
jobs.description:
There is a working product. There is one founder. There is no team yet.

The product needs someone to take it the rest of the way — finish the build, harden it, test it, put it in front of the first real users, and stay close enough to those users to know what to fix next.

That's the job. It is not a well-defined ticket queue. It's closer to: here is the thing, here is what "done" means, go.

This is a paid contract role. We're paying for your time and your expertise, and we expect to pay properly for both.

What we're building

An orchestration layer that sits above the frontier AI models — Claude, GPT, Gemini — and coordinates them rather than picking one.

It is aimed at people whose work product is judgment, where being wrong is expensive and "the AI said so" is not an acceptable answer.

Where things actually stand

  • The core product works end to end.
  • There's a real documentation and decision-log discipline in place — architecture invariants, contracts, a decision record going back months, git hooks enforcing some of it. You will not be reverse-engineering a mystery.
  • There are known open bugs, known unfinished surfaces, and a UI that needs an aesthetics pass.
  • It has never had a user who wasn't the founder.

The gap between "works" and "someone else can use this without me sitting next to them" is the gap you're being hired to close.

What you'd own

Phase 1 — Close it out (first weeks)

  • Finish the remaining feature work; hide or cut what isn't ready
  • Aesthetics and UX pass — it needs to feel like a product, not a prototype
  • Fix the open bug list; expand test coverage
  • Security hardening pass ahead of real users (external review budgeted separately — you'll work with it, not carry it alone)

Phase 2 — Alpha

  • Ship it to real users
  • Onboarding: get people from signup to first genuine use without hand-holding
  • Support them directly. You'll be answering the emails. This is a feature of the job, not a chore attached to it.
  • Instrument it enough to know what people actually do, versus what they say they do

Phase 3 — Beta and beyond

  • Turn alpha behaviour into the beta roadmap
  • Help make the call on who this ships to first: individual professionals, small firms, or enterprise
  • Build the systems and documentation that let a bigger team pick this up later

Stack

  • Frontend: vanilla JS, HTML, CSS — a single-file monolith, no framework. Deliberate. It'll be broken up when there's a reason, not before.
  • Backend: Supabase (Postgres, auth, storage)
  • Hosting: Netlify, deploy on push
  • Provider APIs: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google
  • Node for tooling and tests

If you need a framework to be effective, this isn't your project. If reading 5,000 lines of someone else's JavaScript and immediately knowing where the bodies are buried sounds fine, keep reading.

Who we're looking for

Someone who uses both sides of their brain.

One side reads code carefully. Spots the branch that swallows an error without telling anyone. Doesn't trust a function just because of its name. Can hold the whole system in their head and work out what a change will break three files away.

The other side thinks about the person on the other side of the screen. Why they gave up at step three. Which feature they'll ask for and never use. What would make them tell a colleague about this.

Most people are good at one. We want someone who is genuinely strong on the code side and has real instinct for the user side — someone who can look at a screen and say "this works, and nobody will use it," and be right.

Hard requirement: you have shipped something real inside an agentic coding harness.

We mean you have worked inside Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Aider, or something equivalent — as your main development environment — and something you built that way exists, runs, and has been used by someone other than you. You know how these tools fail. You know what they'll confidently get wrong. You've built your own habits around checking what they produce, because you've been burned by not doing it.

Using AI to look things up or to explain code is not the same thing, and isn't what we're asking about.

And you finish things. One small project that shipped, got users, and was supported for months tells us more than ten impressive repos that stopped at 80%. We're being direct about this because the failure mode of this role is a beautiful, elaborate, unlaunched product.

What we are not asking for

  • A degree, or a degree in progress, or a degree completed
  • A specific number of years. Second-year student and twenty-five-year veteran are both entirely welcome, and will be assessed identically.
  • A recognisable logo on your CV
  • Deep security or infrastructure specialisation — that's brought in as expertise where it's needed
  • Prior startup experience

The founder covers strategy, product direction, positioning, and go-to-market. What's missing is build capacity and someone who owns getting it in front of users.

Hard requirement: you've shipped something real inside an agentic harness — Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Aider. As your actual dev environment, not as a lookup tool. And someone other than you has used what you built.

Don't care about your degree, your years, or your logos. Student or twenty-year veteran, same bar.

Stack: vanilla JS single-file monolith, Supabase, Netlify. No framework. If that sounds fine, we should talk.

Full-time, 40 hours a week, remote, with overlap into US morning or evening hours. Two months to start, with the possibility to continue.

To apply, send me one thing you shipped with an agentic harness, whether anyone else ever used it, and — in five lines — the first three things you'd do with a working product and zero users.

Send an email with:

  1. One thing you shipped using an agentic coding harness. Link to it, live if possible. Tell us which harness, what it got wrong, and how you caught it.

  2. Whether anyone other than you ever used it — how many people, for how long, and what broke when they did.

  3. Five lines, no more: you've just been handed a working product with zero users. What are the first three things you do?

  4. One thing you've killed. A feature, a project, an approach you'd invested real time in and cut anyway. Why.

No cover letter. No CV unless you want to send one. We're reading for judgment, not formatting.

Shortlisted candidates get a full walkthrough of what's been built, followed by a coding interview.

Terms

  • Engagement: Contract
  • Commitment: Full-time, 40 hours per week
  • Duration: 2 months, starting immediately, with the possibility to continue
  • Location: Remote. Overlap with US morning and/or evening hours required.

This is for a US start up.

jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

About the Role

You’ll design coding tasks that challenge frontier AI coding agents. Each task is a self-contained Docker environment with a broken piece of software; an AI agent attempts the fix; automated tests verify the outcome. Your deliverable is the full task package: broken code, tests, instructions, and a reference solution proving the task is solvable.

Responsibilities:

  • Invent a realistic developer scenario — a real bug, a broken ETL, a missing feature — not a toy problem.
  • Build a reproducible Docker environment with pinned dependencies.
  • Write a pytest that verifies outcomes, not specific commands — deterministic, non-flaky, and does not leak the fix.
  • Write an instruction.md that reads like a Jira ticket a developer would receive.
  • Write a reference solve.sh proving the task is solvable.
  • Calibrate difficulty so current state-of-the-art agents solve the task 20–60% of the time.
  • Iterate based on feedback from expert QA reviewers.
  • Later: review other authors’ tasks as a QA reviewer.

Not in scope

  • Data labeling, prompt engineering.
  • Production code to ship — you design problems and verification for AI agents.
  • Leetcode puzzles — scenarios must look like real developer work.
  • Not every candidate task ships — quality over quantity.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of production software development in one backend stack — Python, Go, Node.js, Java, or Rust. Depth in one stack beats breadth.
  • Python + pytest fluency — required regardless of primary stack. The task harness is pytest-based even when the broken app is in another language. Fixtures, parametrize, monkeypatch, timeouts, conftest.py.
  • Docker authoring — reproducible Dockerfiles, pinned dependencies, multi-stage builds when needed, non-root user.
  • Linux & Bash — comfort debugging inside containers (strace, lsof, journalctl); shell beyond set -euo pipefail.
  • AI coding agent experience — Claude Code, Cursor, Roo Code, or similar, on non-trivial work. You can cite a specific time the AI was confidently wrong and how you caught it.
  • English — B2+ written.

Not a fit

  • Data Science, ML, or Computer Vision engineers without backend-engineering output.
  • Manual QA testers without automation or test authoring.
  • Frontend-only, low-code / no-code, IT Support, or Business Analysts.
  • Engineers who have never written pytest from scratch.
  • Junior, intern, or assistant as the most recent role.

Preferred qualifications

  • Domain depth in Security, System Administration (nginx / systemd / cron), Scientific Computing (NumPy / PyTorch / SciPy), DevOps, or Git internals.
  • Modern Python tooling (uv, poetry, pyproject.toml).
  • Coverage tooling (pytest-cov, coverage.py, gcov, llvm-cov, kcov).
  • Fuzzing or property-based testing (Hypothesis).
  • Prior contribution to agent-evaluation benchmarks or related frameworks.

Process

Apply → Pass qualification (90-minute sample-task screen + short behavioral interview) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid.

Time commitment

  • Onboarding: ~10 hours per first task.
  • Steady state: ~5 hours per task, 2–4 parallel tasks per author.
  • Realistic weekly load: 8–20 hours. Higher volume available for top performers.
  • You choose when and how to contribute; tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet acceptance criteria.

Compensation:

  • Paid contributions, rates up to $35/hour*.
  • Task-based compensation equivalent to hourly rate, depending on performance and volume.
  • Some projects include incentive payments.

*Rates vary based on expertise, skills assessment, location, project needs, and other factors. Higher rates may be provided to highly specialized experts. Lower rates may apply during onboarding or non-core project phases. Payment details are shared per project.

Apply

Submit your CV via the Mindrift platform. Indicate your English level, note this role (Software Engineering Evaluation Specialist — Terminal Bench), and include a GitHub profile link if available.

jobs.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Caper is at the forefront of Physical AI, building smart shopping carts that sense and respond to the real world in real time. By bringing intelligence onto the cart, Caper digitizes the entire in-store shopping journey, turning every trip into an interactive, personalized experience from the first item added to checkout. Our plug-and-play technology requires no store renovation or operational overhaul — retailers simply add Caper Carts and instantly upgrade their stores into connected, intelligent shopping environments. Caper is one of the fastest-growing retail automation technology products in the market and is already widely adopted across the industry.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own recommendations and personalization on the Caper Cart. In this role, you will define how the cart decides what to show each shopper, when to show it, and how it adapts to who they are. Every recommendation, moment of inspiration, and ranking decision on the cart screen runs through the systems you will build and refine.

This is a unique opportunity to sit at the intersection of recommendation systems, machine learning, and a physical shopping experience that unfolds in real time as a customer moves through a store. You will blend ML and data science work with hands-on UX design thinking, partnering closely with Instacart's discovery and personalization platforms while shaping a first-of-its-kind experience for the Caper customer. You will report to the Group Product Manager for Caper Customer Value and work alongside a tight-knit team of three product managers, with broad cross-functional reach across Engineering, Data Science, Design, Ads, and Operations.

About the Job

  • Set and own the vision for recommendations and personalization on Caper. Caper turns the store itself into a personalization surface, where every item added and every step through the store is a chance to show something useful in the moment. You will drive Engagement as a primary pillar metric — growing customer interactions, building monetizable surfaces, and diversifying the content mix to serve savings, discovery, and health-focused shoppers.
  • Own the system that decides what to show and when. Mature recommendation and item ranking using machine learning, including LLM-based techniques, and use real-time signals — cart location and motion, lists, search, and Instacart personalization data — to deliver content at the moments it is most relevant rather than constant or intrusive.
  • Drive AI-first innovation to expand what Caper shows shoppers. Ship net-new content types with nuanced product information and pairings tailored to each individual, and lead the architecture for capturing real-time, in-session signals that make personalization feel genuinely intelligent.
  • Champion a high-quality, intuitive shopping experience by partnering closely with Design to translate complex personalization logic into interactions that feel simple and natural on the cart screen. Spend time in labs and partner stores to observe real shopper behavior, test features, and iterate quickly based on what you learn.
  • Run a fast, experiment-driven roadmap and serve as the product lead for recommendations and personalization across the organization — aligning senior stakeholders on strategy, tradeoffs, and progress, and partnering cross-functionally with Engineering, Data Science, Design, Ads, and Operations from discovery through launch with clear PRDs and measurable success criteria.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3+ years of product management experience or equivalent practical experience
  • Experience partnering with ML or data science teams to ship models into a production consumer product
  • Experience defining and driving engagement or relevance metrics, and using experimentation to move them
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage data and quantitative analysis to make sound decisions in ambiguous environments
  • Track record of close partnership with UX design teams and applying strong design thinking practices throughout the product development process
  • Strong communication and influencing skills, with experience presenting to large groups and aligning multiple senior stakeholders on strategy and tradeoffs

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building recommendation, personalization, ranking, or search products
  • Experience with consumer-facing hardware, IoT, or physical retail products
  • Familiarity with retail, grocery, ads, or marketplace recommendation systems

Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • A Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science / Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics / Natural Language Processing (NLP), Information Systems or other related fields.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in related roles or domain - specifically for QA-automation/testing or cybersecurity roles

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation:
Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $40/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.

jobs.title: GenAI CBRNE Cyber Expert
jobs.excerpt: DescriptionAs a GenAI CBRNE Cyber Red Team Expert, you will play a critical role in adversarially testing and strengthening the safety guardrails of GenAI systems against high-risk cyber threats involving CBRNE domains.
jobs.description:
Description

As a GenAI CBRNE Cyber Red Team Expert, you will play a critical role in adversarially testing and strengthening the safety guardrails of GenAI systems against high-risk cyber threats involving CBRNE domains.

You will combine deep cybersecurity expertise with CBRNE domain knowledge and hands-on AI red-teaming to design sophisticated adversarial prompts, multi-turn attack scenarios, jailbreaks, and model evaluations. Your work will identify circumstances in which GenAI systems could inadvertently provide information or capabilities that materially enable cyber-enabled CBRNE threats.

The role requires an adversarial mindset: thinking creatively about how malicious actors could manipulate AI systems, combine seemingly benign information across multiple interactions, circumvent safeguards, or exploit model behavior to obtain sensitive cyber-CBRNE information.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute rigorous adversarial red-teaming of Generative AI models across cyber-CBRNE threat scenarios, systematically probing models for vulnerabilities, safeguard bypasses, dangerous capability escalation, and unintended disclosure of sensitive operational information.
  • Design and execute adversarial prompts, jailbreaks, prompt mutations, multi-turn conversations, and scenario-based evaluations that test whether model safeguards remain effective against sophisticated or obfuscated cyber-CBRNE requests.
  • Develop realistic cyber-CBRNE attack scenarios involving critical infrastructure, industrial control systems, operational technology, cyber-physical systems, laboratory environments, hazardous-material facilities, and other high-consequence systems.
  • Evaluate whether models can be manipulated into materially assisting threat actors through attack planning, vulnerability analysis, target-specific reasoning, operational troubleshooting, or the aggregation of individually benign information into higher-risk workflows.
  • Identify and document failure modes and attack patterns, including indirect requests, role-playing, encoded or obfuscated prompts, terminology substitution, decomposition of harmful objectives into benign-looking subtasks, and multi-turn escalation.
  • Conduct systematic taxonomy audits and safety evaluations, classify model failures by severity and exploitability, reproduce findings, and provide actionable recommendations to AI safety and model-alignment teams.
  • Develop repeatable red-team test suites, adversarial datasets, evaluation rubrics, and risk taxonomies for measuring model resilience against emerging cyber-CBRNE threats.
  • Maintain current knowledge of emerging GenAI attack techniques, AI safety research, cyber threat intelligence, CBRNE security risks, and cybersecurity threats affecting critical infrastructure and high-consequence environments.

Requirements

Requirements

  • ﻿Location: Must be located in and authorized to work within the United States (excluding Illinois and Texas) or United Kingdom.
  • Education: Advanced degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Engineering, Security Studies, CBRNE-related sciences, or a closely related technical field. Equivalent advanced professional, military, intelligence, government, or industry experience may be considered.
  • Cybersecurity Expertise: Deep understanding of cybersecurity concepts, adversarial techniques, vulnerability analysis, attack chains, threat modeling, and defensive security.
  • CBRNE Knowledge: Strong understanding of security and risk considerations associated with Chemical, Biological, Radiological, Nuclear, and/or Explosive environments, particularly their intersection with cyber and digital systems.
  • Red Team Expertise: Demonstrated experience with red teaming, penetration testing, adversarial simulation, vulnerability research, security testing, threat emulation, or comparable offensive-security methodologies.
  • GenAI Red Teaming: Experience or demonstrated aptitude in adversarial prompt generation, jailbreak research, prompt mutation, multi-turn testing, model behavior analysis, and evaluation of LLM safety controls.
  • ICS/OT Knowledge: Familiarity with industrial control systems, SCADA, operational technology, cyber-physical systems, or critical-infrastructure environments.
  • Adversarial Mindset: Ability to think creatively about how sophisticated users could circumvent model safeguards through decomposition, obfuscation, contextual manipulation, multi-turn interactions, or combinations of otherwise permissible information.
  • Communication: Strong technical writing skills with the ability to clearly document prompts, attack methodology, model responses, vulnerabilities, reproduction steps, severity assessments, and recommended mitigations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with LLM red teaming, AI safety evaluations, jailbreak research, prompt engineering, adversarial prompt writing, or model vulnerability research.
  • Experience developing red-team test cases, adversarial datasets, model evaluation benchmarks, attack taxonomies, or automated LLM evaluation pipelines.
  • Familiarity with frontier AI safety concepts, dangerous-capability evaluations, responsible scaling frameworks, model safeguards, and emerging GenAI security standards.
  • Professional experience in offensive security, penetration testing, vulnerability research, cyber threat intelligence, incident response, or adversary emulation.
  • Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK, MITRE ATT&CK for ICS, NIST cybersecurity frameworks, IEC 62443, and other critical-infrastructure cybersecurity standards.
  • Experience working in national security, defense, intelligence, government laboratories, critical infrastructure, CBRNE security, or high-consequence industrial environments.
  • Relevant offensive-security, ICS/OT security, or cybersecurity certifications are advantageous.
  • Expertise in one or more of the following red-team areas:
  • GenAI Cyber Red Teaming: Adversarial testing of LLMs for cyber capabilities, including attempts to circumvent safeguards through prompt manipulation, decomposition, multi-turn interactions, and other adversarial techniques.
  • ICS/OT Red Teaming: Security assessment and adversarial testing involving industrial control systems, SCADA, operational technology, cyber-physical systems, and critical infrastructure.
  • Chemical & Industrial Cyber Risk: Understanding of cyber threats affecting chemical facilities, hazardous-material environments, industrial processes, process-control environments, and associated safety systems.
  • Biological & Laboratory Cyber Risk: Understanding of cyber and information-security risks affecting laboratories, biotechnology environments, research infrastructure, laboratory automation, and associated digital systems.
  • Radiological & Nuclear Cyber Risk: Understanding of cybersecurity risks and safeguards associated with nuclear or radiological facilities, monitoring systems, control environments, and supporting infrastructure.
  • Cyber-Physical & High-Consequence Threats: Expertise in analyzing scenarios where compromise of digital systems could produce significant physical, safety, environmental, or CBRNE consequences.

The salary range for this role in the US is $150K - $178K - Range may vary based on experience. Salary at the time of offer will be commensurate with experience.

About Alice

Alice is a trust, safety, and security company built for the AI era. We safeguard the communicative technologies people use to create, collaborate, and interact- whether with each other or with machines.

In a world where AI has fundamentally changed the nature of risk, Alice provides end-to-end coverage across the entire AI lifecycle. We support frontier model labs, enterprises, and UGC platforms with a comprehensive suite of solutions: from model hardening evaluations and pre-deployment red-teaming to runtime guardrails and ongoing drift detection.

Alice is widely considered a global leader in online safety and AI security. We have some of the most forward-thinking and passionate minds in the world working to safeguard over 3 billion users across the largest AI and tech platforms.

If you're creative and driven to secure the future of AI, we want to hear from you!

For businesses, Degreed builds the infrastructure for a culture of learning that attracts, develops, and retains top talent, driving performance at scale. About the Role

Degreed is looking for a Senior Designer to help bring the next chapter of our brand to life.

This is a hands-on creative role for someone who loves making work that's sharp, thoughtful and useful. You'll work across brand and marketing touchpoints: campaigns, social, events, presentations, sales enablement, web, executive storytelling, product marketing and motion-led content.

You'll be part of a small, high-impact creative team working closely with Brand, Communications, Events, Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Sales and Executive Leadership, translating complex ideas about workforce transformation, skills, learning technology and AI into work that's clear, human and memorable.

This role is for someone with strong design craft, high standards and real curiosity about where creative work is headed.   • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain design decisions clearly, take feedback constructively, and work well with a team to make ideas better.

    • Adapt ideas across formats and tools (Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, presentation platforms) without losing quality, including clean files and production-ready handover.
  • Evolve the Degreed visual identity
    • Work with the Senior Creative Lead to strengthen and scale Degreed's visual identity across web, campaigns, events and sales materials.
    • Apply brand guidelines with care while helping evolve them, and build templates and reusable assets that plug into AI tools for the wider business.
    • Balance consistency with distinctiveness, avoiding rigid or over-templated work.
  • Champion AI-first creative workflows
    • Use AI tools across concepting, image generation, layout exploration, presentation design and video to speed up production and free time for high-value creative thinking.
    • Work with the Senior Creative Lead to develop sensible standards for AI use, including quality, brand safety, transparency and creative judgement.
    • Stay close to emerging design tools and creative practices, and share useful learnings with the team.
  • Partner across the business

    • Balance creativity with practicality, pace, and commercial impact.

jobs.excerpt: 🌎 About UsAt TeamSnap, we believe when the world connects through sports; the world becomes better.
jobs.description:
🌎 About Us

At TeamSnap, we believe when the world connects through sports; the world becomes better. TeamSnap is a sports and communication platform dedicated to taking the work out of play in youth sports. We also believe our jobs should excite us, our teammates should support us and our bosses should inspire us. We empower our people to bring big ideas and tiny egos, landing us on Outside Magazine’s list of “Best Places to Work" and Built In’s “100 Best Remote-First Places to Work."

TeamSnap is seeking a Staff Software Engineer, Backend, to join our fully distributed engineering team and help us continue scaling systems that serve millions of daily users and tens of thousands of amateur sports organizations. Our stack includes Node, TypeScript, Elixir, Ruby/Rails, SQL, React, cloud-based services, event-driven systems, queues, background jobs, caching layers, and observability tooling.

We are looking for a hands-on Staff Backend Engineer who can build and improve APIs and services, reason through production issues across the system, lead technical design in ambiguous areas, mentor engineers, and raise the quality bar across the team. This person should be comfortable working closely with infrastructure, platform, and data teams without being expected to own those functions directly.

As an engineering team, we architect and build scalable systems using service-oriented and event-driven architecture. This role will help shape the technical foundation behind TeamSnap’s product experience, with a focus on backend systems, APIs, services, data performance, reliability, observability, and production quality.

What You'll Do:

  • Architect, build, and evolve backend APIs, services, event-driven workflows, queues, background jobs, data models, caching strategies, and integrations that support millions of users and thousands of sports organizations.

  • Own complex backend product and technical work from discovery through design, implementation, rollout, production support, and long term maintainability.

  • Lead ambiguous technical initiatives by breaking down problems, identifying risks, making practical tradeoffs, and helping teams move from uncertainty to clear execution.

  • Improve the reliability, scalability, performance, and operability of production systems through thoughtful architecture, strong testing practices, database optimization, caching, monitoring, alerting, and incident follow-up.

  • Debug complex production issues by reasoning across application code, databases, caches, queues, jobs, observability data, and the broader request lifecycle.

  • Partner with Product, Design, Engineering, Infrastructure, Platform, Data, Support, and other teams to turn roadmap needs into durable backend systems and practical delivery plans.

  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to give and receive constructive feedback, mentor engineers, influence cross-team alignment and articulate technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders

What Will Set You Up for Success:

  • Strong Node expertise with experience building and maintaining production backend systems.

  • Staff level backend engineering depth, with a strong track record building and operating high-scale APIs, services, distributed systems, or shared product capabilities in production.

  • Strong command of backend technologies such as Node, TypeScript, Elixir, Ruby/Rails, Java, Go, Python, or similar, including runtime behavior, failure modes, and production tradeoffs.

  • Strong SQL and relational database judgment, including indexing, query optimization, migrations, profiling, data modeling, transactions, read and write patterns, and performance tuning.

  • Practical understanding of service-oriented architecture, event-driven architecture, queues, background jobs, webhooks, Redis or similar caching tools, and systems that need to scale under real production load.

  • Working knowledge of production infrastructure and platform concerns, enough to reason through deployments, containers, CI/CD pipelines, cloud services, networking basics, observability, and operational debugging.

  • Strong production ownership mindset, with the ability to use logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, alerts, incident reviews, and system behavior to improve reliability over time.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, mentor engineers, facilitate technical decisions, communicate tradeoffs clearly, and connect backend technical choices to customer impact, business needs, and long term maintainability.

Bonus:

  • Previous work in or close partnership with infrastructure, platform, SRE, DevOps, or data teams.

  • Familiarity with Elasticsearch, BigQuery, analytics pipelines, search infrastructure, reporting workflows, or high-volume data processing.

  • Responsible use of AI-assisted engineering workflows to improve debugging, testing, documentation, refactoring, prototyping, or developer experience without compromising quality or understanding.

Got cold feet? If you’re thinking you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying. We’re all humans with special talents that go beyond what’s listed here.

jobs.excerpt: ServiceNow is seeking an experienced and highly skilled Senior Manager, Events Technology to join our Strategic Events team.
jobs.description:
ServiceNow is seeking an experienced and highly skilled Senior Manager, Events Technology to join our Strategic Events team. This role is ideal for a seasoned event technology professional who brings deep platform expertise, strong technical and operational instincts, and a proven ability to lead complex programs within a fast-moving global organization.

This individual will work across ServiceNow’s global event portfolio, partnering with internal stakeholders, technology teams, agencies, and vendors to deliver scalable technology solutions and exceptional attendee experiences. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable developing strategy, navigating complex software environments, and rolling up their sleeves to drive execution.

What you’ll do in this role:

  • Event Technology Strategy & Execution: Drive technology strategy and execution across major programs within ServiceNow’s global event portfolio. Translate business and attendee requirements into scalable technology solutions and provide experienced leadership across complex, concurrent initiatives.

  • Platform & Integration Leadership: Serve as a subject matter expert across event technology platforms and their supporting ecosystem. Partner across technical and business teams to drive complex integrations, data flows, platform configuration, documentation, governance, and operational readiness.

  • Program & Operational Management: Lead complex technology workstreams from planning through onsite execution and post-event analysis. Develop project plans, manage timelines and dependencies, identify risks, solve problems, and establish repeatable processes that improve quality and scalability.

  • Agency, Vendor & Budget Management: Lead external agencies, technology providers, and professional services partners while managing budgets, forecasting, resource allocation, scope, and performance. Identify opportunities to improve efficiency while maintaining a high standard of delivery.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Build strong partnerships across Strategic Events, Marketing, Digital, IT, Sales, Finance, Sourcing, and other stakeholder groups. Bring clarity to complex requirements, influence decisions, and serve as a trusted event technology partner across the organization.

  • Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Stay current on emerging event technologies and industry best practices. Identify opportunities to improve attendee experiences, automate processes, strengthen platform capabilities, reduce operational risk, and scale programs more effectively.

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in event technology, event operations, experiential technology, or related disciplines, preferably supporting large-scale B2B events and global event portfolios.

  • Deep experience with enterprise event technology platforms, with a strong track record working with RainFocus, Swoogo, and Cvent Passkey. Experience with Jifflenow is a plus.

  • Significant experience working within complex software ecosystems and managing integrations between event platforms and enterprise technologies, including CRM, marketing automation, identity, data, mobile, APIs, and other SaaS platforms.

  • Proven ability to independently lead complex, high-profile event technology programs and multiple concurrent workstreams from strategy through execution.

  • Strong program management skills, including project planning, requirements gathering, timeline and dependency management, risk mitigation, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

  • Demonstrated experience managing substantial budgets, agencies, professional services engagements, SaaS vendors, forecasting, and resource allocation.

  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to understand system architecture, data flows, integrations, dependencies, and platform limitations while translating technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.

  • Proven success operating within large, highly matrixed global organizations and influencing stakeholders across multiple functions and levels.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to bring clarity to ambiguous problems, build alignment, and drive decisions.

  • Ability to operate independently, manage changing priorities, and move comfortably between strategic planning and hands-on execution.

  • Experience within enterprise software, technology, or another complex global B2B organization preferred.

  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally as required (5+ events per calendar year minimum).

Transforming Life Science Consulting Worldwide.

With over 450 employees and 25 offices worldwide, our mission is to revolutionize our clients' business transformation challenges and set new industry standards through innovative solutions.

Focused on S/4HANA, Data & Cloud, and innovative technologies, Fusion Consulting brings unparalleled expertise and commitment to excellence to every project we undertake.

jobs.excerpt: # Safety Project | Emotional Distress Clinical Specialist (Role-Play & Evaluation) $40/entregávelIndique e ganhe ## About VettoVetto is a global platform that connects top-tier professionals to strategic Artificial Intelligence projects around the world.
jobs.description:
# Safety Project | Emotional Distress Clinical Specialist (Role-Play & Evaluation)

$40/entregável

Indique e ganhe

## About Vetto

Vetto is a global platform that connects top-tier professionals to strategic Artificial Intelligence projects around the world. Our mission is to build trust, quality, and long-term value within the AI ecosystem, for both exceptional talent and companies operating at the forefront of technology.

## About the project

We are opening a freelance opportunity for the Safety Project — Emotional Distress (Clinical track), a project focused on evaluating how AI systems respond in sensitive conversations involving emotional distress, suicidal ideation, and depression. The goal of this project is to assess whether the AI can respond with empathy, responsibility, and appropriate safety awareness in high-risk emotional scenarios.

In this track, selected contributors will perform two complementary activities:

1. Role-play— participate in structured multi-turn conversations with an AI system, acting according to a predefined persona and scenario representative of real clinical presentations. 2. Evaluation — review AI responses against clinical criteria, assessing risk recognition, appropriateness of safety messaging, empathy, accuracy of psychoeducation, and adherence to evidence-based crisis-response practices.

This dual contribution is what makes the clinical track distinct: we need professionals who can both embodya sensitive scenario and judge the AI's response with clinical rigor.

## What you'll do

  • Conduct role-play sessionsas a clinically informed persona across multi-turn conversations - Evaluate AI responses for safety, empathy, clinical appropriateness, and risk handling - Provide structured written feedback grounded in clinical reasoning - Flag responses that miss risk signals, give unsafe guidance, or fall short of best-practice crisis communication

## Who can apply

Licensed or formally trained professionals in psychiatry, clinical psychology, counseling psychology, psychiatric nursing, or related mental health fields— including those working in crisis centers, helplines, or other mental health support environments. Experience in suicide prevention, crisis intervention, or risk assessment is highly valued.

## Profiles we're looking for

  • Psychiatry or psychiatric nursing - Clinical or counseling psychology - Crisis intervention or suicide prevention specialists - Social work focused on mental health - Helpline or support center professionals (clinical role) - Emotional health coaching or therapy with formal training - Researchers or educators in mental health and risk assessment

## Compensation

Payment is made per approved task: US$40 per approved task. Each task takes approximately 1 hour to complete. Only approved tasks are eligible for payment.

## Refer People → Earn Money

Earn $20 USDfor each approved referral. Visit and click "Refer & Earn".

‼️ AI is not allowed.If we spot AI use, we'll block the application.

⚠️ This application must be completed entirely in English or Portuguese.

⚠️ Important warning:This project involves highly sensitive topics, including emotional distress, suicidal ideation, and depression. These tasks may be emotionally triggering for some people.

Our mission is to help individuals and families build strong foundations for healthy, fulfilling lives.

Why Work for Us?

Trillium believes that empowering others begins with supporting our team. We offer our employees:

  • A collaborative, mission-driven work environment
  • Competitive benefits and work-from-home options for most positions

Trillium Health Resources has a career opening for an Appeals Specialist II to join our team! The Appeals Specialist II manages appeals or grievance cases from intake through resolution. On a typical day, you might:

  • Manage assigned appeals, grievances, and/or complaint cases from intake through resolution.
  • Investigate cases by gathering documentation, interviewing stakeholders, and analyzing findings.
  • Evaluate case information to determine appropriate resolution and required actions.
  • Prepare and issue acknowledgment and resolution letters within required time frames.
  • Maintain complete case files in accordance with regulatory and accreditation standards.

Employee Benefits:

Trillium knows that work/life balance is essential. That’s why we offer:

  • Typical working hours: 8:30 am – 5:00 pm; flexible work schedules with some roles with management approval.
  • Work-from-home options available for most positions
  • Health Insurance with no premium for employee coverage
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • 24 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) plus 12 paid holidays in your first year
  • NC Local Government Retirement Pension (defined-benefit plan)
  • 401k with 5% employer match and immediate vesting
  • Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) qualifying employer
  • Quarterly stipend for remote work supplies

Qualifications

Required:

  • High school diploma or GED and six (6) years of experience in the Mental Health, Developmental Disabilities, and Substance Use services field; OR
  • Associate's degree and four (4) years of experience in the Mental Health, Developmental Disabilities, and Substance Use services field; OR
  • Bachelor's degree and two (2) years of experience in the Mental Health, Developmental Disabilities, and Substance Use services field; OR
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license.
  • Must reside within North Carolina.
  • Must be able to travel within catchment as required.

Preferred:

  • Experience working with provider claims, provider network, or provider sanctions.

To be considered, submit your application and resume through our ADP Career Center. Your resume must include:

  • Employer name, dates of service (month/year), average hours worked per week, and essential job duties

After submission, your resume will be reviewed to ensure it meets the essential criteria for the position. You’ll be notified by HR regarding your application status as appropriate. All applicants will receive a final update once the recruitment cycle closes.

Join our Talent Community through ADP to stay informed about future opportunities. Be sure to keep your resume updated in your profile.

jobs.title: Young Ambassador (Volunteer)
jobs.excerpt: Here at Youth4Youth, we have grown a strong, tight-knit community of individuals who are passionate about making a difference and improving the lives of young people across the UK.
jobs.description:
Here at Youth4Youth, we have grown a strong, tight-knit community of individuals who are passionate about making a difference and improving the lives of young people across the UK. Our growing team of volunteers all contribute, significantly, to the impact that we have as a charity on our direct beneficiaries, regardless of the department that they work in of the level of time that they are able to commit. Our servicesprimarily offer a peer-support network to young people right across the UK, allowing them to access a peer mentor who is of a similar age to them and somebody that they feel more comfortable speaking with.

If successful, you will be joining a growing team of diverse, but likeminded individuals, collaborating to increase the reach of the Charity and improve support provisions available to young people. All of our volunteers and employees are remote workers,but that doesn't stop us keeping in touch and maintaining a strong positive culture amongst our whole team.

About the role

Here at Youth4Youth, we hugely value involving young people in decisions made about how the charity supports young people. We are pleased that we continue to build the relationship that our Board of Trustees has with young people through our Youth Voice Team.

If you are aged 14 to 25, this is a great opportunity to join a growing and adaptable youth-focussed charity and make a real impact. As a member of the Youth Voice Team, you will play a key role in providing feedback to the Board of Trustees on the Charity, promote youth voice from within and, ultimately, influence decisions made about the charity and how we remain relevant to the needs of those that we support.

We are happy to help you with any volunteering hours required for programmes such as the Duke of Edinburgh award - let us know when you get started so that we can track your hours and sign them off.

What does our Youth Voice team need from you?

  • Attend regular Youth Voice meetings (normally held monthly), where you will play an active role in discussing the current status of the Charity and its growth

  • Influence decisions that are made to make sure that we stay relevant to the needs of young people - this includes the general direction of the charity, the services that we offer, the way that we engage with young people and much more!

  • Be an ambassador for the charity and share what we do with others (such as your peers and your local community) to gather feedback and insights to help us understand the needs of young people.

  • Get involved in other areas that interest you, such as social media, fundraising and much more.

Our mission is to continue to grow towards becoming one of the best charities in the UK. Our aim is to do this by building a diverse team, rich with different backgrounds and perspectives. Therefore, even if you feel you only are a 75% match, we would still love to hear from you. Skills can be learned, but diversity cannot.

Benefits of volunteering with Youth4Youth

We recognise that you will be joining us and giving your time as an 'in-kind' donation, but there must be benefits for you too. When joining our team, you will be open to the following benefits:

  • Professional and personal development opportunities in a variety of skill areas through volunteering in real roles. This may be general development or tailored to your specific needs or ambitions

  • Becoming a member of a strong network of likeminded individuals, spread across the UK, who you can connect with and collaborate with both within and outside of the Charity

  • Access to bespoke discounts, specifically designed for non-profit workers and Youth4Youth volunteers

  • Opportunities to truly shape the future of the Charity, having a direct influence over the impact that Youth4Youth has on its direct beneficiaries

The hiring process

Our hiring process typically has two stages

  1. Video or Written Application (when applicable)

  2. Interview with the Volunteering Coordinator for that role

Some roles will have extra stages but we’ll let you know as early as possible if so.

Please let us know if you require any accommodations for the interview process, and we’ll do our best to assist.

Price Benowitz LLP is a mid-sized law firm headquartered in Washington, DC, with offices throughout Washington, DC, Maryland, Virginia, and South Carolina.
